OSSC CPGLRE 2025 Provisional Result 2026 - Teacher Educator and Instructor Posts Shortlist Released

The OSSC CPGLRE 2025 Provisional Result is officially out. The Odisha Staff Selection Commission (OSSC), Unit-II, Bhubaneswar - 751009 has released the provisional shortlist of candidates for the Main Written Examination of various Teacher Educator and Instructor posts under the Combined Post Graduate Level Recruitment Examination-2025 (CPGLRE-2025), vide Notification No. Conf-IIE-47/2025-79(C)/OSSC, dated 12 June 2026.

Candidates who appeared in the Preliminary Examination held on 10 May 2026, pursuant to Advertisement No. 5915/OSSC dated 30.12.2025, can now check their roll numbers in the official provisional shortlist. The result is subject to the final outcome of WP(C) No. 2405 of 2026.

The date of the Main Written Examination will be announced separately on the official OSSC website at www.ossc.gov.in. All shortlisted candidates are advised to visit the official portal regularly for further updates.

How to Check Your Name in OSSC CPGLRE 2025 Provisional Shortlist

Candidates can verify whether they have been provisionally shortlisted for the Main Written Examination by following these simple steps. The shortlist is available as a PDF document on the official OSSC portal.

  1. Visit the official OSSC website: www.ossc.gov.in
  2. Navigate to the "Results / Notifications" section on the homepage.
  3. Look for the notification titled "CPGLRE-2025 - Provisional Shortlist for Main Written Examination (Teacher Educator and Instructor Posts)"
  4. Click on the link to open or download the PDF.
  5. Search for your Roll Number in the relevant post-category list.
  6. Note the category against which you have been shortlisted.
  7. Bookmark the official website to stay updated on the Main Written Exam date announcement.

Official Website: www.ossc.gov.in

Important Note for Shortlisted Candidates

All candidates whose roll numbers appear in this provisional shortlist should note the following key points before appearing in the Main Written Examination:

  • The exact date and schedule for the Main Written Examination will be announced separately on the OSSC official website.
  • Candidates must regularly visit www.ossc.gov.in to stay updated on the Main Exam date, admit card release, and any further notifications.
  • The shortlist has been prepared based solely on candidates' performance in the Preliminary Examination held on 10 May 2026.
  • In the Art Education Instructor category, due to non-availability of SC Women candidates, 2 SC Male candidates have been adjusted against the SC(W) quota.

India Exim Bank MT Result 2026 - Management Trainee Merit List Released for Personal Interview

India Exim Bank Management Trainee Result 2026 has been officially released on 11 June 2026. The Export-Import Bank of India (Exim Bank) has published the shortlist of candidates under Advertisement No. HRM/MT/2025-26/05 for the Direct Recruitment Drive for Management Trainees. Candidates whose registration numbers appear in the merit list are invited to appear for a personal interview tentatively scheduled between June 29 and July 2, 2026. Read on for the complete list of shortlisted registration numbers, document requirements, submission deadlines, and interview schedule.

What Is the India Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2025-26?

The India Exim Bank Management Trainee recruitment drive is a direct recruitment initiative by the Export-Import Bank of India to select talented graduates for its Management Trainee programme. Understanding the context of this recruitment helps candidates gauge the importance and prestige of this opportunity.

India Exim Bank, a premier financial institution under the Government of India, conducts this recruitment under its Human Resource Management Group (HRMG). The current drive is governed by Advertisement No. HRM/MT/2025-26/05. Candidates who have successfully cleared the initial screening stage are now shortlisted for a personal interview, which is the next decisive stage of the selection process.

India Exim Bank MT Result 2026 - Document Submission Process

Shortlisted candidates must submit self-attested copies of their documents before the deadline to be eligible for the personal interview. This section covers everything you need to know about what to send, where to send it, and by when.

Where to Send Documents

Shortlisted candidates are required to email self-attested document copies to the official recruitment email address: [email protected]

Email Subject Line

The subject line of the email must be written exactly as follows:

"Recruitment of Management Trainees, Registration No. [Your Registration Number]"

Document Submission Deadline

All documents must be submitted on or before June 15, 2026. Candidates are strongly advised not to wait until the last day to avoid technical or network issues.

List of Required Documents

The following documents must be included in the email submission as self-attested copies:

  • Mark sheets and Degree Certificate of Class X (10th), Class XII (12th), Graduation, and the qualifying examination as specified in the advertisement
  • Valid Photo Identity Proof - any one of: Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, or Voter ID
  • Caste Certificate / EWS Certificate / Disability Certificate (if applicable), in the prescribed Central Government format
  • Experience Certificate (if applicable)

India Exim Bank MT Personal Interview 2026 - Schedule & What to Expect

The personal interview is the final stage of the India Exim Bank Management Trainee selection process. Here are the important details regarding the interview schedule and eligibility to attend.

Tentative Interview Dates

The personal interviews are tentatively scheduled to be held from June 29 to July 2, 2026. Candidates should keep these dates free and monitor official communications for the exact schedule and venue details.

Interview Eligibility Condition

Shortlisted candidates will only be allowed to attend the personal interview after successful verification of submitted documents as per the eligibility criteria outlined in Advertisement No. HRM/MT/2025-26/05. Candidates whose documents are not verified or found to be ineligible will not be permitted to sit for the interview.

How to Check Your Name in India Exim Bank MT Merit List 2026

Checking whether your registration number is on the India Exim Bank MT shortlist is simple. Follow the steps below to confirm your selection status quickly and accurately.

  1. Visit the official India Exim Bank website or check the official notification PDF (Advertisement No. HRM/MT/2025-26/05).
  2. Open the merit list published by the Human Resource Management Group, dated 11 June 2026.
  3. Locate your 9-digit registration number (starting with 759) in the shortlisted candidates' table.
  4. If your registration number appears in the list, you are shortlisted for the personal interview.
  5. Proceed to email your self-attested documents to [email protected] before June 15, 2026.

RRC WR Ratlam Apprentice 2nd Merit List 2026 Out - 276 Candidates Selected for Document Verification on 22-24 June

The RRC WR Ratlam Apprentice 2nd Merit List 2026 has been officially released by the Western Railway, Ratlam Division under Notification No. RRC/WR/04/2025. A total of 276 candidates across 12 ITI trades have been shortlisted for Document Verification (DV), which will be held on 22, 23, and 24 June 2026 at the DRM Office, Ratlam (Establishment Department - EM Section), Second Floor, Near Do Batti, Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh - 457001. This recruitment is being conducted under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961. Candidates whose names appear in the 2nd Merit List have also been notified via email. Physical presence at the DV venue on the allotted date is mandatory — no proxy or rescheduling requests will be entertained.

  • Candidates must be physically present at the DV venue on their allotted date. Proxy attendance or absence will result in immediate cancellation of candidature.
  • No request for change of DV date, time, or centre will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Any mismatch in name, father's name, date of birth, or marks across documents will lead to candidature cancellation.
  • After DV, posts will be allotted to selected candidates strictly as per merit order.
  • Waiting List candidates will only be called when a merit-list selected candidate is absent or voluntarily withdraws.
  • All travel and accommodation expenses are to be borne by the candidate. No TA/DA will be paid by Western Railway.
  • Candidates should plan for a 1-2 day stay at Ratlam, as DV proceedings may extend beyond the single day.
  • Violation of any instructions will result in immediate disqualification from the process.

About This Recruitment - RRC/WR/04/2025

This apprentice recruitment is being conducted by Western Railway's Ratlam Division under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961. The 2nd Merit List follows the earlier 1st Merit List released in May 2026. Candidates shortlisted in this list are either those who were on the waitlist or those being considered for remaining vacant positions. Once the Document Verification is completed and documents are found to be in order, selected candidates will be enrolled as Act Apprentices under the Ratlam Division of Western Railway for the prescribed training period.

UPSC CAPF AC 2024 Reserve List Out - 55 Candidates Recommended for Assistant Commandant Posts

The UPSC CAPF AC 2024 Reserve List has been officially released by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) on 12 June 2026 through an official press note. In response to a requisition placed by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), UPSC has recommended 55 candidates from the revised reserve list to fill the remaining posts of Assistant Commandants based on the Central Armed Police Forces (ACs) Examination, 2024. Additionally, 4 candidates have been separately added to the merit list in compliance with the judgment dated 10 December 2025 passed by the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in WP(C) No. 8304/2025. The full list of 55 recommended candidates is available on the UPSC official website at upsc.gov.in.

UPSC CAPF AC 2024 Reserve List Notification PDF

Background - CAPF AC 2024 Original Result and Reserve List

To understand the significance of this reserve list release, it helps to know the sequence of events since the original CAPF AC 2024 result was declared. The original result was published via a press note on 13 June 2025, recommending 459 candidates in the order of merit for appointment as Assistant Commandants.

In accordance with Rule 16(4) and (5) of the Central Armed Police Forces (ACs) Examination, 2024 Rules, UPSC also maintained a Reserve List in merit order below the last recommended candidate. This reserve list was originally drawn up with 112 candidates (56 General, 12 EWS, 37 OBC, 3 SC, 4 ST). However, following a change in the category of one OBC candidate to General, the consolidated reserve list was subsequently revised downward to 110 candidates (55 General, 12 EWS, 36 OBC, 3 SC, 4 ST).

4 Additional Candidates Added via Delhi High Court Order

Over and above the original 459 candidates, UPSC has now recommended 4 more candidates for appointment to the post of Assistant Commandant. This addition is in direct compliance with the judgment dated 10 December 2025 of the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi in WP(C) No. 8304/2025 and connected matters. RRB ALP Selection Process 2025-26

  1. CBT 1 (Computer-Based Test - Stage 1): Qualifying in nature; screens candidates for CBT 2. Result declared on 12 June 2026.

What Happens After Provisional Selection? Next Steps for Candidates

Understanding what comes after appearing in the OSSC ATO provisional selection list is critical. Here is a step-by-step breakdown of the appointment process as outlined in the official notification.

  • Provisional selection is not a guarantee of appointment. Inclusion of a candidate's name in this list does not confer any right to appointment unless a specific appointment letter is issued by the concerned Appointing Authority.
  • Document Verification is mandatory. Appointment orders will be issued only after verification of original certificates relating to age, educational qualification, caste, category, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Bio-Data-Cum-Attestation Form required. The Appointing Authority (Director of Technical Education & Training, Odisha, Cuttack) has been requested to collect the Bio-Data-Cum-Attestation Form along with the Online Application Forms of the 11 newly selected candidates from the OSSC office.
  • SEBC candidates: Appointment orders for candidates selected under the SEBC category will be issued only after verification of their Caste Certificate from the Competent Authority.
  • A copy of the appointment orders issued must be communicated back to OSSC for the record.

The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission released the OSSSC RI ARI Mains Result 2026 on 11th June 2026. OSSSC Provisional Screening List for Practical Skill Test 2026

This section explains what the Provisional Screening List means and what shortlisted candidates need to do next.

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the Provisional Screening List must prepare for the Practical Skill Test. It is important to note that this list is provisional and subject to verification.

OSSSC CRE-2023(IV) Selection Process

Understanding the complete selection process helps candidates plan their preparation for the remaining stages. Here is the step-by-step selection procedure for OSSSC CRE-2023(IV):

The selection process includes the Mains Examination (180 marks: Math, GS, English, Odia, Computer Awareness), followed by the Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills, and then Document Verification. 

Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination

The OSSSC prelims result for Revenue Inspector (RI), Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI), Amin, and related posts under CRE-2023(IV) was released on February 16, 2026, as a PDF merit list on osssc.gov.in.

Stage 2 - Main Examination

The Mains Examination was conducted in CBRE (Computer-Based Recruitment Examination) mode. The Main Examination for the posts of RI, ICDS Supervisor, ARI, Amin & SFS under CRE-2023(IV) was held on 26th April 2026. The result for this stage has now been released on 11th June 2026. 

Stage 3 - Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills

The selection process for the OSSSC CRE exam includes the Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills, with qualifying marks set at 40%. Candidates must secure at least 40% in this stage to advance further.

Stage 4 - Document Verification

Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification by the District Level Board, followed by counselling for choice of post and Department/District/Range, with allotment based on merit-cum-choice and availability.

OSSSC CRE-2023(IV) - Merit List Details

The OSSSC Mains Merit List and Provisional Screening List have both been published together. Candidates should check the following:

The commission prepares a Provisional Master Merit List based on marks/normalized score in the Written Test, a Provisional Screening List for the Practical Skill Test, a Provisional Merit List of the Practical Skill Test, a Screening List for Document Verification, and Provisional Select Lists post-wise/district-wise.

  1. Visit the official website of your respective regional RRB (e.g., rrbcdg.gov.in, rrbchennai.gov.in, etc.).
  2. Look for the link labelled "RRB NTPC Graduate Result / CEN 06/2025" on the homepage.
  3. Click the relevant link to open or download the result PDF.
  4. Use Ctrl + F to search for your registration number within the PDF.

To Download the RRB NTPC Scorecard 2026 (Login Required - Active from 12 June, 5 PM):

  1. Go to the official candidate login portal at rrb.digialm.com.
  2. Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Click on the scorecard/result link to view your marks and qualifying status.
  4. Download and save the scorecard for future reference.

RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 - What Details Does It Contain?

The individual scorecard provides a comprehensive performance summary for each candidate. Understanding the scorecard helps candidates assess their standing and plan their CBT 2 preparation accordingly.

The RRB NTPC CBT 1 Scorecard 2026 includes the following details:

  • Candidate's Name and Roll Number
  • Registration Number and Date of Birth
  • Category (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS)
  • Post Applied For and Exam Name
  • Raw Marks Obtained
  • Normalized Marks
  • Section-wise Scores
  • Qualifying Status for CBT 2
  • Category-wise Cut-Off Marks

RRB NTPC Graduate CBT 1 Cut-Off Marks 2026

The RRB NTPC CBT 1 Cut-Off Marks 2026 have been released alongside the result for all zones. The cut-off varies by RRB region and candidate category. Several factors determine the final cut-off, including the total number of vacancies notified, the difficulty level of the examination, the number of candidates who appeared, and the reservation policy applicable.

Key factors influencing the RRB NTPC CBT 1 Cut-Off 2026:

  • Number of vacancies per post and zone
  • Total number of applicants per category
  • Difficulty level of the CBT 1 exam
  • Normalization of marks across different shifts

Candidates should check the cut-off PDF published on their respective RRB regional website for the exact category-wise qualifying marks applicable to their zone.

RRB NTPC CBT 1 Shortlisting Process - How Candidates Were Selected

The shortlisting for CBT 2 has been done strictly on the basis of merit in CBT 1, while also considering each candidate's order of preference for various posts. Candidates should be aware of the following key rules governing provisional shortlisting:

  • Candidates shortlisted under reserved categories — OBC (NCL), SC, ST, EWS, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen (ExSM) — will continue to be considered only under those respective categories in all subsequent stages of the recruitment process.
  • Roll numbers in the shortlist PDF are arranged horizontally in ascending order, not in order of merit.
  • All shortlistings are purely provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if any inconsistency, data deficiency, or malpractice is detected.
  • Being shortlisted for CBT 2 does not guarantee a Railway appointment in any manner.

What Next After RRB NTPC CBT 1 Result 2026?

Candidates who have cleared CBT 1 must now focus on preparing for the next stage of the selection process. Here is a complete overview of the selection pipeline after the CBT 1 result.

RRB NTPC Complete Selection Process:

CBT 1 → CBT 2 → CBAT / CBTST (post-specific) → Document Verification (DV) → Medical Examination → Final Merit List & Allotment

RRB NTPC CBT 2 2026 - Key Dates and Details

Detail Information
CBT 2 Tentative Date 2nd Week of July 2026
Exam City Intimation Approx. 10 days before CBT 2 (via website, SMS, Email)
E-Call Letter / Admit Card 4 days before the exam date
Basis of Shortlisting for DV CBT 2 performance + CBAT/CBTST scores (where applicable)

Candidates are advised to start preparing for CBT 2 immediately. The syllabus for CBT 2 is post-specific and covers General Awareness, Mathematics, General Intelligence, and Reasoning at a higher difficulty level than CBT 1.

Candidates whose roll numbers appear in the merit list must go through a structured post-result process before receiving a final appointment as a Primary Teacher. Here is a step-by-step guide to what happens next.

Step 1 - Pre-Document Verification (Pre-DV) Scrutiny Form

Shortlisted candidates will first be required to submit a Pre-DV Scrutiny Form online. This step is mandatory before being called for document verification.

Step 2 - Document Verification (DV)

Candidates are called to a designated centre to verify their original documents. The following documents are typically required:

  • REET Mains Admit Card and filled Application Form
  • Marksheets and certificates for Class 10, Class 12, Graduation, and B.Ed./D.El.Ed.
  • REET Eligibility Certificate
  • Caste/Category and Domicile (Mool Niwas) Certificates
  • Character Certificate and Income Proof
  • Passport-size photographs and a valid Government-issued photo ID

Step 3 - Final Merit List and District Allocation

After successful document verification, RSSB publishes the final merit list along with district and school allocation details based on candidate preference and merit rank.

Step 4 - School Allotment and Appointment Order

Candidates are issued an official posting order specifying their assigned school and joining date.

Step 5 - Probation Period

Finally, all selected Primary Teachers are placed on a 2-year probation period from the date of joining.

Candidates who have qualified for this stage can download their hall tickets from the official APSSB portal starting 22 June 2026 at 11:00 AM. The download window closes on 28 June 2026 at 03:00 PM. When Will the APSSB CGLE 2026 Steno Admit Card Be Available?

Candidates eagerly waiting for the APSSB CGLE Stenography hall ticket should note the exact download window so they do not miss accessing this critical document before the portal closes.

As per the official notification issued by Dr. Rubu Tabiyo (APCS), Under Secretary, APSSB, the Admit Cards for the Stenography Proficiency Test of CGLE 2026 will be available for APSSB portal from 22 June 2026 at 11:00 AM until 28 June 2026 at 03:00 PM. Candidates are strongly advised to download the admit card as soon as it becomes available to avoid any last-minute technical difficulties.

How to Download APSSB CGLE 2026 Stenography Proficiency Test Admit Card

Downloading the APSSB CGLE 2026 Steno Admit Card is a straightforward process through the official APSSB portal. Follow the steps below to retrieve your hall ticket quickly and without confusion.

  1. Visit the official APSSB website at www.apssb.nic.in.
  2. Log in to the candidate portal using your registered credentials (application number, date of birth, or password, as applicable).
  3. Locate the link for the CGLE 2026 Stenography Proficiency Test Admit Card on the dashboard or the notices section.
  4. Click on the download link and verify your personal details on the admit card.
  5. Save a digital copy and take a printout (hard copy) immediately.

Note: Candidates must carry a printed copy of the Admit Card to the exam venue. No entry will be permitted without it.

Official Website to Download APSSB Admit Card 2026

All admit card-related activities, including download and complaint submission, must be done exclusively through the official APSSB portal to ensure the security and accuracy of information.

The official portal for downloading the APSSB CGLE 2026 Stenography Admit Card is: www.apssb.nic.in. Candidates should avoid third-party websites or unofficial links, as these may contain inaccurate or misleading information. Always use your personal login credentials on the official site.

How to Report Issues or Complaints Related to the Admit Card

If a candidate encounters any discrepancy or problem with the admit card — such as incorrect personal details, photograph, or other errors — the APSSB has provided a dedicated window to report such issues before it is too late.

Any issues or complaints related to the APSSB CGLE 2026 Stenography Admit Card must be reported by 04:00 PM on 26 June 2026. Complaints submitted after this deadline are unlikely to be entertained. Candidates are advised to check all details on the admit card promptly after downloading it.

Common Admit Card Issues to Check For

  • Incorrect candidate name or date of birth
  • Wrong exam centre or venue address
  • Missing or blurry photograph
  • Invalid roll number or registration number
  • Incorrect exam date or shift timing

Important Instructions for Candidates - APSSB CGLE 2026 Steno Test

The APSSB has issued specific advisory notes along with the admit card announcement. Every candidate appearing for the Stenography Proficiency Test should carefully follow these instructions to avoid any inconvenience on the day of the examination.

  • Download early: Do not wait until the last day to download your admit card. Technical issues or high server traffic near the deadline could prevent access.
  • Save a hard copy: Print and retain a physical copy of the admit card well in advance of the exam date.
  • Verify details: Immediately after downloading, verify all personal and exam-related details mentioned on the hall ticket.
  • Report discrepancies promptly: If any error is found, report it to APSSB before the 26 June 2026 deadline at 04:00 PM.
  • Carry valid ID proof: Along with the admit card, bring an original government-issued photo ID to the exam venue.

About APSSB and the CGLE 2026 Examination

Understanding the role of APSSB and the significance of the CGLE 2026 provides context for candidates who are preparing for the Stenography Proficiency Test and subsequent recruitment stages.

The Arunachal Pradesh Staff Selection Board (APSSB), headquartered in the C-Sector, Itanagar, is the official government body responsible for conducting recruitment examinations for various posts in the Government of Arunachal Pradesh. The Combined Graduate Level Examination (CGLE) 2026 is a multi-stage selection process for graduate-level government positions. The Stenography Proficiency Test is a specialized assessment designed to evaluate candidates' shorthand and typing skills for stenographer-category posts.

Downloading the Special Assam TET 2026 hall ticket is a simple process. Follow these steps carefully to retrieve your admit card without any issues.

  1. Visit the official ASSEB / SEBA website at www.sebaonline.org or click the direct download link provided above.
  2. On the admit card login page, enter your Application Number (Username) in the first field.
  3. Enter your Password that you created while submitting the online application form.
  4. Click the login/submit button to access your hall ticket.
  5. Your Assam Special TET admit card 2026 will appear on the screen verify all printed details carefully.
  6. Download the admit card and take a clear colour printout. Keep at least two copies one for exam day and one as a backup.

  • Examination Centre Name and Address
  • Exam Duration and Instructions

Special Assam TET 2026 Exam Pattern

Understanding the exam structure helps candidates prepare effectively. Both papers contain 150 MCQs carrying 150 marks. The duration of each paper is 2 hours and 30 minutes. An additional 20 minutes per hour will be provided for visually impaired candidates. There is no negative marking. 

Paper I - Lower Primary (LP) Level (Class I to V)

Paper I is for candidates who wish to teach in Lower Primary schools (Classes 1 to 5) in Bodo, Garo, Manipuri, or Hmar medium schools.

Subject No. of Questions Marks

Language I (Bodo / Garo / Manipuri / Hmar) 30 30
Language II (English) 30 30
Mathematics 30 30

Paper II - Upper Primary (UP) Level (Class VI to VIII)

Paper II is for candidates who wish to teach in Upper Primary schools (Classes 6 to 8). Candidates must choose between the Mathematics & Science stream OR the Social Science stream.

Subject No. of Questions Marks
Child Development & Pedagogy 30 30
Language I (Bodo / Garo / Manipuri / Hmar) 30 30

Mathematics & Science OR Social Science 60 60

A candidate is required to score 60% marks to clear the Special Assam TET 2026. Separate cut-off criteria may apply for Language-I section. The TET certificate carries lifetime validity once awarded.

Allowed Items Inside the Exam Hall

  • Transparent water bottle (without label)

Mobile phones and all electronic devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall, even in switched-off mode. The following are banned: 

  • Mobile phones, smart watches, digital watches, health bands
  • Bluetooth devices, earphones, microphones, electronic pens
  • Calculators, pen drives, scanning devices, bits of paper

JKPSC CCE Mains 2025 - Exam Pattern

Understanding the exam pattern is essential before appearing for the Mains examination. The JKPSC CCE Mains consists of descriptive/written papers spread across multiple subjects, as outlined below.

Paper Subject Nature

Paper II Essay Counted in merit

Paper VII Optional Subject - Paper I Counted in merit
Paper VIII Optional Subject - Paper II Counted in merit

All papers except the qualifying English paper are descriptive in format. Candidates must write structured, well-argued answers. The final merit is based on the combined scores from the Essay, General Studies, and Optional Subject papers, along with the Personality Test.

Eligibility Conditions for JKPSC CCE Mains 2026

Admission to the Mains examination is provisional and subject to document verification at any stage of the recruitment process. Candidates must satisfy all the eligibility conditions outlined below.

  • Domicile: Must be a domicile of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.
  • Qualification: Must have cleared the J&K Combined Competitive Preliminary Examination 2025 and must satisfy all conditions under Notification No. 03-PSC (DR-P) of 2026 dated 13.02.2026.
  • Educational Qualification: A Bachelor's Degree in any subject from a recognised Indian university, or an equivalent foreign degree approved by the Government.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 21 years; Maximum 32 years (relaxation applicable for reserved categories and in-service candidates as per government norms).
  • In-Service Candidates: Must have completed at least 2 years of substantive service as of 01-01-2025 to claim upper-age relaxation.

Warning: Any candidate found to have submitted false information or concealed relevant facts will face immediate disqualification at any stage of the JKPSC CCE selection process, including after appointment.

JKPSC CCE Selection Process 2025-26

The JKPSC Combined Competitive Examination follows a three-stage selection process. Each stage is eliminatory, meaning only those who clear one stage are eligible to proceed to the next.

  1. Stage 1 - Preliminary Examination: Objective-type screening test consisting of two papers. Results used only for shortlisting; marks are not counted in the final merit. The JKPSC CCE Prelims 2025 was held on 7 December 2025.
  2. Stage 2 - Mains Examination: Descriptive written examination consisting of 8 papers (1 qualifying + 7 merit papers). Scheduled from 23 June to 1 July 2026. Carries the highest weightage in the final selection.
  3. Stage 3 - Personality Test / Interview: Final stage for candidates who clear the Mains. Assesses overall suitability for administrative service roles. Combined scores from Mains and the Personality Test determine the final merit list.

Posts Covered Under JKPSC CCE 2025 Recruitment

The JKPSC CCE 2025 recruitment is being conducted to fill 80 vacancies across three prestigious services in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. Candidates selected through this process will be placed in senior administrative, police, and accounts roles.

The pay scale for posts under JKPSC CCE falls in the range of ₹47,600 - ₹1,51,100 as per applicable pay matrix levels. Reserved category vacancies are distributed among SC, ST, OBC, and other eligible categories as per J&K government reservation norms.

  • Candidates must appear in both papers wherever two sessions are scheduled on the same day.
  • Mobile phones, electronic gadgets, and unauthorised materials are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall.
  • Read all instructions printed on the admit card carefully before the exam date.
  • Admission to the exam is purely provisional, subject to verification of documents at the time of joining.

Many candidates confuse city intimation slip with admit card. Here's a clear comparison to understand the differences:

Aspect City Intimation Slip Admit Card / Hall Ticket
Purpose Advance information only for travel planning Mandatory entry document for examination
Release Time 7-10 days before exam date 2-3 days before exam date
Information Provided Exam city, date, shift timing only Complete center address, roll number, photo, signature
Can you enter exam hall? ❌ NO - Not permitted ✅ YES - Mandatory requirement
Contains Photo ❌ No ✅ Yes
Contains Roll Number ❌ No ✅ Yes
Exam Center Address Only city name Complete address with venue details
Use for Travel Booking ✅ Yes - Use for advance planning Can use after release
Barcode/QR Code Usually not present Present for verification
Exam Instructions General instructions Detailed exam day instructions

Critical Warning: You CANNOT enter the examination hall with only the city intimation slip. You MUST download and carry the admit card (available from 15th January 2026) along with a valid photo ID proof to appear for the exam.

Download your SSC CGL Tier 2 City Intimation Slip 2026 immediately from ssc.gov.in and start planning your travel! All the best for your exam!

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi has released the Detailed Recruitment Advertisement for Common Recruitment Examination-5 (CRE-5) on 11 June 2026. The examination invites applications from eligible Indian nationals for a wide range of Non-Faculty Group-B and Group-C posts spread across 28 participating AIIMS and Central Government Institutes/Bodies. The last date to apply online is 30 June 2026 (up to 5:00 PM) at www.aiimsexams.ac.in. The Computer Based Test (CBT) is tentatively scheduled for 25 to 27 July 2026.

About CRE-5: What Is It and Who Is It For?

CRE-5 is a unified, single-window recruitment platform that allows eligible candidates to apply once and be considered for similar posts across multiple participating institutes. The Examination Section, AIIMS New Delhi acts solely as the examination-conducting body; recruitment rules, service conditions, and final appointment decisions rest entirely with each participating institute independently.

Participating organizations are autonomous bodies or subordinate offices under the Government of India, functioning independently from AIIMS New Delhi. Candidates are advised to check each institute's individual recruitment rules and eligibility criteria before applying, as conditions may differ for the same post name across different institutes.

Participating Institutes (28 Total)

AIIMS Awantipora, AIIMS Bathinda, AIIMS Bhopal, AIIMS Bibinagar, AIIMS Bilaspur, AIIMS Deoghar, AIIMS Gorakhpur, AIIMS Guwahati, AIIMS Kalyani, AIIMS Mangalagiri, AIIMS Madurai, AIIMS Nagpur, AIIMS New Delhi, AIIMS Patna, AIIMS Raebareli, AIIMS Raipur, AIIMS Rajkot, AIIMS Rewari, AIIMS Rishikesh, AIIMS Vijaypur, AIIMS-CAPFIMS (New Delhi), Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences & Dr. RML Hospital, Chittaranjan National Cancer Institute (CNCI) Kolkata, Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), Lady Hardinge Medical College & associated Sucheta Kriplani Hospital and Kalawati Saran Children's Hospital, Pasteur Institute of India, Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC) Najafgarh, and Regional Institute of Paramedical and Nursing Sciences (RIPANS) Aizawl.

AIIMS CRE-5 Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is charged per group applied. Candidates applying to multiple groups must pay separately for each group.

Category Fee

Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) Exempted

Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, or Net Banking. The examination fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, even if the application is rejected for ineligibility. However, application fees paid by SC/ST candidates who appear in the examination will be refunded to the source account after declaration of results.

AIIMS CRE-5 Recruitment 2026 - Exam Pattern and Syllabus

The CRE-5 Computer Based Test is a structured, time-bound examination designed to assess both domain knowledge and general aptitude.

CBT Structure

Parameter Detail
Duration 90 minutes
Total Questions 100 MCQs
Total Marks 400 marks (4 marks per question)
Negative Marking –1 mark per wrong answer (1/4th deduction)
General Knowledge & Aptitude / Computer 20 MCQs
Domain-Specific Questions 80 MCQs
Sections 5 sections × 20 questions × 18 minutes each

Each section is sequential and time-locked - once a section closes, candidates cannot return to it. Candidates must attempt all possible questions within the active section's time window.

Medium of Examination

Posts where the essential qualification is 10th/12th will be examined in bilingual (English and Hindi) medium. Posts requiring bachelor's or higher qualifications, or posts involving specific technical domain knowledge, will be examined in English only.

Qualifying Marks

Category Qualifying Percentage
UR / EWS 40%
OBC 35%
SC / ST 30%
PwBD (all categories) 30%
Ex-Servicemen As per their category

Tie-Breaking Rules

In case of equal marks, ties are resolved in this order: (i) higher marks in the domain-specific section; (ii) fewer wrong answers/negative marks; (iii) older date of birth; (iv) alphabetical order of name, then father's name, then mother's name.

Syllabus (Domain Part - Selected Groups)

Group Domain Syllabus
1 Food & Nutrition, Diets
2 General Administration, CCS Rules, FR/SR, Basic Computer
3 General Maths & English
4 Civil Engineering
5 Electrical Engineering
12 Pharmacy

34 Nursing

53 General Maths, English, Fire Safety and Security

Full syllabus details for all 57 groups are in Section IX of the official DRA.

Skill Test

For selected post groups, a Skill Test is conducted as Stage II for candidates who qualify the CBT. The skill test is qualifying in nature. The final merit list is prepared based on CBT performance, but only among those who pass the skill test for the relevant post.

Posts requiring skill tests include groups such as Junior Administrative Assistant (typing test), Stenographer (stenography test), Programmer (computer skill test), Hindi Translator (translation test), Assistant Security Officer (PST), and Fire Technician (PET & PST). See Annexure-V of the DRA for complete scheme details.

If a candidate qualifies the CBT but fails the skill test, they remain eligible only for posts within the same group that do not require a skill test.

AIIMS CRE-5 Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

CRE-5 follows a multi-stage recruitment process. Each stage is mandatory for progression to the next.

Stage 1 - Online Application: Candidates register on www.aiimsexams.ac.in and submit applications by 30 June 2026.

Stage 2 - Application Acceptance: Application status published on 9 July 2026.

Stage 3 - Computer Based Test (CBT): Tentatively 25–27 July 2026 at examination centres across major states/UTs of India.

Stage 4 - Skill Test (where applicable): Conducted after CBT for qualifying candidates in applicable groups. Venue: preferably Delhi/NCR. Date to be notified.

Stage 5 - Choice & Preference: Qualified candidates are invited to exercise institute choices and indicate order of preference. Candidates who fail to exercise choices within the given period will not be considered for any institute.

Stage 6 - Seat Allocation: Allocation is made in order of merit based on choices exercised and eligibility at each participating institute.

Stage 7 - Document Verification: Original certificates verified by the respective AIIMS/Institute on the date notified by them.

Stage 8 - Joining: Selected candidates must report on the date specified in the result/allocation notice. Failure to report will lead to mandatory cancellation of candidature for CRE.

AIIMS CRE-5 Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Pay Scale

In addition to basic pay, posts carry allowances (HRA, DA, TA, etc.) as per the rules applicable at each respective institute.

AIIMS CRE-5 Recruitment 2026 - How to Apply for AIIMS CRE-5 2026

Applications can only be submitted through the Online Registration Terminal (OTR) at www.aiimsexams.ac.in. Physical documents must not be sent; no correspondence regarding correction in registration will be entertained.

  10. Check your application status on 9 July 2026 at www.aiimsexams.ac.in.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy all eligibility conditions as on the cut-off date, i.e. 01-06-2026. Candidature is provisional and subject to verification of original documents before joining.

Educational Qualification As prescribed discipline-wise; obtained through Full-time Regular course only. Qualifications via Part-time/Correspondence/Distance Learning are not eligible.
Qualification Passing Date Candidate should not have passed Graduation/Diploma/ITI prior to June 2022.
Prior Apprenticeship / Experience Candidates who have undergone Apprenticeship earlier, are currently pursuing Apprenticeship Training, or have 1 year or more of job experience are summarily ineligible.
Higher Qualification Candidates possessing higher qualification over and above the prescribed qualification are not eligible.
OBC Status Only OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Age Limit

Age is calculated as on the cut-off date 01-06-2026. Candidates must have been born on or between 01-06-2000 and 01-06-2008 (i.e. minimum 18 years and maximum 26 years). Standard age relaxations are applicable only for reserved category slots.

NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

Selection will be made purely on the basis of merit drawn from qualifying examination marks, followed by document scrutiny and a mandatory medical test. No written examination will be conducted by NCL for this recruitment.

Stage 1 – Merit List Preparation

For Graduate and Diploma positions, merit is drawn on the basis of marks scored in the qualifying Graduation/Diploma examination. For ITI Trade positions, merit is based on the average of passing percentage in Matriculation and the respective National/State Trade Certificate. Candidates are arranged in descending order of marks. In case of a tie, date of birth (older candidate preferred) and then alphabetical order of name will be applied.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny

Shortlisted candidates based on merit will be called to appear with all original certificates for scrutiny. Date and venue will be notified on nclcil.in and through NATS/NAPS portal or email. Failure to appear or produce valid documents within the stipulated date and time will result in cancellation of candidature.

Stage 3 – Medical Examination

Final offer for Apprenticeship Training is subject to clearing the Medical Test as per prescribed standards under the Mines Rules 1955. A fitness certificate from the medical officer of a Government Hospital (rank not less than Assistant Civil Surgeon) in the prescribed format (Annexure-3) must be produced. The Medical Fitness certificate must be issued after the date of release of this Notification.

Who should NOT apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have already undergone Apprenticeship Training earlier or are currently pursuing Apprenticeship in any industry.
  • Candidates with 1 year or more of job experience.
  • Candidates who have passed their qualifying degree/diploma/ITI before June 2022.
  • Candidates who possess qualifications higher than the prescribed qualification for the applied discipline.
  • Candidates whose qualifying institution is not functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Candidates whose qualifications were obtained through Part-time, Correspondence, or Distance Learning mode.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer.
  • Candidates who submit multiple applications - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Candidates who are unable to produce a valid Medical Fitness certificate as per Mines Rules 1955.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not pre-registering on the NATS portal (for Graduate/Diploma) or NAPS portal (for Trade/ITI) before applying - without a valid Enrolment ID, the application cannot be completed.
  • Applying for more than one discipline - multiple applications will lead to disqualification of candidature.
  • Entering incorrect percentage/marks scored or maximum marks in the online form - candidature will be cancelled if found incorrect during scrutiny.
  • Not checking that the qualifying institution is functional and operational in Uttar Pradesh or Madhya Pradesh.
  • Uploading blurred or unclear photograph or signature in black ink.
  • Not having an active email ID and mobile number valid for at least one year for future communication.
  • Rounding off the passing percentage - NCL will not consider rounding off (49.99% will be treated as less than 50%).
  • Not taking a printout of the finally submitted online application for future reference.

How to Apply for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27

Candidates must apply online only. Graduate and Diploma Apprentice candidates must first enrol on the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and Trade Apprentice candidates must enrol on the NAPS portal at https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. After successful registration, a registration number (Enrolment ID) will be generated, following which the candidate must apply for the NCL positions through the respective portal.

Documents/Details required at the time of Online Application:

  • Valid NATS/NAPS Enrolment ID (registration reference).
  • Scanned colour photograph and scanned signature in black ink (as per portal specifications).
  • Date of Birth as per Matriculation certificate.
  • Academic details - total marks scored and maximum marks in qualifying degree/diploma/ITI trade.
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in prescribed format (Annexure-1), if applicable.
  • PwBD disability certificate as per Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules 2017 (Annexure-2), if applicable.
  • Address for correspondence and permanent address.

Candidates must save and preserve a hard copy as well as soft copy of the finally submitted online application for future reference. No paper-based or postal applications will be accepted.

Apply Online (Graduate/Diploma) at: https://nats.education.gov.in

Apply Online (Trade/ITI) at: https://www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

For assistance, candidates may email the HRD Department, NCL at [email protected] or visit Menu > Career > Apprenticeship Training section on the NCL official website www.nclcil.in.

Important Instructions for NCL Apprentice Trainee Recruitment 2026-27 Candidates

  • Online applications are open from 01-06-2026 to 15-06-2026 through NATS/NAPS portals only.
  • A candidate may apply for any one notified position only - multiple applications will lead to disqualification.
  • Information pertaining to Date of Birth, Caste Category, and Qualification once entered in the online application shall be considered final - no alteration will be permitted at later stages.
  • Stipend for Graduate and Diploma Apprentices is inclusive of the Government of India share paid through DBT; Trade Apprentice stipend will be paid directly by NCL.
  • Stipend will be paid directly into the AADHAAR-linked bank account of the Apprenticeship Trainee as per the signed contract.
  • Apprenticeship Training is purely temporary and statutory in nature - it does not confer any right or claim for regular employment in NCL.
  • Apprentices are eligible for 11 days Casual Leave and 15 days Medical Leave per year of training.
  • Engagement hours are between 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
  • Apprentices will be covered under the Workmen Compensation Act, 1923 for any accident during training.
  • No accommodation, fooding/lodging, or transport will be provided during the training period.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in document scrutiny or post-scrutiny processes.
  • Canvassing in any manner at any stage will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Any dispute will be subject to courts/tribunals of Singrauli, MP only.
  • Dates mentioned in the notification are tentative and subject to alteration/amendment.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Central Bank of India (CBI) has officially released the Apprentice Recruitment 2026 notification for 4,500 training seats under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for the financial year 2026–27. This is one of the largest banking apprenticeship drives in India, offering graduates a paid one-year training opportunity across CBI's pan-India branch network of over 4,500 branches.

The online application window opened on June 12, 2026, and will close on June 22, 2026. Candidates must register on the NATS government portal and then complete their final application on the BFSI SSC portal. The online examination is tentatively scheduled for the first week of July 2026.

Download Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Quick Overview - Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Central Bank of India is recruiting 4,500 Apprentice posts with any Graduation qualification, last date 22 June 2026.

Important Dates for Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Knowing the key dates is critical for planning your application. All events from notification release to the online exam are listed here.

Important: The process is complete only when the application fee is paid online on or before the closing date. Incomplete applications are automatically rejected.

Eligibility Criteria for Central Bank of India Apprentice 2026

Before applying, candidates must confirm they meet all eligibility requirements as on the cut-off date of May 31, 2026.

Nationality

A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived in India before January 1, 1962 with the intention of permanently settling, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries with intent to permanently settle in India. Candidates under categories other than Indian citizen must possess an eligibility certificate issued by the Government of India.

Age Limit

  • Minimum Age: 20 years
  • Maximum Age: 28 years (for General/EWS candidates as on 31/05/2026)
  • Candidates must have been born not earlier than May 31, 1998 and not later than May 31, 2006 (both days inclusive).

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years

Widows/Divorced Women (General/EWS) Up to 35 years
Widows/Divorced Women (OBC) Up to 38 years
Widows/Divorced Women (SC/ST) Up to 40 years

Educational Qualification

Candidates must hold a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a university recognized by the Government of India. Graduation must have been completed on or after January 1, 2022. Mark sheets and provisional/degree certificates will be required at the time of verification.

NATS Registration Requirement

Candidates must be registered on the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in) to be eligible to apply. Registration on the government apprenticeship portal is a mandatory prerequisite.

Other Key Eligibility Conditions

  • Candidates must not have previously undergone or be currently pursuing any apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in any organization, including Central Bank of India.
  • Candidates who have completed one year or more of training or job experience after attaining their educational qualification are not eligible.
  • No Ex-servicemen or Disabled Ex-Servicemen are eligible, and no reservation is provided for them.

How to Apply for Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process involves two portals. Here is a step-by-step guide:

Step 1 - Register on NATS Portal Visit https://nats.education.gov.in and navigate to the "Student Register/Login" section. Complete your registration and note your Enrolment ID, which is required for all future correspondence.

Step 2 - Find CBI Apprenticeship on NATS After logging in, visit https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php to find and apply to the Central Bank of India apprenticeship advertisement.

Step 3 - Complete Application on BEEP Portal After applying on NATS, you will receive an email from BFSI SSC ([email protected]) with a link to register on https://beep.bfsissc.com. Complete your final application here by entering caste category, district preferences, and other details.

Step 4 - Pay the Application Fee Pay the applicable fee online through the BEEP portal. The application is complete only after successful payment.

Step 5 - Save Your Application Take a printout of the system-generated online application form after submitting. Do not make multiple submissions; only the last valid completed application will be retained.

Selection Process for Central Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Selection involves multiple stages. Candidates must clear all stages to be engaged as apprentices.

Stage 1 - Online Written Examination

The exam is objective type, conducted by BFSI SSC. It will be taken from the candidate's own home on their own device - no admit card or examination centre is required.

Subject Questions Marks Duration
General / Financial Awareness 20 20 -
Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 20 20 -
Computer Knowledge 20 20 -
General English 20 20 -
Central Bank of India Products & Services 20 20 -
Total 100 100 60 minutes
  • Medium: English/Hindi (General English section in English only)
  • No negative marking for wrong answers
  • Tie-breaking rule: if two candidates score equally, the older candidate ranks higher (descending order of age)
  • Details on CBI Products & Services will be shared on the bank's official website in due course

Stage 2 - Test of Local Language

Candidates must be proficient (reading, writing, speaking, and understanding) in the specified official language of the state they apply for. This test is conducted after qualifying the online exam at a centre decided by the bank, at the candidate's own expense.

Candidates who have studied the specified local language at the 10th or 12th standard level (as evidenced by mark sheets) are exempt from the language test.

Stage 3 - Document Verification

Qualified candidates are called to the relevant CBI Regional/Zonal Office for verification of all original documents, including date of birth proof, graduation certificates, category certificates, and any other relevant documents.

Stage 4 - Medical Fitness Verification

Final engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a qualified medical practitioner or MBBS doctor, as per the bank's requirements.

Stipend, Training Conditions, and Benefits

Understanding what to expect during the apprenticeship helps candidates plan ahead.

  • Monthly Stipend: ₹15,000 per month for the 12-month training period
  • No other allowances or employee benefits are provided
  • Leave: One casual leave per month; public/bank holidays as applicable; no other leave types
  • Working hours: Same as clerical staff of the bank; no overtime is permitted
  • No hostel, transport, or residential accommodation is provided by the bank
  • An assessment test may be conducted after completion, followed by certification as per prevailing guidelines
  • Apprentices are trainees, not employees - no labour laws or employee benefits apply
  • Apprentices cannot form or join any union

Contract of Apprenticeship

Candidates selected after document verification will receive a digital apprenticeship contract through the NATS government portal (https://nats.education.gov.in). They must accept the contract within the stipulated timeframe. No candidate can begin training without an approved apprenticeship contract.

Termination Conditions

The contract may be terminated in the following situations:

  • Non-reporting on the date of commencement of On-Job Training
  • Automatic termination on expiry of the 12-month training period
  • Mutual application to the Apprenticeship Advisor (BFSI SSC) before completion, with stated reasons
  • Misconduct by the apprentice, with written notice from the bank
  • If the Apprenticeship Advisor finds either party has failed to fulfil the contract terms

Documents Required at the Time of Document Verification

Candidates must carry originals plus self-attested photocopies of all the following:

  • System-generated printout of online application/NATS enrolment form
  • Date of Birth proof (Birth Certificate or Class X certificate with DOB)
  • Photo identity proof
  • Individual semester/year-wise mark sheets and final degree certificate
  • Caste certificate (for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates) in the Government of India prescribed format
  • OBC certificate must explicitly contain the non-creamy layer clause and be valid as on the date of the Language Test (issued within one year)
  • Disability certificate from District Medical Board (for PwBD candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates) issued by competent authority

Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)

Under Section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, reservation for PwBD is on a horizontal basis within the overall vacancies for each state. The qualifying disability categories include:

  • Visual Impairment (Blindness and Low Vision)
  • Hearing Impairment (Deaf and Hard of Hearing)
  • Orthopedic/Locomotor Disability (OA, OL, BL, OAL)
  • Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims, Muscular Dystrophy
  • Intellectual Disability (Autism Spectrum Disorder, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness)
  • Multiple Disabilities

A total of 45 seats each are reserved for VI, HI, OH, and ID categories, amounting to 180 PwBD seats across the country.

Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) Eligibility

Candidates not covered under SC/ST/OBC reservation and whose family gross annual income is below ₹8 lakh from all sources (salary, agriculture, business, profession) qualify for EWS reservation. Additionally, the family must not own:

  • 5 acres or more of agricultural land
  • A residential flat of 1,000 sq. ft. or more
  • A residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities
  • A residential plot of 200 sq. yards or more outside notified municipalities

The EWS benefit requires an Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed Government of India format, issued by a competent authority.

  • BFSI SSC portal: https://bfsissc.com
  • BEEP portal: https://beep.bfsissc.com (under "My Applied Opportunities")

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released Advertisement No. 06/2026 inviting Online Recruitment Applications for 538 posts across more than 30 central government ministries and departments. UPSC Recruitment 2026 - Age Relaxation

The standard age relaxations applicable to these posts are as follows. SC candidates receive 5 additional years, OBC candidates receive 3 additional years, and all PwBD candidates receive 10 additional years over and above their category relaxation. For certain posts with a base upper limit of 50 years, the PwBD maximum is capped at 56 years - this applies to the Regional Director (NCONF), Professor Sugar Engineering (NSI), Principal (A&N), and Consultant Ophthalmologist (UT Ladakh). UPSC may relax qualifications and experience at its discretion in writing for candidates otherwise well qualified.

Grade Point to Percentage Conversion (CME Pune and UT Ladakh posts)

Where a grade point system is in use and no conversion formula has been notified by the institution, the following equivalences apply as stated in the notification:

CGPA Equivalent Percentage
6.25 55%
6.75 60%
7.25 65%
7.75 70%
8.25 75%

For UT Ladakh Lecturer and Engineering posts, ST candidates receive a 5% relaxation at Bachelor's and Master's level, making 55% (or equivalent grade) the minimum eligibility.

Special Condition - UT Ladakh Posts (Posts 60-70)

All posts under the Administration of the Union Territory of Ladakh are exclusively open to Domiciles of UT Ladakh. A valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Tehsildar under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment Rules, 2025 (published in the Gazette of India on 03.06.2025) is mandatory. Two eligible categories exist: Category A (holders of or eligible for Ladakh Resident Certificate) and Category B (children of LRC holders or those eligible). Reservation is governed by the Jammu and Kashmir Reservation Act, 2004, as extended to UT Ladakh and amended by the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025 (No. 1 of 2025), and further by the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Rules, 2025 notified vide S.O. 77 dated 27.06.2025.

UPSC Recruitment 2026- How to Apply

The following steps reflect the application process described in the notification for UPSC's ORA portal.

  1. Visit the UPSC Online Recruitment Application portal at https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/.
  2. Register as a new user if you do not already have an account, or log in with your existing credentials.
  3. Select Advertisement No. 06/2026 from the list and choose the relevant post.
  4. Fill in all required personal, educational, and experience details accurately.
  5. Upload your photograph, signature, and required supporting documents.
  6. Submit the application and save the system-generated confirmation receipt with your registration number.

Troubleshooting and Common Mistakes

Candidates applying through the UPSC ORA portal can avoid common problems by following these general practices. Photograph and signature files must meet the portal's specified size and dimension requirements; uploading files that are too large or in an unsupported format is among the most frequent causes of incomplete applications. If a payment transaction fails, wait for the system to confirm the failure before attempting to pay again - making duplicate payments can cause complications that require manual resolution. Use an updated, stable browser on a desktop or laptop for the best experience; mobile browsers sometimes fail to render form fields correctly. Save your registration number and password immediately after registering, as the portal requires them for every subsequent login. Do not attempt to submit your application on the final day of the application window, as heavy traffic on the server is common and can cause timeouts or session errors.

U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru - the lead satellite technology centre of ISRO under the Department of Space, Government of India - has invited online applications for 17 posts of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vide Advertisement No. URSC:02:2026 dated 12 June 2026. The online application window is open from 12 June 2026 to 11 July 2026 at www.isro.gov.in under the "CAREERS" section. Only Indian nationals who have already passed their qualifying degree are eligible - candidates awaiting final results need not apply.

ISRO URSC JRF Recruitment 2026  - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for ISRO URSC JRF Recruitment 2026 is two-part: a qualifying postgraduate degree with the required minimum marks, and a valid national-level qualifying test score. Both conditions must be satisfied simultaneously as on the last date, i.e., 11 July 2026. Only passed candidates are eligible - students awaiting final results should not apply.

Educational Qualification

For positions JRF-E1 to JRF-E12, JRF-M1, JRF-M2, JRF-M3: M.E./M.Tech./M.Sc.(Engg.) or equivalent postgraduate degree in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 60% or CGPA/CPI of 6.5 on a 10-point scale.

For position JRF-E13 (M.Sc. route): M.Sc. in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 65% average of all semesters or CGPA/CPI of 6.84 on a 10-point scale.

For position JRF-E13 (M.Tech. route): M.Tech. or equivalent in First Class with an aggregate minimum of 60% or CGPA/CPI of 6.5 on a 10-point scale.

All degrees must be duly recognised by AICTE/UGC or any other organisation authorised by the Government of India. Essential qualifications must be completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university. Candidates who pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible to apply for JRF positions.

Where a university mentions both CGPA and percentage in its degree certificate or consolidated mark sheet, at least one criterion must meet DOS/ISRO eligibility norms. Conversion of CGPA into percentage of marks is not permitted to determine eligibility regardless of any conversion formula prescribed by the university. Rounding of percentage/CGPA is not allowed - values must be entered to the nearest 2 decimal places (e.g., 8.235 entered as 8.23; 8.236 as 8.24).

NET / NET-Equivalent Requirement

Candidates must have qualified one of the following national-level examinations. This is a mandatory requirement - possession of the degree alone does not make a candidate eligible to apply.

  • CSIR-UGC National Eligibility Test including NET-Lectureship (Assistant Professorship)
  • GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) conducted by MoE
  • JAM (Joint Admission Test) conducted by MoE
  • JEST (Joint Entrance Screening Test)
  • National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their agencies/institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER, etc.

Age Limit (as on 11 July 2026)

The maximum age for all JRF positions is 28 years as on 11 July 2026. Candidates wondering about age relaxation can note that SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation and OBC candidates get 3 years. Additional relaxations as per Government of India orders apply to Ex-Servicemen, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, Widows, Divorced Women, and Women judicially separated from their husbands and not remarried.

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST 5 years
OBC 3 years
Ex-Servicemen As per Government of India orders
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) As per Government of India orders
Widows, Divorced Women, Women judicially separated (not remarried) As per Government of India orders

ISRO URSC JRF Recruitment 2026  - Fellowship and Stipend

Selected JRFs at ISRO URSC receive a monthly fellowship stipend of ₹37,000 per month. After completion of two years as JRF, at the sole discretion of ISRO/DOS/URSC, the fellow may be awarded Senior Research Fellow (SRF) status with a stipend of ₹42,000 per month. HRA at prescribed rates is paid if hostel accommodation is not provided at the place of posting. Medical benefits for self are admissible as per extant rules. No Dearness Allowance (DA) is paid. The fellowship amount is treated as basic pay for this purpose.

JRFs are eligible only for casual leave. All female JRFs are entitled to maternity leave as per Government of India instructions. JRFs are also eligible for subsidised canteen facilities. Selected candidates are not entitled to any other benefits or concessions admissible to regular employees. The initial engagement is for two years, extendable based on assessment of work and project requirements. The maximum combined period of engagement as JRF and SRF together shall not exceed five years. JRFs with aptitude for research will be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. with an external university.

ISRO URSC JRF Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection for ISRO URSC JRF 2026 involves an initial screening stage followed by an interview. Meeting the minimum qualification is necessary but does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for interview - shortlisting is based on academic performance and other parameters in the online application.

  1. Initial Screening - Based on academic performance and other parameters given in the online application. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.
  2. Interview - Conducted in Bengaluru only on a given date. Call letters for the interview will be sent by e-mail only. The interview result will be announced on the ISRO website.

URSC/ISRO reserves the right to change the venue/date of the interview. Outstation candidates shortlisted for interview will be reimbursed to-and-fro Second Class Sleeper Railway fare by the shortest distance from the address in the online application to the interview venue, or non-A/C government bus fare, or actual fare - whichever is less - on production of proof of journey. If a candidate travels by a higher class, only second class rail fare excluding reservation/sleeper charges will be paid. Travel allowance is payable only to candidates allowed for interview after successful document verification.

How to Apply

Applications for ISRO URSC JRF Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only. All further communications will be made exclusively by e-mail and through the ISRO website. Candidates are advised to check their e-mail regularly and visit www.isro.gov.in periodically for updates.

  1. Visit www.isro.gov.in and navigate to the "CAREERS" section
  2. Find Advertisement No. URSC:02:2026 and select the JRF position you wish to apply for
  3. Register online - note your Registration Number carefully and preserve it for future reference
  4. Fill in all required fields including a valid and correct e-mail ID - hall tickets will be sent by e-mail only
  5. Upload the following mandatory documents in soft copy:
    • Recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months) - JPG/JPEG, maximum 500 KB
    • Signature - JPG/JPEG, maximum 500 KB
    • Mark cards of each semester/year with final pass certificate - single PDF, not exceeding 1 MB
    • SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex-Serviceman certificate if seeking age relaxation - PDF, not exceeding 1 MB
    • CSIR-UGC-NET score card or GATE score card or equivalent national examination score card - PDF, not exceeding 1 MB
  6. Submit the application before 11 July 2026
  7. Candidates already employed under Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or Autonomous Body must follow up the online application with a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer, indicating name, position applied for, Position No., and Registration No. on the reverse of the NOC
  8. Avoid submitting multiple applications for the same position - if multiple applications are submitted, only the latest application submitted before the closing date will be processed

For any clarification, candidates may write to [email protected]. No interim correspondence will otherwise be entertained. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification of candidature.

Document Requirements at Interview

Shortlisted candidates called for the interview must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of all of the following documents to the interview venue in Bengaluru.

  • All certificates and mark sheets of all degrees and postgraduate degree
  • Equivalency Certificate from Association of Indian Universities, New Delhi - in case of a foreign degree
  • Proof of work experience
  • Age proof
  • CSIR-UGC-NET score card or GATE score card or score card of equivalent national level examination
  • Caste certificate - for SC/ST/OBC candidates seeking age relaxation
  • PwBD certificate - for candidates claiming PwBD age relaxation
  • Relevant certificates issued by Competent Authority for Ex-Servicemen and other categories claiming age relaxation

Troubleshooting and Common Mistakes

Applying through an online government portal involves several steps where errors can cause rejection. The following general guidance helps candidates complete their application successfully.

  • Photo upload errors: The photograph must be in JPG/JPEG format, not older than 6 months, and not exceeding 500 KB. Uploading any object other than your own passport-size photograph in the designated photo field will result in your candidature being rejected at screening stage under any circumstances.
  • Incomplete applications rejected outright: Applications submitted without complete information or without a photograph will be summarily rejected. Verify every mandatory field before final submission.
  • Last-day server load: Online portals experience high traffic close to the deadline. Submit your application well before 11 July 2026 to avoid gateway timeouts or submission failures.
  • Save your Registration Number: Upon successful registration, an online Registration Number is provided. Store it securely - it is required for all future reference, hall ticket download, and communications.
  • E-mail ID accuracy: The e-mail ID entered in the application must be valid and actively monitored. Hall tickets and all official communications will be sent exclusively by e-mail. Errors in e-mail ID cannot be corrected after submission.
  • Multiple applications: If you accidentally submit more than one application for the same position, only the latest application submitted before the closing date will be processed. Ensure that application is complete in all respects.
  • PDF file size: Each supporting document PDF must not exceed 1 MB. Compress your PDF if the file is larger before uploading.
  • ODL degree: Candidates who completed their qualifying postgraduate degree through Open and Distance Learning are not eligible. Verify your mode of study before applying.
