📄 Complete Details & Notification

Punjab & Sind Bank, a Government of India Undertaking, has released a notification inviting applications for 8 contractual posts across its Cloud Centre of Excellence and Artificial Intelligence verticals. The posts span three grade levels - MMGS II, MMGS III, and SMGS IV. Online applications open on 12 June 2026 and close on 28 June 2026. Experienced IT professionals in cloud engineering and AI/ML development should apply at the bank's official website, https://punjabandsind.bank.in/.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Quick Summary

Field Detail
Organisation Punjab & Sind Bank (Govt. of India Undertaking)
Posts Manager / Senior Manager / Chief Manager - Cloud CoE; Manager / Senior Manager - AI Engineers
Total Vacancies 8
Application Mode Online only
Apply Start Date 12 June 2026
Last Date to Apply 28 June 2026
Official Website https://punjabandsind.bank.in/

The last date for online application, application editing, and online fee payment is 28 June 2026. No other mode of application is accepted.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

Candidates must note these dates carefully, as the bank will not entertain any request for extension or change of date.

Event Date
Online Application Opens 12 June 2026
Last Date to Apply Online (including Edit & Fee Payment) 28 June 2026
Cut-off Date for Age Eligibility 01 June 2026
Cut-off Date for Work Experience 28 June 2026

The eligibility cut-off date for age is 01 June 2026, while the cut-off for reckoning post-qualification work experience is 28 June 2026. Any experience or qualification completed after these respective dates will not be counted.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Breakdown

Punjab & Sind Bank has advertised 8 posts across five designations and two technology domains. All vacancies are contractual. The category-wise distribution is as follows.

S.No. Post Scale OBC UR Total
1 Manager - Cloud Centre of Excellence MMGS II 1 3 4
2 Senior Manager - Cloud Centre of Excellence MMGS III 0 1 1
3 Chief Manager - Cloud Centre of Excellence SMGS IV 0 1 1
4 Manager - Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineers MMGS II 0 1 1
5 Senior Manager - Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineers MMGS III 0 1 1
Total     1 7 8

There are no vacancies reserved for SC, ST, EWS, or PwBD categories in this notification. The largest pool - 4 posts - is for Manager (Cloud CoE) at MMGS II level.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

All eligibility conditions are assessed as on the respective cut-off dates stated above. Candidates must independently verify they meet every criterion before applying; merely submitting an application does not constitute a right to be called for selection.

Age Limit (as on 01 June 2026)

Scale Minimum Age Maximum Age Date of Birth Range
SMGS IV 33 years 45 years 02 June 1981 – 01 June 1993
MMGS III 31 years 43 years 02 June 1983 – 01 June 1995
MMGS II 29 years 41 years 02 June 1985 – 01 June 1997

The maximum ages above apply to General category and EWS candidates. SC/ST candidates receive 5 years of relaxation in the upper age limit; OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates receive 3 years; Persons with Benchmark Disabilities receive 10 years; Ex-Servicemen (with at least 5 years' military service) receive 5 years; and persons affected by the 1984 riots receive 5 years. SC/ST/OBC candidates may combine their category relaxation with only one of the remaining relaxation categories.

Educational Qualification and Work Experience

Post 1 - Manager, Cloud Centre of Excellence (MMGS II) Mandatory qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or Electronics & Communications Engineering (or equivalent) from a university/institute recognized by the Government of India, UGC, or AICTE. Preferred certifications include AWS Solutions Architect (Associate/Professional), Azure Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Google Associate/Professional Cloud Engineer.

Work experience required: Minimum 4 years of post-qualification experience in IT Industry, BFSI, or the IT vertical of an organization, of which at least 2 years must be specifically in cloud administration or cloud engineering roles.

Post 2 - Manager, AI Engineers (MMGS II) Mandatory qualification: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or Machine Learning - OR - full-time MCA/M.Tech in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field - from a university/institution recognized by the Government of India, AICTE, or UGC. Candidates must also hold at least one professional certification (valid as on the date of eligibility) in AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Data Science, or Generative AI from a recognized university, reputed technology organization, or professional certification body.

Work experience: Minimum 6 years (post B.E./B.Tech/MCA) in AI/ML development, Data Science, or Advanced Analytics, including at least 2 years leading or managing AI/ML projects or teams - OR - Minimum 5 years (post M.Tech) with the same specialization, including the same 2-year leadership requirement.

Post 3 - Senior Manager, Cloud Centre of Excellence (MMGS III) Same mandatory degree requirement as Post 1. Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Administrator, DevOps Engineer, or Google Associate/Professional Cloud Engineer.

Work experience: Minimum 6 years post-qualification experience in IT/BFSI, of which at least 3 years in cloud architecture or cloud engineering roles.

Post 4 - Senior Manager, AI Engineers (MMGS III) Same mandatory degree and certification requirements as Post 2 (Manager AI Engineers).

Work experience: Minimum 4 years (post B.E./B.Tech/MCA) in AI/ML development, Data Science, or Advanced Analytics - OR - Minimum 3 years (post M.Tech) in the same domains.

Post 5 - Chief Manager, Cloud Centre of Excellence (SMGS IV) Same mandatory degree as Posts 1 and 3, plus a mandatory intermediate certification from Microsoft Azure. Preferred additional qualifications: MCA or M.Tech/M.Sc in Computer Science, IT, or Electronics & Communications Engineering. Preferred certifications: AWS Solutions Architect (Professional), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.

Work experience: Minimum 8 years post-qualification experience in IT/BFSI, of which at least 4 years in cloud architecture, cloud engineering, or DevOps roles.

Candidates should note that 59.99% will be treated as less than 60%, and 54.99% as less than 55%, when calculating percentage of marks. Where a university awards CGPA/OGPA, candidates must convert it to percentage and indicate that figure in the online application.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is non-refundable. Payment must be made online only - cash, cheques, money orders, and postal stamps are not accepted. Bank transaction charges for the online payment gateway are borne by the candidate.

Category Application Fee
SC / ST / PwBD ₹100 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges
General, EWS & OBC ₹850 + applicable taxes + payment gateway charges

Once submitted, an application cannot be withdrawn, and the fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor held in reserve for any other examination.

Punjab and Sind Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The bank will use a multi-stage selection process for all posts. All three scales - SMGS IV, MMGS III, and MMGS II - follow the same procedure: Written Test → Short-listing → Personal Interview.

The written test, where conducted, will have the following structure:

Section Questions Maximum Marks Duration
English Language 20 20 15 minutes
General Awareness 20 20 30 minutes
Professional Knowledge 60 60 60 minutes
Total 100 100 105 minutes

The minimum qualifying score in each section is 40% for General and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved Category candidates. However, only Professional Knowledge marks are used for drawing the merit/rank list and shortlisting candidates for the Personal Interview; marks in English Language and General Awareness are not included in the final merit calculation.

Candidates clearing the written test are called for a Personal Interview. The minimum qualifying score for the interview is 40% for Unreserved and EWS candidates and 35% for Reserved categories. Final selection is based on the combined marks from the written test and Personal Interview, in order of merit ranking. Where two candidates tie at the cut-off, they are ranked in descending order of age.

The Personal Interview will be conducted in New Delhi unless otherwise specified. Call letters will be sent by email only. Candidates must attend at their own cost.

The bank shortlists candidates based on experience and suitability at its own discretion - meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call.

Examination Centres

The bank has designated examination centres across India. Candidates may opt for a centre in their state, subject to availability. The bank reserves the right to allot a different centre or cancel/add centres. No request for a change of examination centre, date, or session will be entertained. Selected centres include: Vishakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh), Guwahati (Assam), Patna and Bhagalpur (Bihar), Chandigarh/Mohali, Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Delhi/Delhi-NCR, Panaji (Goa), Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar (Gujarat), Ambala (Haryana), Hamirpur (Himachal Pradesh), Jammu (J&K), Bengaluru (Karnataka), Ernakulam (Kerala), Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh), Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai/MMR (Maharashtra), Bhubaneswar (Odisha), Patiala (Punjab), Jaipur (Rajasthan), Chennai (Tamil Nadu), Hyderabad (Telangana), Prayagraj, Lucknow and Meerut (Uttar Pradesh), Dehradun (Uttarakhand), and Asansol and Siliguri (West Bengal), among others.

Terms of Contract

This engagement is on a contractual basis, not a regular/permanent appointment. The initial period is three years, subject to annual performance review. Depending on need and performance, the bank may extend the contract on an annual basis for up to a maximum of two additional years at its discretion.

The bank may terminate the contract at any time without assigning any reason by giving one month's notice or paying one month's fixed component of compensation in lieu. Similarly, the appointee must give the bank one month's clear notice - or equivalent payment - to exit the contract before its expiry.

Additional conditions: the selected individual must not take up any assignment with any other organization during the contract period; no vigilance case or adverse observation from previous employers should be pending; and the candidate must have a minimum CIBIL score of 650 at the time of joining.

How to Apply

Applications are accepted online only through the bank's official website. The steps below reflect the application flow described in the notification.

  1. Visit https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and navigate to the Recruitment section on the home page.
  2. Click on the relevant notification for Cloud CoE / AI Engineers.
  3. Before starting registration, scan and prepare the following files:
    • Passport-size photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG/PNG)
    • Signature on white paper in black ink (10–20 KB)
    • Left thumb impression on white paper (20–50 KB; JPG/JPEG)
    • Hand-written declaration in English, on white paper in black ink - text: "I, [Name], hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." (50–100 KB; JPG/JPEG; NOT in capital letters)
    • Supporting documents in PDF format: Brief Resume, ID Proof, Age Proof, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates/NOC, Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  4. Complete the online registration form. Keep the registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the process.
  5. Upload all documents at the specified fields. The system will not proceed until photographs and signatures meet specifications.
  6. Pay the application fee online. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate.
  7. Submit the application and save/print the system-generated application form with the registration number.
  8. Apply separately for each post if applying for more than one position.

In case of multiple submissions for the same post, only the last valid completed application will be retained; fees paid for earlier submissions will be forfeited.

Documents Required at Document Verification

Candidates called for the interview stage must bring originals and self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents. Documents not produced on the day of verification will disqualify the candidate from further participation.

Required documents include: Date of Birth proof (SSC/School Leaving Certificate); printout of call letter; system-generated online application printout; all educational certificates and mark sheets from Class X onwards (semester-wise mark sheets and provisional/final degree certificate); all work experience certificates and NOC from the current employer if employed with a public sector bank or government/quasi-government organization; caste/category certificates in the prescribed Government of India format (OBC certificate must be no more than one year old and contain the non-creamy layer clause); disability certificate from District Medical Board (if applicable); Income and Asset Certificate (for EWS candidates, valid as on the date of application); two passport-size photographs identical to the one in the application; and valid photo identity proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Aadhaar, Employee ID, etc. - Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted).

No documents should be sent directly to the bank before or after the interview.

Troubleshooting & Common Mistakes

Photo/Signature upload errors are among the most common reasons for application failure. Ensure your photograph is between 20 KB and 50 KB and your signature between 10 KB and 20 KB. Files larger than the specified limit will be rejected by the system. Use a scanner set to at least 200 DPI and save files in JPG/JPEG format. All supporting documents must be in PDF format.

Payment gateway failures can occur during high-traffic periods near the deadline. If a payment is deducted but the fee status is not updated, wait 24 hours and check again before attempting re-payment; duplicate payments are generally not refunded. Avoid applying on the last day to reduce the risk of server overload.

Hand-written declaration errors are a unique pitfall in this recruitment. The declaration must be in English, in the candidate's own handwriting, in lowercase (not capital letters). A typed or third-party-written declaration will invalidate the application.

Name mismatches between the application and identity documents can cause disqualification at any stage. Ensure the name (and father's/husband's name where applicable) is spelled exactly as it appears on your certificates and mark sheets. Candidates who have changed their name must produce an original Gazette notification, marriage certificate, or affidavit.

CIBIL score is a condition of joining, not selection. Candidates are advised to check their CIBIL score before applying - a score below 650 will disqualify them at the time of joining even if selected.

Baba Farid University of Health Sciences (BFUHS), Faridkot has released Advertisement No. BFU-26/20 inviting online applications for 454 posts of Pharmacist (Pharmacy Officer) under the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Punjab. BFUHS Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

To be eligible for BFUHS Pharmacist Recruitment 2026, candidates must satisfy all three qualification conditions simultaneously. The eligibility is determined as on the last date of application, i.e., 1 July 2026.

Educational Qualification

  • Passed Senior Secondary Part-II (Class 12) with Science or its equivalent from a recognised university or institution; AND
  • Possess a Diploma in Pharmacy or Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) or Pharm.D (Doctor of Pharmacy) from a recognised university or institution, or higher qualification in the same discipline; AND

Certificates and diplomas from non-recognised institutions will not be accepted and candidature will be declared ineligible. Foreign university degrees require equivalence/recognition proof from the University Grants Commission.

Knowledge of Punjabi Language

No person shall be appointed by direct recruitment unless they have passed the Matriculation examination with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject, or an equivalent Punjabi language examination. Additionally, as per Punjab Government Notification No. GSR72/Const./Art.309/Amd.(22)/2022 dated 28.10.2022, candidates must pass a qualifying Punjabi Language test equivalent to Matriculation standard with at least 50% marks, conducted by the recruiting agency alongside the competitive exam. Failure to secure 50% in this test will disqualify the candidate regardless of their other scores.

Exception: War Heroes discharged from defence/paramilitary services on account of disability (or their widows/dependents appointed under Government instructions) are exempt from the Punjabi language requirement. Wards of defence personnel who are bonafide Punjab residents must qualify the Punjabi test within two years of appointment.

Age Limit (as on 1 January 2026)

BFUHS Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 - Pay Scale / Salary

Selected candidates will be entitled to pay scales and emoluments as per Punjab Government instructions. The initial pay for the Pharmacist (Pharmacy Officer) post is fixed at ₹29,200/- (Pay Level 5 under the 7th Central Pay Commission). Other allowances and service conditions are governed by the Department of Health and Family Welfare Technical Group 'C' Service Rules of 2016 (with first amendment dated 23.07.2025) and relevant Finance Department instructions.

Selection Process

Selection for BFUHS Pharmacist 2026 is based on a written examination (90 marks) combined with experience marks (10 marks), giving a total of 100 marks. The written test is conducted by Baba Farid University of Health Sciences, Faridkot.

  1. Written Examination – 90 Marks (conducted by BFUHS, Faridkot)
  2. Experience Marks – 10 Marks (as per Punjab Government, Health & Family Welfare Dept., Health-5 Branch, Letter Memo No. 1037633: HFW-HLH5021/161/2025-2H5/1/1329287/2026 dated 26.02.2026)
  3. Punjabi Language Qualifying Test – Mandatory qualifying test (minimum 50% marks required; failure disqualifies candidate)
  4. Document Verification – Certificate verification after written test
  5. Police Verification – Required before appointment; must produce Police Verification Certificate and clearance of criminal charges
  6. Final Merit List – Combined and category-wise merit list prepared on inter-se merit of written test and experience marks

Minimum qualifying marks in written test: 33%. Candidates scoring below 33% in the written examination will be declared ineligible for selection. In case of a tie in marks, preference will be given to the elder candidate. Higher qualification carries no extra weightage.

Experience Marks – COVID-19 Service Benefit (Annexure-1 Detail)

Candidates who served under the Punjab Health Department or its various institutions/agencies during the COVID-19 pandemic (March 2020 to June 2021, the period of lockdown/partial lockdown in Punjab) are eligible for experience marks. The criteria are as follows:

  • COVID service of less than one year: 5 marks
  • COVID service of one year or more: 10 marks

Key conditions for experience marks: The written exam retains a maximum of 90 marks; experience benefit is capped at 10 marks. COVID experience must be verified by the Head of the concerned institution. The experience benefit applies only to Group-C and Group-D cadre vacancies. The benefit is available only when the candidate is applying for a vacancy of the same nature/job responsibilities for which they worked on contract/outsourcing under the Health Department during the pandemic. This benefit is applicable only for direct recruitment vacancies in the current year (up to 31.12.2026).

How to Apply

Applications for BFUHS Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online only through the official university website. No offline applications will be accepted. Candidates should read the complete notification on bfuhs.ac.in before applying.

  1. Visit the official website: www.bfuhs.ac.in
  2. Navigate to the Recruitment / Vacancies section
  3. Click on the link for Advt. No. BFU-26/20 – Pharmacist (Pharmacy Officer)
  4. Register and fill in the online application form carefully
  5. Select your category carefully - category once selected cannot be changed under any circumstances
  6. Mention your sub-category vis-à-vis Caste in the online form
  7. Upload all required documents including educational certificates, Punjab Pharmacy Council registration, and category certificates
  8. Pay the application fee online (non-refundable)
  9. Submit the application and download the confirmation receipt

Important: Candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately with separate fees for each post. No TA/DA will be paid for travel to the written test or counselling. The qualification including Punjab Pharmacy Council registration must be prior to the last date of filling the application (1 July 2026).

Important Terms and Conditions

Candidates are advised to read all terms before applying. These conditions govern eligibility verification, disqualification, and appointment procedures.

  • Category is final: The category once selected will not be changed under any circumstances. Wrong category selection will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Sportspersons claiming reservation must possess a Sports Gradation Certificate issued by the Director of Sports, Punjab, as per the latest instructions, available as on the last date of application.
  • SC/BC certificate must be in accordance with Welfare Department Punjab instructions; ESM, Freedom Fighter, EWS, and Sports certificates must comply with the concerned department's instructions.
  • Fictitious/bogus certificates: If any certificate is found fake at any stage, candidature will be cancelled and legal action will follow.
  • Police Verification is mandatory before appointment - passing the written exam alone does not guarantee appointment.
  • Government employees applying must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their Head of Department and must not be under any disciplinary proceedings.
  • The number of posts can be increased or decreased at any time as per departmental requirements.
  • Reserved category posts are provisional and subject to change as per Punjab Government Policy Guidelines.
  • No extra weightage for higher qualification.
  • In case of equal marks, preference is given to the elder candidate.
  • Nationality: Candidates must be Indian citizens or fall under prescribed categories (Nepal/Bhutan citizens, Tibetan refugees who came before 1.1.1962, or persons of Indian origin from specified countries with Punjab Government eligibility certificate).

Competition Level Analysis

With 454 posts across Punjab's government health network, BFUHS Pharmacist Recruitment 2026 is one of the largest pharmacy recruitment drives in Punjab in recent years. General category has the highest allocation at 136 posts, while ESM/LDESM categories together account for 88 posts. The combination of written exam (90 marks) and experience marks (10 marks) means candidates with valid COVID-19 service experience under the Punjab Health Department gain a direct scoring advantage. The mandatory 50% Punjabi Language qualifying test is a key eliminator - candidates must prepare specifically for this component alongside the technical pharmacy exam. Minimum 33% in written exam is needed to even qualify for the merit list.

Who Should NOT Apply

  • Candidates who are not registered with Punjab Pharmacy Council under the Pharmacy Act, 1948, as on 1 July 2026
  • Candidates who do not hold a Diploma in Pharmacy, B.Pharm, or Pharm.D from a recognised institution
  • Candidates who have not passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a subject and cannot qualify the Punjabi language test at 50%
  • Candidates above 37 years of age as on 1 January 2026 (unless eligible for age relaxation under a specific category)
  • Candidates previously disqualified by any recruiting board/government body where the disqualification period is still active
  • Government employees with pending disciplinary proceedings who cannot obtain an NOC from their Head of Department

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Wrong category selection: This is irreversible - double-check your category (General/SC/BC/EWS/ESM etc.) before final submission
  • Not mentioning sub-category: Candidates must specify their sub-category vis-à-vis Caste in the online form as instructed
  • Applying without Punjab Pharmacy Council registration: Registration must be active and obtained before 1 July 2026
  • Ignoring the Punjabi Language test: Many candidates underestimate this mandatory qualifier - failing at 50% disqualifies you regardless of your written exam performance
  • Sports candidates without Gradation Certificate: The Sports Gradation Certificate must already be in hand as on the last date of application; no extra time is given
  • Not claiming COVID experience correctly: Experience benefit is only for candidates who worked for the same nature of post under Punjab Health/Medical Education departments during March 2020–June 2021 - mis-claiming it can lead to disqualification

Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), a Scientific Society under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, has announced its JIT (Just-In-Time) June 2026 Recruitment Cycle with 900+ contractual vacancies across 11 centres including Bengaluru, Chennai, Noida, Pune, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Delhi, Mohali, Kolkata, Thiruvananthapuram, and Guwahati (CINE/North East). Applications are open from 01 June 2026 and the last date to apply online is 20 June 2026. There is no application fee for any category. All applications must be submitted online at https://careers.cdac.in/.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Quick Overview

Field Details
Organization Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC), under MeitY, Govt. of India
Advertisement No. CORP/JIT/02/2026 (centre-wise suffixes)
Recruitment Cycle JIT June 2026

Official Website https://www.cdac.in/

C-DAC has published separate notifications dated 01 June 2026 for each of its 11 centres. Each centre-specific advertisement covers post details, domain areas, qualification, experience, age limit, and selection instructions. The number of positions is provisional and may vary based on actual project requirements.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates

Candidates planning to apply for C-DAC JIT June 2026 Recruitment should note these key dates. All eligibility conditions — age, qualification, and experience — are calculated as on the last date of application, i.e., 20 June 2026.

Event Date
Online Application Opens 01 June 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 20 June 2026
Age & Experience Cut-off Date 20 June 2026
Written Test / Interview Date Communicated later by email to shortlisted candidates only

C-DAC will not send any hard copy communication at any stage of the selection process. Candidates must keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Centre-wise Vacancy Details

C-DAC JIT June 2026 vacancies are spread across 11 centres pan-India, covering domains ranging from AI/ML and Cyber Security to VLSI, HPC, Quantum Computing, Embedded Systems, and e-Governance. Each centre has issued its own advertisement — applying on one centre's portal does not cover other centres.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Post-wise Eligibility and Salary

C-DAC JIT June 2026 Recruitment covers positions from entry-level Project Associates to senior Project Managers. Eligibility requirements, experience bands, salary ranges, and upper age limits differ by position level. All qualifications must be from AICTE/UGC-approved colleges or recognized universities.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

C-DAC charges no application fee for any position under the JIT June 2026 Recruitment Cycle. This applies to all candidates across all categories — General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST, and PwBD — and across all 11 centres. No payment of any kind is required at any stage of the application process.

C-DAC Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

C-DAC follows a multi-stage selection process for JIT June 2026 positions. All communications regarding selection stages are sent by email only — no hard copy letters or call letters are dispatched at any stage.

Stage 1 – Initial Academic Screening: All submitted applications are assessed on the basis of academic records, qualifications, declared experience, and domain relevance. Only candidates meeting minimum eligibility criteria proceed further. C-DAC reserves the right to raise the minimum cut-off if the applicant volume significantly exceeds the number of vacancies.

Stage 2 – Written Test (if applicable): A written or skill-based test may be conducted at the discretion of individual centres, depending on the number of screened-in candidates. Shortlisted candidates will be notified by email. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test.

Stage 3 – Personal Interview: Candidates who clear the screening and written test stages are called for a personal interview by the respective C-DAC centre. The interview call is sent by email only. Receipt of an interview call letter does not confirm selection. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

Important Points About the Nature of Engagement

These C-DAC positions are purely contractual — candidates should understand the terms before applying. The initial contract period is up to 3 years (1 year for the Kolkata centre), or project completion, whichever is earlier. Extensions are possible based on performance and project requirements.

Selected candidates have no right to regular or permanent appointment in C-DAC by virtue of this engagement. They may be deputed or transferred to any C-DAC project location across India based on organizational requirement. C-DAC internal candidates who are finally selected must resign from their current C-DAC service and join afresh for the selected post. Internal C-DAC candidates must also have completed a minimum of 2 years of service in C-DAC as on 20 June 2026 to be eligible.

Competition Level Analysis

C-DAC JIT June 2026 is a large-scale national recruitment drive and competition is expected to be moderate to high, particularly in popular domains. The absence of any application fee significantly increases applicant volume across all centres.

Roles in AI/ML, Full Stack Development, Cyber Security, and Software Development at the Project Engineer and Senior Project Engineer levels will attract the largest applicant pools, especially from tier-2 and tier-3 engineering colleges. In contrast, niche domain posts in Quantum Computing, VLSI/Chip Design, Additive Manufacturing, Robotics, and HPC System Software will see comparatively lower competition but demand highly specialised credentials.

Initial screening is where effective filtering happens — CGPA, subject percentage, and domain match are the primary screening parameters. Candidates applying to Noida (e-Governance, Health Informatics) and Pune (200+ positions, wide domain breadth) should expect steeper competition due to location preference and higher vacancy counts. Documenting relevant project work, publications, or domain-specific internships may help distinguish profiles at the screening stage, even where such work is not formally counted as experience.

Who Should NOT Apply

Before investing time in the application, certain candidates should assess whether this recruitment is suitable for them.

Candidates seeking a permanent government job should not apply — all positions are purely contractual with no path to regular employment in C-DAC. Those whose degree is from an institution not approved by AICTE/UGC or not recognized by the Central or State Government will face rejection during document verification. Candidates unable to produce a CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate from their university — where applicable — will also face issues at document stage.

Work experience from internships, academic project placements, teaching assignments, or research work embedded in a curriculum is explicitly excluded from the experience count unless a specific post states otherwise. Candidates without formal employer-issued experience certificates clearly showing period of employment, designation, and salary drawn will find their experience claims unacceptable. C-DAC internal candidates who have not completed 2 years of service by 20 June 2026 are ineligible. Anyone unwilling to be posted anywhere in India, or who prefers postal communication over email-only correspondence, will find this recruitment unsuitable.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Several avoidable errors frequently affect candidates during the C-DAC application process. Applying on one centre's portal and assuming it covers other centres is the most common mistake — each centre has a completely separate advertisement and application link, and candidates must apply individually to each centre they wish to be considered for. Similarly, candidates who want to be considered for more than one position must submit a separate application for each post.

Uploading a resume in any format other than PDF (max 500 KB) or a photograph other than .jpg (max 400 KB) will cause application issues. Failing to note the unique application number generated after submission is another frequent problem — this number is essential for all future reference. Government or PSU employees who do not forward their application through proper channel must ensure they carry a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer at the time of the interview. Sending physical documents or hard copies to any C-DAC centre is unnecessary — the entire application process is online. Assuming an interview call letter means confirmed selection is also incorrect; candidature remains provisional until document verification is completed.

How to Apply

Candidates must apply online only through the official C-DAC careers portal. A valid mobile number and active email ID are mandatory, as OTP-based login is used and all subsequent communications are sent by email.

  1. Visit the official C-DAC careers portal at https://careers.cdac.in/.
  2. Select the relevant centre from the list of active advertisements.
  3. Click 'Apply' against the specific position you wish to apply for.
  4. Log in using your registered mobile number and enter the OTP received.
  5. Fill in all required fields in the online application form accurately.
  6. Upload your passport-size photograph in .jpg format (max 400 KB) and your resume/CV in PDF format (max 500 KB).
  7. Submit the form and note down the unique application number generated upon successful submission.
  8. If applying for multiple positions or multiple centres, repeat the process with a separate application for each.

Documents to be produced at the time of document verification or joining include: educational mark sheets and degree certificates from Class 10 onwards, CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate (if applicable), experience certificates from all previous and current employers, caste/category certificate (if applicable), disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board (for PwBD candidates), date of birth proof, and an NOC from the current employer where applicable.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

The application fee is ₹100 (One Hundred only). Women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Serviceman categories are fully exempted from paying the fee. Ex-Servicemen who have already secured regular civil employment under the Central Government or Government of NCT of Delhi after availing ESM reservation benefits are not eligible for fee exemption.

Payment must be made only through SBI ePay. No other payment mode will be accepted, and fees paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

DSSSB Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Computer Based Written Examination under one of three examination schemes depending on the post applied for.

One Tier General (I-T-G) — Post Codes 34/26, 39/26, 40/26: Duration: 2 hours | 200 MCQs | 200 marks. Five sections of 40 marks each: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability, Arithmetical & Numerical Ability, Hindi Language & Comprehension, and English Language & Comprehension. Final merit is based on written examination marks only.

One Tier Technical (I-T-T) — Post Codes 21/26 to 31/26, 32/26, 33/26, 35/26 to 38/26, 45/26: Duration: 2 hours | 200 MCQs | 200 marks. Section A: 100 marks covering General Awareness, Reasoning, Arithmetic, Hindi, and English (20 marks each). Section B: 100 marks on the domain subject for the post concerned. Minimum qualifying marks apply only to Section B; combined marks of both sections determine the final merit list.

One Tier Technical/Teaching (I-T-T) — Post Codes 41/26, 42/26, 43/26, 44/26: Duration: 2 hours | 200 MCQs | 200 marks. Section A: 100 marks (same five general subjects, 20 marks each). Section B: 100 marks from subject-specific content including teaching methodology/B.Ed. Minimum qualifying marks apply only to Section B; combined marks of both sections determine final merit.

Skill Test, Aptitude Test, Trade Test, or Physical Endurance Test may be conducted additionally as per job requirements. How to Apply

The application process for DSSSB Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. No applications sent by post, by hand, or by email will be accepted.

  1. Visit the official DSSSB registration and application portal at https://dsssbonline.nic.in.
  2. If you are a new user, complete the one-time registration process. Note down your User ID and password — the same credentials are to be used for all future DSSSB examinations; do not register multiple times.
  3. Log in using your registered credentials and select the relevant post code from Advertisement No. 03/2026.
  4. Fill in all fields of the online application form accurately. Once submitted, no change or correction — including change of category — will be permitted under any circumstances.
  5. Upload a recent, clear colour photograph (plain white or off-white background, full face, front view, eyes open) and your signature. Blurred or illegible photographs/signatures will result in rejection.
  6. Pay the application fee of ₹100 through SBI ePay (exempted categories need not pay).
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for your own records. Keep the registration number and application number safely.

The application portal will be live from 16 June 2026 (12:00 Noon) until 15 July 2026 (11:59 PM), after which the link will be disabled.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Candidates applying for DSSSB 2026 should be careful about a few common pitfalls in the online application process.

Photo and signature uploads are a frequent reason for rejection — ensure the image files are clear, correctly sized, and within the file-size limit specified on the portal. Blurred or illegible uploads will cause outright rejection of candidature. If the payment gateway shows an error after fee deduction, do not immediately retry; wait for a few hours to check whether the payment was credited before attempting again through the portal's payment history section. Use an updated browser (Chrome or Firefox preferred) and avoid mobile browsers for form submission, as they may not render all fields correctly. Save your User ID and password immediately after registration and store your application number carefully — all future communications from DSSSB will reference these. Avoid applying on the last day; DSSSB expressly states it will not be responsible for inability to submit due to heavy server load near the closing date.

Central Sanskrit University (CSU), Delhi has released Advertisement No. 04/2026 dated 10.06.2026, inviting online applications for 90 Teaching and Other Academic posts across its three campuses — Vedvyas (Himachal Pradesh), Shri Raghunath Kirti (Uttarakhand), and Ekalavya (Tripura). Eligibility Criteria for CSU Recruitment 2026

For candidates wondering about the educational qualifications and age limits for these posts, CSU has specified that the detailed eligibility for each post is given separately in Annexure-I of the official notification. Qualifications and other eligibility criteria are determined as per the norms of the UGC, NCTE, NCISM, and the Statutes/Ordinances of CSU, including amendments made from time to time.

The age limit and relaxations are governed by applicable UGC Regulations and Government of India norms, along with the Statutes/Ordinances of CSU. The criteria date for determining eligibility in every respect — including qualifications, NET/Ph.D., teaching/research experience, and publications — is the last date of online application submission, i.e., 10 July 2026. Candidates should refer to Annexure-I of the official notification for post-wise qualification details.

CSU Application Fee 2026: Category-wise Details

The application fee for CSU Recruitment 2026 depends on the post level (10 or 13A) and the candidate's category, and must be paid only through online mode. Here is the complete fee structure:

CSU Selection Process 2026: Step-by-Step

Candidates wondering how the selection will be conducted can note that the process differs slightly for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts, though both involve shortlisting, assessment, and interview stages.

  • Step 1 – Online Application & Scrutiny: Candidates apply online and upload documents; applications are provisionally scrutinized for eligibility.
  • Step 2 – Written Test (for Assistant Professor / Level-10 posts only): An OMR-based test with Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) and a Descriptive Test assessing Research Aptitude and Writing Skills. If eligible candidates for a subject are fewer than 20, the written test may be dispensed with.
  • Step 3 – No Written Test for Associate Professor (Level-13A): These posts go directly to shortlisting based on Video Presentation, Research Skill assessment, and PPT presentation.
  • Step 4 – Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates undergo verification of original certificates related to age, qualification, experience, and category.
  • Step 5 – Face-to-Face Interview: The final stage for all shortlisted candidates across both Level-10 and Level-13A posts.

Detailed information on the selection procedure, shortlisting criteria, syllabus, and weightage will be announced separately on the CSU website (www.sanskrit.nic.in).

How to Apply for CSU Recruitment 2026 Online

Applicants who want to know the exact application steps can follow this simple process, which is entirely online except for the final hard-copy submission.

  1. Visit the CU Chayan Portal at curec.samarth.ac.in or access it via www.sanskrit.nic.in under "Recruitment/Notification."
  2. Register yourself on the portal to generate a registration number.
  3. Select the post/subject you wish to apply for and fill in the online application form.
  4. Upload clear, high-quality scanned copies of all required documents, certificates, and publications.
  5. Pay the prescribed application/examination fee online based on your category and post level.
  6. Submit the application before 10 July 2026, 11:30 PM IST (no correction window is available after submission).
  7. Take a printout of the application and fee receipt, sign it, attach self-attested document copies, and superscribe the envelope with the Advertisement Number and post/subject applied for.
  8. Send the hard copy by registered post to "The Registrar, Central Sanskrit University, 56-57, Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058" so it reaches within 15 days from the online application closing date.

Candidates already employed in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies must additionally submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and, where applicable, a Vigilance Clearance Certificate from their employer.

Salary and Pay Level for CSU Posts

Candidates curious about the pay structure can refer to the Pay Level (as per 7th CPC) mentioned against each post in the official notification.

  • Associate Professor posts (Part A) are placed at Pay Level-13A.
  • Assistant Professor, Assistant Director, and Assistant Librarian posts (Part B) are placed at Pay Level-10.

The University has not specified exact in-hand salary figures in the notification; candidates can refer to the standard 7th Pay Commission pay matrix corresponding to Level-10 and Level-13A for indicative pay ranges.

Document Requirements & Caste/Category Certificates

Reserved category candidates often ask which certificates are mandatory — CSU requires self-attested copies of the Caste/Class Certificate and, for PwBD candidates, a Medical Certificate from the Competent Authority in the Government of India prescribed format.

  • OBC Certificate: Must be a valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 for this advertisement. Certificates issued before this date will not be accepted.
  • EWS Certificate: Must be an Income & Assets certificate valid for the current financial year, issued by a competent authority such as a District Magistrate, Tehsildar, or Sub-Divisional Officer, and issued on or before the last date of online application.
  • PwBD Certificate: A valid Disability Certificate showing a disability of not less than 40% must be uploaded to claim PwBD benefits.

Candidates failing to submit valid category certificates will not be considered for that reservation and will instead be treated as Unreserved (UR) candidates.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

Many applicants lose their candidature due to avoidable errors during the CSU application process. Keep the following points in mind to ensure a smooth application:

  • Don't wait until the last day: Heavy server load near the deadline (10 July 2026) can prevent successful submission, and CSU will not entertain complaints about this.
  • Double-check before final submission: No correction window is provided once the online form is submitted, so verify all details — name, category, post, photo, and signature — carefully.
  • Use a valid OBC certificate date: Certificates issued before 01.04.2026 will be rejected for OBC claims under this advertisement.
  • Match signatures and photographs: Any variation between the photo/signature on the form and on supporting documents can lead to summary rejection.
  • Pay the correct fee for each subject: A separate application and fee is required for every individual post/subject applied for.
  • Send hard copy on time with correct superscription: The envelope must clearly mention the Advertisement Number and post/subject; missing this can delay or invalidate your application.
  • Choose one exam city if applying for multiple posts: This avoids scheduling conflicts between different examination slots.

Competition Level Analysis for SSC CGL 2026

The overall competition level for SSC CGL 2026 is expected to remain very high because the examination attracts a massive number of graduate applicants every year across India. Even with around 12,256 vacancies, the effective competition ratio remains extremely tough for high-demand posts.

  1. Applicant volume is huge: SSC CGL is among the most sought-after central government exams, and premium posts receive intense preference from top scorers.
  2. Tier-I acts as the main screening stage: With negative marking and sectional timing, both speed and accuracy matter. Candidates targeting top posts generally need a very strong Tier-I score.
  3. Tier-II gets post-specific: Specialized posts like JSO and AAO attract a smaller but more qualified pool, making domain preparation more important than raw competition numbers.
  4. DEST and CKT can eliminate candidates: Although qualifying in nature, poor performance in these sections can disqualify otherwise strong candidates for certain posts.
  5. Physical standards create an extra filter: Certain Inspector and Sub Inspector posts require physical and medical fitness standards that are checked separately by user departments.

Who Should NOT Apply for SSC CGL 2026?

  1. Candidates who will not possess a Bachelor's Degree by 01-08-2026.
  2. Candidates who fall outside the age limit for all eligible posts even after applicable relaxation.
  3. OBC Creamy Layer candidates intending to claim OBC reservation.
  4. Candidates who cannot meet post-specific physical or medical standards for the posts they plan to prefer.
  5. Non-matriculate Ex-Servicemen or those who have not completed the required length of service.
  6. Candidates applying for JSO without the required Mathematics or Statistics qualification.
  7. Female candidates applying specifically for BRO vacancies, where only male candidates are eligible.
  8. Distance-learning degree holders without valid UGC-DEB approval for the relevant period.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying SSC CGL 2026

  1. Not generating a fresh OTR on the new SSC website.
  2. Using a pre-existing photograph instead of live photo capture where required.
  3. Uploading blurred or wrongly sized signature files.
  4. Selecting the wrong reservation category without valid supporting certificate.
  5. Ignoring post-specific standards before locking post preferences.
  6. Choosing JSO or AAO related preferences without being ready for Paper-II or Paper-III.
  7. Skipping Aadhaar-based authentication even when eligible.
  8. Waiting until the final date for application submission.
  9. Missing the answer key objection window after examination.
  10. Confusing the correction window fee structure.

How to Apply for SSC CGL 2026

Candidates must apply online only at https://ssc.gov.in or through the mY SSC mobile application (available on Store). No other mode of application is accepted. Candidates who have not generated OTR on the new website must do so first. Once OTR is generated on the new website, it remains valid for all future examinations on that portal.

Candidates are advised to opt for Aadhaar-based authentication during OTR. Aadhaar-authenticated candidates get significant exemptions: their applications are not rejected for photograph/signature standards, and they need not carry photo ID at the examination venue.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Generate One-Time Registration (OTR) at https://ssc.gov.in (mandatory; use Aadhaar-based authentication if possible)
  2. Complete OTR profile and lock it
  3. Fill the Common Application Form (CAF) including live photograph capture via camera
  4. Upload scanned signature (JPEG/JPG, 10–20 KB, 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm)
  5. Fill the Examination Specific Module (post preferences, exam centre choices - 3 centres within same region in order of priority)
  6. Pay application fee of Rs. 100/- online (if applicable) by 23-06-2026
  7. Preview/Print the application to verify all details before final submission
  8. Use the correction window (29-06 to 01-07-2026) if any correction is needed (chargeable)
  9. Keep printout of application and all documents for at least 3 years

Documents to Keep Ready for Document Verification (after final selection):

  • Matriculation/Secondary School Certificate (proof of date of birth)
  • Mark sheets for all years/semesters of Graduation + Provisional/Degree Certificate

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Karnataka State Police (KSP) has officially released the KSP Recruitment 2026 notification, announcing 3,991 vacancies for the post of Civil Police Constable across two separate cadres. This is one of the biggest police recruitment drives in Karnataka in recent years, and online applications are now open on the KEA portal from 8th June 2026 to 3rd July 2026. The written examination is scheduled for 2nd August 2026.

If you are a Karnataka resident who has passed Class 12 (PUC) and has been looking for a stable government job in law enforcement, this is your chance. Read on for a complete breakdown of the KSP Constable Recruitment 2026 - from eligibility and vacancies to how to apply and what to expect in the selection process.

Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Karnataka State Police, Central Recruitment & Promotion Department, Bengaluru has officially released two notifications - Advertisement No. 01/Recruitment-4/2026-27 (Kalyana Karnataka / 371(J) cadre) and Advertisement No. 02/Recruitment-4/2026-27 (Mikkili/Okkalida cadre) - both dated 05.06.2026, for direct recruitment of Police Constable (Civil) posts. The notifications include complete details on vacancies, eligibility, selection process, exam pattern, physical standards, age relaxations, reservation, and application instructions. Candidates are strongly advised to read the full notifications before applying.

  • Download Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF - Kalyana Karnataka (596 Posts)
  • Download Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF - Mikkili/Okkalida Cadre (3395 Posts)

Karnataka Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Overview

Karnataka State Police is recruiting 3991 Police Constable (Civil) posts across two cadres with PUC / equivalent qualification, last date 03 July 2026.

KSP Constable Notification 2026 - Important Dates

Missing a deadline can disqualify your candidacy altogether. Below are all the critical dates in the KSP Constable application 2026 Karnataka, listed clearly so you can plan your application well ahead of time.

Important: Apply well before the last date to avoid website congestion or technical difficulties. Do not wait until the deadline.

KSP Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026

Before submitting your PC application for 2026 Karnataka, carefully verify that you meet all eligibility conditions. Candidates who do not meet the educational, age, or language criteria will be disqualified at any stage of the process.

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed Class 12 / PUC or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. This includes:

  • Class 12 passed from CBSE, ICSE, any State Board, or equivalent
  • Class 12 equivalent from NIOS (National Institute of Open Schooling)
  • A 2-year ITC/Diploma (NVBT) course with one language and one academic subject from NIOS
  • A 3-year Diploma from a recognised Polytechnic institution (treated as equivalent to PUC for direct/compassionate recruitment)

Kannada Language Requirement: Candidates must have studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC/10th standard. Those who have not done so must pass a Kannada Language Test conducted by KEA.

Age Limit

The minimum age for all candidates is 18 years. The upper age limit varies by category as follows:

Category Maximum Age

Age is calculated as of the notification date. Candidates should refer to the official PDF for precise age cut-off dates.

KSP Constable Application Fee 2026

The application fee for the KSP Constable recruitment must be paid online only, and is non-refundable under all circumstances. Candidates must ensure payment is completed before 4th July 2026.

Category Application Fee

SC / ST / Cat-1 / Ex-Servicemen / 3rd Gender Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online for KSP Constable Recruitment 2026

The KSP Constable apply online 2026 process is conducted through the KEA (Karnataka Examinations Authority) portal. Follow these steps carefully to submit a valid application for Karnataka police constable recruitment 2026.

  • Step 1: Visit the official KEA recruitment portal at https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/
  • Step 2: Click on the active link for KSP Civil Police Constable Recruitment 2026 (Adv. No. 01 or 02, depending on which cadre you are eligible for).
  • Step 3: Register by entering your personal, educational, and category details accurately.
  • Step 4: Choose the cadre (Kalyana-Karnataka or General) you are applying for. Note: only one application per notification is permitted.
  • Step 5: Upload a recent passport-size photograph (JPEG, 50KB-200KB) and your signature (JPEG, 50KB-70KB).
  • Step 6: Pay the required application fee online through the portal.
  • Step 7: Download and save a copy of the submitted application form and the fee payment receipt.
Caution: No edits or corrections are permitted after final submission. Double-check all entries before clicking submit.

KSP Constable Selection Process 2026

The Karnataka police constable selection process 2026 consists of four clearly defined stages. Candidates must qualify each stage to proceed to the next. There is no direct interview; merit is determined through the written exam and physical assessments.

Stage 1 - Written Examination (CBT / OMR-Based)

The written test is the first and most critical stage of the pc recruitment 2026 Karnataka. It determines the candidates who will move on to physical testing.

Detail Information
Mode OMR-based (Offline)
Total Questions 100
Total Marks 100
Duration 90 Minutes (1 hour 30 minutes)
Minimum Qualifying Marks 30 out of 100
Negative Marking Yes - 0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer

Exam Timings:

  • Notification 1 (KK Cadre): 2:30 PM - 4:00 PM on 2nd August 2026
  • Notification 2 (General Cadre): 10:30 AM - 12:00 PM on 2nd August 2026

Subjects Covered:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science
  • Geography
  • Indian History
  • Indian Constitution
  • Karnataka State Affairs
  • Mental Ability & Reasoning
  • Ethics

Stage 2 - Physical Standard Test (PST)

Candidates who qualify the written exam must appear for physical measurements. Below are the height and chest requirements:

Category Height Chest
Male / Ex-Servicemen Min. 168 cm Min. 86 cm (expanded); expansion min. 5 cm
Female / 3rd Gender Min. 157 cm Min. weight: 45 kg
Budakattu Male (Forest Areas) Min. 155 cm Min. 75 cm; 5 cm expansion
Budakattu Female (Forest Areas) Min. 150 cm -

Stage 3 - Physical Efficiency / Endurance Test (PET)

Candidates who pass the PST will then undergo the physical endurance test. All events must be completed within the prescribed standards.

Event Male / Ex-Servicemen Female / 3rd Gender
Run 1,600m in 6 min 30 sec 400m in 2 min
High Jump Min. 1.20 m (3 chances) Min. 0.90 m (3 chances)
Long Jump Min. 3.80 m (3 chances) Min. 2.50 m (3 chances)
Shot Put (Weight) 7.26 kg; min. 5.60 m (3 chances) 4 kg; min. 3.75 m (3 chances)

Stage 4 - Medical Examination

Shortlisted candidates (in a 1:2 ratio per vacancy) will undergo a comprehensive medical examination by a Medical Board. This includes vision testing, hearing assessment, and musculoskeletal evaluation to ensure candidates are physically fit for active police duty.

Stage 5 - Document Verification

Candidates who clear the medical examination must present original academic certificates, domicile proof, category certificates, and other relevant documents for final verification.

KSP Constable Exam Pattern 2026

This section gives a concise view of the pc exam date 2026 Karnataka and the structure of the written test, helping candidates plan their preparation effectively.

Subject Questions Marks Duration
General Knowledge, Science, Geography, History, Indian Constitution, State Affairs, Mental Ability, Ethics 100 100 90 Minutes

Key Points to Remember:

  • Each correct answer carries 1 mark
  • Each wrong answer results in a deduction of 0.25 marks
  • Unanswered questions carry no penalty
  • Minimum qualifying score is 30 marks

KSP Constable Salary 2026

One of the most attractive aspects of the KSP Recruitment 2026 is the government pay structure. Karnataka police constables are placed at Pay Level 7 under the 7th Pay Commission, with a monthly pay scale of Rs. 37,500 - Rs. 76,100. In addition to the base salary, candidates are eligible for:

  • Dearness Allowance (DA)
  • House Rent Allowance (HRA)
  • Travel Allowance (TA)
  • National Pension Scheme (NPS) benefits
  • Other Karnataka Government allowances

Training and Probation:

  • Selected candidates undergo 9 months of basic police training at designated Police Training Schools in Karnataka.
  • Candidates are on probation for 2 years and 6 months after formal appointment.
  • Candidates who fail during training may be removed from service.

  • B.Sc. (Hons) in Chemistry

SUPT (JOT)-Instrumentation / Instrument Mechanic & Technician (Instrumentation / Instrument Mechanic) Gr. III

  • 10th Pass with ITI (NCVT/NCVET) in Instrumentation / Instrument Mechanic Trade (2 years duration)
  • Apprenticeship Certificate required

** If the Supervisory Certificate of Competency (M.V/H.T/E.H.T) is granted by any other Electrical Licensing Board, the candidate must get it endorsed for validity from the Electrical Licensing Board of Odisha as per the Electrical Licensing Board Regulation, Odisha, 2014, failing which his service will not be confirmed.

NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

Age is calculated as on the last date of online application submission (10-06-2026). Upper age limit is relaxable for various categories. The maximum upper age limit including all relaxations shall not exceed 56 years. The relaxation in age for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) is subject to availability of vacancy for the particular category.

Post Type General (UR) / EWS OBC (NCL) SC / ST PwBD - UR PwBD - OBC (NCL) PwBD - SC / ST
SUPT(JOT) posts (Fresher) 27 years 30 years 32 years 37 years 40 years 42 years
Operator / Technician / Mining Mate Gr. III posts (Experienced) 35 years 38 years 40 years 45 years 48 years 50 years
Jr. Foreman posts (Experienced) 40 years 43 years 45 years 50 years 53 years 55 years
Land Ousted Candidates (M&R Complex, Damanjodi) Maximum 40 years as on 10-06-2026 (all categories); age relaxation applicable as above additionally

Additional relaxations: Ex-Servicemen and children/family members of those who died in the 1984 riots will get relaxation as per Government of India directives.

NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

Application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances. Fee can be paid through dedicated bank account, net banking, debit card, or UPI only. Fee shall not be collected by any other mode. Candidates are advised to verify their eligibility before paying the fee. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, Land Ousted candidates, and internal candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.

Category Application Fee
General (UR) / OBC (NCL) / EWS candidates Rs. 100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) - Non-refundable
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen / Land Ousted / Internal Candidates Exempted (No fee)

NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process consists of Computer Based Test (CBT) and/or Trade Test, followed by Document Verification and Pre-employment Medical Examination (PEME). For posts at Sl. No. 5, 7, 9, 11, and 12 of the vacancy table, selection will be based on CBT only. For posts at Sl. No. 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 13, selection will be made through both CBT and Trade Test, with a weightage of 60% for CBT and 40% for Trade Test. There is no negative marking for wrong answers. CBT will be conducted in English and Hindi only.

Computer Based Test (CBT) Details

Type Objective type - 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs), 1 mark each
Duration 120 minutes (2 hours)
Question Paper Composition 60% Technical (domain specific) questions + 40% Non-technical questions (Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, General Knowledge and English)
Language English and Hindi only
Negative Marking No negative marking

Selection Mode - Post-wise

Posts Selection Mode CBT Weightage Trade Test Weightage
SUPT(JOT)-Operator, SUPT(JOT)-Fitter, SUPT(JOT)-Electrical, SUPT(JOT)-Laboratory, SUPT(JOT)-Instrumentation/Instrument Mechanic (Sl. No. 5, 7, 9, 11, 12) CBT only 100% -
Operator (HEMM) Gr. III, Mining Mate Gr. III, Jr. Foreman (Mines), Jr. Foreman (Electrical), Operator Gr. III, Technician (Fitter) Gr. III, Technician (Electrical) Gr. III, Technician (Instrumentation) Gr. III (Sl. No. 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 13) CBT + Trade Test 60% 40%

6 Tamil Nadu Chennai
7 West Bengal Kolkata

NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 - Emoluments & Benefits

Stipend during SUPT Training (12 months) Rs. 12,000/- per month
Stipend during JOT Training - First 12 months Rs. 15,000/- per month
Stipend during JOT Training - Remaining period Rs. 15,500/- per month
Medical Facility during Training Indoor and Outdoor at NALCO Hospital
On Placement (T0 Grade) Rs. 29,500 - 3% - 70,000/- with all regular employee emoluments
Other Benefits on Placement Transport Allowance, HRA / Housing, Site Location Allowance, Leave Travel Allowance, Medical Facility (CHSS), Educational facilities, PF, Gratuity, Group Insurance, Pension (NALCO Defined Contribution Pension Scheme 2025), Performance Linked Incentive Scheme, etc.

How to Apply for NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only through the official NALCO website https://www.nalcoindia.com. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. The online application is a 2-step process -

Step-I: Registration and profile creation

Step-II: Login with credentials, fill application form, upload documents, and make online payment of fee (if applicable). Candidates must carefully furnish all correct details as no change/edit will be allowed after submission. A candidate is allowed to apply for only one post; if multiple applications are submitted for a single post, the latest application will be considered and the rest rejected. If a candidate applies for multiple posts, the candidature will be summarily rejected. Before applying online, candidates must scan and keep ready: passport-size photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20-50 KB), signature (blue/black ink, 10-20 KB), left thumb impression, hand-written declaration, and all relevant certificates.

Documents to be Uploaded at the Time of Online Application:

  • Left Thumb Impression
  • Hand Written Declaration (in English, blue/black ink)
  • Proof of Date of Birth (Matriculation Certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Matriculation mark sheet) (PDF)
  • Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Photo ID issued by Gazetted Officer) (PDF)
  • Educational Certificates - All mark sheets and certificates (Final or Provisional) of Class 10th, ITI, Graduation, Diploma (as applicable) (PDF)
  • Ex-Servicemen eligibility proof with declarations as per latest Government guidelines (if applicable) (PDF)
  • Valid Employment Exchange Registration Card
  • Valid Heavy Vehicle Driving Licence (for Sl. No. 1 - Operator HEMM post)
  • Valid Mining Foreman Certificate of Competency / Electrical Supervisor's Certificate of Competency / Mining Mate Certificate of Competency issued by DGMS (as applicable for the post applied for)
  • National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) with requisite endorsement
  • Latest SC / ST / Disability Certificate / OBC (NCL) Certificate / EWS - Income & Asset Certificate, issued on or after 01-04-2026, in prescribed format (PDF)
  • Experience Certificate (if applicable) in the format given at Annexure-IV, on letterhead of the Organisation, along with offer of appointment and last pay slip
  • Land Ousted candidates - all supporting documents including land documents, legal heir certificate, and affidavit in prescribed format (Annexure-III) on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 25/-

Apply Online at: https://www.nalcoindia.com → Career page → Current Openings → Recruitment of Non-Executive Personnel - M&R Complex, Damanjodi-2026 → View Advertisement → Click here to Apply Online

For any queries: https://ccrs.ibps.in or Toll-free Helpline No. 1800222366 or 18001034566 (09:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days except Saturday, Sunday, and holidays).

Important Instructions for NALCO Non-Executive Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • A candidate is allowed to apply for only one post - applications for multiple posts will result in summary rejection of all applications.
  • Only full-time qualifications from recognized institutes will be considered; ITI/Diploma/B.Sc. must be in the specific branch/trade prescribed for the post.
  • All qualifications and experience must have been acquired on or before the closing date of application (10-06-2026).
  • OBC (NCL) certificate must be issued on or after 01-04-2026 (Central List OBC only - State Government OBC lists are not followed).
  • EWS Income & Asset Certificate must be issued on or after 01-04-2026 based on FY 2025-26 income.
  • PwBD candidates must possess a Disability Certificate certifying minimum 40% disability issued as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. Only permanent (non-temporary) disabilities are eligible for reservation and age relaxation.
  • Land Ousted candidates whose lands have been acquired for the NALCO project at Damanjodi must upload a valid Employment Preference Certificate - maximum age is 40 years as on 10-06-2026.
  • Employees of PSUs/Government organizations must apply through proper channel and produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of document verification.
  • Candidates working in PSUs/Government organizations who fail to produce NOC will not be considered for appointment; their application will be subject to submission of original release order.
  • Application fee once paid shall neither be refunded under any circumstances nor held in reserve for any other recruitment or selection.
  • No documents/certificates and application forms are required to be sent by post.
  • Signature / hand written declaration in CAPITAL LETTERS will NOT be accepted.
  • Electronic gadgets including mobile phones, smartwatches, etc. are not permitted inside the CBT examination hall - carrying them may lead to criminal prosecution.
  • Canvassing in any form during any stage of recruitment will render the candidate ineligible.
  • Any dispute with regard to this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Cuttack (Odisha) only.
  • NALCO does not seek payment of any kind other than the above-mentioned application fee - candidates are cautioned against fraud.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs

Eligibility for forest department jobs depends on the post, state and recruitment authority. Below is a general idea of qualification and age for popular posts like Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer. Candidates should always check the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria.

Education Qualification for Forest Guard, Forester, Ranger

  • Forest Guard / Field Guard / Forest Watcher / Beat Guard: Usually 10th pass or 12th pass from a recognized board, knowledge of local language, and basic physical standards as per state rules.
  • Forester / Section Forest Officer / Deputy Forest Ranger: Generally 12th pass or graduate in any stream or science-related subjects, with physical standards and sometimes driving or technical skills depending on the post.
  • Forest Range Officer (RFO) / Forest Ranger / ACF: Normally graduate degree in Science, Agriculture, Forestry, Environmental Science, Engineering or related disciplines, with higher physical standards and sometimes a competitive exam similar to state PCS level.
  • IFS / Indian Forest Service and senior posts (DCF, CF, CCF, PCCF): Filled through UPSC Indian Forest Service Examination and promotions, requiring a graduate degree and all-India competitive selection.

Age Limit & Relaxation

  • Forest Guard / Forester / Field Guard: Minimum age is usually 18 years and maximum age is around 27–30 years, with age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, Ex-servicemen and other categories as per government rules.
  • Forest Range Officer / ACF and higher competitive posts: Age limit often ranges from 21 to 32 years (varies by recruitment), with relaxations for reserved categories.
  • Exact age limit, cut-off date and relaxation details always depend on the particular notification, so candidates should verify from the official advertisement before applying.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The selection process for Forest Department Jobs 2026 typically includes written examinations, physical tests and document verification. Some posts also conduct medical examination and walking tests due to the demanding nature of field duties.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  • Written Exam: Most Forest Guard, Forester and Forest Range Officer recruitments start with a written exam based on objective-type questions (MCQs).
  • PET / PST (Physical Efficiency Test / Physical Standard Test): Candidates who qualify written exam are called for running, walking test, height, chest measurement and other physical parameters as per post and gender.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates of age, qualification, caste, residence, sports/NCC and other documents mentioned in the notification.
  • Medical Examination: Many forest posts require medical fitness to ensure candidates can perform field duties in forests, wildlife areas and difficult terrain.

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

Typical syllabus for written exam may include:

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs (national, state-level, environment and forest-related topics)
  • General Hindi / English or regional language (grammar, comprehension, vocabulary)
  • General Mathematics / Quantitative Aptitude (up to 10th or 12th level)
  • General Science and Environmental Studies (forest, wildlife, biodiversity, conservation, climate, basic biology)
  • Reasoning Ability (logical and analytical reasoning)

Exact subject-wise marks, number of questions, negative marking and exam duration will be given in the respective forest department notification.

How to Apply for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Most Forest Department Jobs 2026 applications are accepted either online through official websites or offline via prescribed application forms. Candidates should carefully read the official notification before filling the form.

Online Application Process

  1. Visit the official website of the recruiting body (State Forest Department, State PSC, Staff Selection Board or other government portal).
  2. Find the latest link for Forest Guard / Forester / Forest Range Officer / other forest posts and open the detailed advertisement.
  3. Complete the registration process with basic details like name, mobile number, email ID and verify using OTP if required.
  4. Fill the online application form with personal, educational, address and category information exactly as per documents.
  5. Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature and other certificates in the prescribed format and size.
  6. Pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI as per your convenience.
  7. Finally, submit the form and take a printout or PDF of the submitted application and payment receipt for future reference.

  • Recent passport size photograph and signature (scanned)
  • Class 10th and 12th mark sheets and certificates
  • Degree / Diploma certificates for graduate-level posts
  • Caste / Category certificate (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, etc.)
  • Domicile / Residence certificate if required by the state
  • NCC, Sports, Ex-serviceman and other quota certificates if applicable
  • Valid ID proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Passport, etc.)
