Forest department jobs are popular among candidates who love nature, wildlife and field work. These jobs offer job security, government benefits and a chance to work in forest conservation, wildlife protection, eco-tourism and community development.

  • Stable government job with regular salary, pension/NPS and allowances
  • Opportunity to work in forests, wildlife sanctuaries, national parks and protected areas
  • Contribution to environment protection, afforestation and biodiversity conservation
  • Good promotion avenues from Forest Guard to Forester, Forest Range Officer and higher posts in many states.

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has published the Notice for Senior Secretariat Assistant / Upper Division Clerk Grade Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2025 on 05 June 2026 vide No. 4/1/2026-CONF-5. The examination will be held tentatively in July-August 2026 in Delhi NCR only for making additions to the Select List of Senior Secretariat Assistant/Upper Division Clerk Grade [Pay Level-4, Group 'C' Non-Gazetted (Rs. 25,500 - Rs. 81,100)] across 10 participating Services/Cadres. This is a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination open only to eligible serving government employees (JSA/LDC) of the specified participating cadres. The application process is active from 05 June 2026 to 26 June 2026, and candidates can access the notification PDF and apply link below.

SSC SSA/UDC Limited Departmental Competitive Examination 2025 Notification PDF

Staff Selection Commission, Block No.12, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, under the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions, Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India, has officially released the Notice for Senior Secretariat Assistant/Upper Division Clerk Grade Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2025. This is a departmental (internal) exam restricted to eligible Junior Secretariat Assistants (JSA) / Lower Division Clerks (LDC) of the 10 specified participating services/cadres. Candidates are strongly advised to download and read the full advertisement before applying online.

SSC SSA/UDC Limited Departmental Competitive Examination 2025 - Eligibility Criteria

This is a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination open only to serving government employees (JSA/LDC) of the specified participating cadres. Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions as on the crucial date for their respective cadre. The eligibility conditions prescribed in the Notice shall not be relaxed under any circumstances.

Eligibility Conditions (Crucial Date and Service Requirements - Post-wise)

Name of Service / Cadre Crucial Date Conditions of Eligibility
Central Passport Organisation, Ministry of External Affairs 01.07.2025 Junior Passport Assistant with 6 years' service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis and possessing a Bachelor's degree of a recognized university or its equivalent.
Armed Forces Headquarters Clerical Service 01.07.2025 Must have rendered not less than five years approved continuous service in the JSA Grade on the crucial date. Provided that if appointed on the result of a Competitive Examination (including LDCE), the results should have been announced not less than five years before the crucial date and he/she should have rendered not less than four years' approved continuous service. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.
Railway Board Secretariat Clerical Service, Ministry of Railways 01.08.2025 (A) Length of Service: Not less than five years' approved and continuous service in the Lower Division Grade on the crucial date. If appointed on the result of a Competitive Examination (including LDCE), results should have been announced not less than five years before the crucial date and at least four years' approved and continuous service rendered. (B) Typewriting Test: Unless exempted, should have passed the typewriting test on or before the date of notification. (C) Age: Not more than 50 years on the crucial date (relaxable as notified by Central Government).
Central Administrative Tribunal 01.01.2025 Five years regular service in the Lower Division Clerk Grade. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.
Central Vigilance Commission 01.01.2025 Junior Secretariat Assistant who has rendered five years of regular service in the level in pay matrix.
Election Commission of India 01.07.2025 Junior Secretariat Assistant/Lower Division Clerk who has completed a minimum of three years regular service in the grade. If appointed on the result of a competitive examination (including LDCE), results should have been announced not less than three years before the crucial date and at least 2 years' approved and continuous service rendered. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.
Forest Survey of India, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change 01.01.2025 Lower Division Clerk having five years of regular service in the grade in Forest Survey of India. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.
National Technical Research Organisation 01.01.2025 Junior Secretariat Assistant/Lower Division Clerk of NTRO having five years of regular service in the grade. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.
Directorate General, Defence Estates 01.01.2025 Hindi Typist who has rendered five years regular service. Age: Not more than 45 years of age on the crucial date.
Office of Development Commissioner, Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises 01.01.2025 Lower Division Clerk of MSME-DO in the Level-2 as per 7th CPC with five years of regular service in the Grade. JSAs on deputation to ex-cadre posts with approval and those having lien in JSA grade are also eligible.

SSC SSA/UDC Limited Departmental Competitive Examination 2025 - Selection Process & Exam Pattern

The examination consists of two parts: Part-I (Computer Based & Written Examination, 300 marks) and Part-II (Evaluation of Record of Service/APARs, 100 marks). Total marks = 400. Final selection will be made on the basis of aggregate performance in all parts. This is a competitive and not a qualifying examination.

Part-I: Computer Based & Written Examination (300 Marks)

Subject Paper No. No. of Questions Maximum Marks Time Duration Mode
General Awareness Paper-I 100 200 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for Scribe) Computer Based Examination (Objective Type Multiple Choice)
English Language and Comprehension 100
Noting, Drafting & Office Procedure Paper-II -- 100 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for candidates eligible for Scribe) Written Examination (Descriptive / Conventional type)

Note: There will be negative marking of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in Computer Based Examination (Paper-I). Candidates have to attempt the examination in the language (English/Hindi) as opted in the online Application Form. There will be no Question Paper in Braille for Visually Handicapped candidates.

Part-II: Evaluation of Record of Service (100 Marks)

Marks 100 marks earmarked for evaluation of record of service (APARs - Annual Performance Assessment Reports)
Usage Marks obtained in Part-II will be added for ascertaining the rank of the candidate. Once the APARs have been evaluated, no request for change in APAR grading will be entertained by the Commission under any circumstances.

Syllabus of the Examination

Paper Subject Syllabus / Topics
Paper-I (CBE) General Awareness Questions aimed at testing General Awareness of the environment around and its application to society. Current events; matters of everyday observations and experience in their scientific aspect; History, Culture, Geography, Economics, Science, General Politics and Scientific research relating to India and neighboring countries.
Paper-I (CBE) English Language and Comprehension Understanding and knowledge of English language: Vocabulary, spelling, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, sentence completion, phrases and idiomatic use of words, comprehension of a passage. Questions will be of matriculation level.
Paper-II (Written/Descriptive) Noting, Drafting & Office Procedure Knowledge of office procedure in the Secretariat and Attached Offices; ability to write and understand notes and drafts. Candidates are required to study the Manual of Office Procedure (including Ministry of Railways version), the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, Hand Book of orders issued by Ministry of Home Affairs regarding use of Hindi for official purpose of the Union, and Reservation Policy for SC/STs in services and orders issued by Government thereon from time to time.

Mode of Selection

Step 1 Based on performance in Paper-I (CBE) of Part-I, candidates will be shortlisted for evaluation of Paper-II (Descriptive Paper) of Part-I. Candidates not qualifying Paper-I will not be evaluated for Paper-II and will not be considered for further selection.
Step 2 Based on aggregate performance in Paper-I and Paper-II of Part-I, candidates will be shortlisted for evaluation of record of service (Part-II). Candidates not qualifying Part-I aggregate will not be eligible for Part-II evaluation.
Step 3 Final selection will be made on the basis of aggregate performance of candidates in Paper-I (CBE) + Paper-II (Descriptive) of Part-I and Part-II (APAR Evaluation). The Commission may fix minimum qualifying marks individually for Paper-I and Paper-II of Part-I.

Tie-Breaking Rules

1st Tie-Break Marks obtained in Paper-II (Descriptive)
2nd Tie-Break Marks obtained in part (b) of Paper-I (English Language and Comprehension)
3rd Tie-Break Date of birth - older candidates placed higher
4th Tie-Break Alphabetical order in which the names of the candidates appear

How to Apply for SSC SSA/UDC Limited Departmental Competitive Examination 2025

The Application Form must be submitted only in online mode on the SSC website https://ssc.gov.in. The process consists of two parts: (i) One Time Registration (OTR) and (ii) Filling of online Application Form for the Examination. Candidates who have not generated their OTR on the new website (https://ssc.gov.in) will be required to do so; the earlier OTR generated on the old website (https://ssc.nic.in) will not be functional for the new website.

After completion of online Application Form, the printed copy accompanied with necessary documents must be duly forwarded by the respective Service/Cadre Controlling Authority to "The Regional Director, Staff Selection Commission (Northern Region), Block No.12, C.G.O. Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003" so as to reach by 03.07.2026 (1800 hrs). Only those candidates whose application is forwarded by their Head of Department/Head of Office will be considered for admission to this Examination.

Documents to be Uploaded with Online Application:

  • Certified true copy of the first page of the Service Book duly attested by Head of Department/Head of Office (showing Name, Father's Name, Husband's Name, Nationality, SC/ST Name if applicable, Date of Birth)
  • Certified true copy of particulars of service attested by Head of Department/Head of Office (posts held, scale of pay, nature of appointment - substantive/officiating/permanent/temporary)
  • Copy of certificate of essential educational qualification, if applicable
  • Form of certificate for disabled Defence Personnel while in service, wherever applicable
  • Certificate of disability in case of PwBD candidates
  • Live photograph captured through the application module (plain background, no cap/mask/glasses, full frontal view)
  • Scanned signature in JPEG format (10 to 20 KB; image dimension about 6.0 cm width x 2.0 cm height)

Apply Online at: https://ssc.gov.in

Important Instructions for SSC SSA/UDC Departmental Examination 2025 Candidates

  • This is a Limited Departmental Competitive Examination - only eligible serving JSA/LDC employees of the specified 10 participating cadres can apply.
  • Only one application form should be submitted; submission of multiple applications may lead to rejection of candidature.
  • After completion of online application, the printed copy must be forwarded by the Head of Department/Office through proper channel to reach SSC (NR) by 03.07.2026 (1800 hrs); applications not forwarded through proper channel will not be considered.
  • A candidate who resigns, quits service, or whose services are terminated after applying will not be eligible for appointment on the result of this examination.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the notification for the Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) / Lower Division Clerk (LDC) Grade Limited Departmental Competitive Examination (LDCE), 2025 vide Notice No. 4/4/2026-CONF-5, to fill 149 vacancies across 12 Central Government departments and cadres. The online application window is open from 05th June 2026 to 26th June 2026 (up to 11:00 PM). Please note this is a limited departmental examination - only existing regular Group 'C' / Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) employees of the participating cadres are eligible, and every application must be forwarded through proper channel by the Head of Department/Office. The Computer Based Examination is tentatively scheduled for July–August 2026 and will be held in Delhi-NCR only. Check the complete eligibility, vacancy break-up, exam pattern, and step-by-step process below.

Important: Who Can Apply (and Who Cannot)

Because this is an LDCE (Limited Departmental Competitive Examination), eligibility is far narrower than an open recruitment. Read this before anything else - it is the most common point of confusion.

You CAN apply only if all of the following are true:

  • You are a regularly appointed Group 'C' employee or Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) in Level-1 / Grade Pay ₹1,800 of one of the 12 participating cadres listed below.
  • You have completed at least 3 years of regular service in that grade as on your cadre's crucial date.
  • You have passed Class 12th (Higher Secondary) or equivalent from a recognised Board.
  • Your application is forwarded by your Head of Department / Head of Office to SSC (Northern Region).

You CANNOT apply if:

  • You are a fresh candidate / general public with no qualifying government service - this exam is not open to private-sector or unemployed applicants.
  • You work in a department that is not among the 12 participating cadres.
  • Your application is not forwarded through proper channel - direct/self-submitted hard copies will be summarily rejected.

SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025 - Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Candidates must have passed the 12th standard (Higher Secondary) examination from a recognised Board or equivalent. For the Railway Board Secretariat Clerical Service, candidates are additionally required to pass a typing test (35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi on computer) within one year of appointment.

Length of Service

A minimum of three years of regular service as a Group 'C' employee / MTS in Level-1 (Grade Pay ₹1,800) in the respective cadre, counted as on the crucial date applicable to that cadre.

Crucial Date (Varies by Cadre)

Age Limit & Relaxation

SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025 - Application Fee

(A separate, non-refundable charge of ₹50 per question applies only if a candidate later chooses to challenge the tentative answer key - this is unrelated to the application itself.)

How to Apply for SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025

The process has two parts - One Time Registration (OTR) followed by the application - plus a mandatory offline forwarding step. Follow these steps:

  1. Generate OTR on the new website. Visit ssc.gov.in and click "Register Now." Any OTR created on the old site (ssc.nic.in) will not work on the new portal.
  2. Opt for Aadhaar-Based Authentication during OTR (recommended). Candidates who skip Aadhaar must upload the prescribed proof documents.
  3. Log in with your Registration Number and password, then open the JSA/LDC LDCE 2025 link under the "Live Exam" tab and click Apply.
  4. Fill the application - service details, cadre, crucial date, length of service, and age-relaxation code (if any). Information auto-filled from OTR is non-editable; use "Modify Registration" if a correction is needed.
  5. Capture your live photograph and upload your signature as per the specifications (see below).
  6. Upload the required documents (listed below) and Submit. Take a printout of the submitted application.
  7. Forward the hard copy through proper channel. Your Head of Department / Head of Office must forward the printed application along with service documents to: The Regional Director, Staff Selection Commission (Northern Region), Block No. 12, CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003, so as to reach by 03-07-2026 (6:00 PM) - or 10-07-2026 for candidates abroad/A&N/Lakshadweep.

Critical: Only applications forwarded by the Head of Department/Office will be admitted. A correctly submitted online form alone is not enough.

Documents to Keep Ready Before You Start

  • Certified true copy of the first page of your Service Book (attested by HoD/HoO)
  • Certified particulars of service (posts held, scale of pay, nature of appointment)
  • Class 12th certificate / educational qualification proof (if applicable)
  • Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST), if claiming reservation
  • Disability certificate (Annexure-VII / VIII) for PwBD candidates
  • A recent passport-size photo for the live capture reference, and a scanned signature

Photograph & Signature Specifications

  • Photograph: Captured live via webcam/phone, in a well-lit area with a plain background. No cap, mask, or spectacles. Face must fill the on-screen red rectangle. Pre-existing/scanned photos are rejected.
  • Signature: JPEG/JPG, 10–20 KB, dimensions about 6.0 cm × 2.0 cm. Sign so the signature fills at least 80% of the box. Blurred or miniature signatures are rejected.

SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025 - Exam Pattern & Scheme

The examination carries 260 marks in total - 200 for Part-I (the exams) and 60 for Part-II (service record). Note that Paper-I is descriptive (written) and Paper-II is the objective Computer Based Test (CBT).

Part-I: Written + Computer Based Examination (200 Marks)

Paper Type Section Questions Max Marks Duration
Paper-I Descriptive (Written) Short Essay – 100 1 hr 30 min*
Paper-II Objective (CBT) (a) Language - General English or Samanya Hindi 50 50 2 hrs*
Paper-II Objective (CBT) (b) General Knowledge 50 50 (combined)

*Scribe-eligible candidates get 2 hours for Paper-I and 2 hours 40 minutes for Paper-II, plus 20 minutes compensatory time per hour.

  • Negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer applies to Paper-II (CBT) only. There is no negative marking in the descriptive Paper-I.
  • Candidates must attempt the exam in the language (English/Hindi) chosen in the application form.

Part-II: Evaluation of Record of Service (60 Marks)

60 marks are reserved for evaluation of the APARs (Annual Performance Appraisal Reports). These marks are added to determine the final rank. Once evaluated, no request to change APAR grading is entertained.

SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025 - Selection Process

This is a competitive, not qualifying examination. Selection proceeds stage by stage:

  1. Paper-II (CBT) qualifying: Candidates must clear the minimum marks fixed for Paper-II to have their Paper-I evaluated.
  2. Paper-I (Descriptive) evaluation: Only those qualifying in Paper-II have their descriptive paper assessed.
  3. APAR evaluation (Part-II): Based on the aggregate of Paper-I + Paper-II, shortlisted candidates move to service-record evaluation.
  4. Final merit: Prepared on the combined total of Paper-I + Paper-II + Part-II (APAR) = 260 marks, cadre-wise, subject to reservation. Ties are resolved by Paper-I marks, then Paper-II part (a), then Paper-II total, then date of birth (older ranked higher), then alphabetical order.

SSC JSA / LDC LDCE 2025 - Syllabus

  • Paper-I (Short Essay): One essay of 400–500 words on any of the specified subjects.
  • Paper-II (a) Language: Simple composition and applied grammar (in the chosen English/Hindi medium).
  • Paper-II (b) General Knowledge: Current events, matters of everyday observation and experience, and general information about India.

SSC JSA / LDC Salary 2026

Selected candidates are appointed in Pay Level-2 (₹19,900 – ₹63,200 per month) under the 7th CPC, as Group 'C' Non-Gazetted staff. In addition to basic pay, employees are entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance, and other benefits as admissible under Central Government rules for the respective department.

Common Reasons SSC Applications Get Rejected

A large share of LDCE applications fail on avoidable mistakes. Double-check all of these before submitting:

  • Application not forwarded by the Head of Department/Office (the single biggest cause of rejection).
  • Multiple applications submitted for the same exam.
  • Photograph with a cap/spectacles, dark background, blurred, or a pre-existing (scanned) photo instead of a live capture.
  • Signature that is blurred, miniature, or below the size norm.
  • Wrong OTR details - name, father's/mother's name, or date of birth not matching the matriculation certificate (OTR data is non-editable).
  • Hard copy reaching SSC-NR after the deadline, or incomplete documents.

What to Do If the SSC Website Is Slow

Traffic on the SSC portal spikes near the closing date. If you face issues:

  • Apply during off-peak hours - late at night or early morning - rather than on the last day.
  • Clear your browser cache/cookies, or use an incognito/private tab.
  • Try a different browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge) or switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data.
  • Keep all documents pre-scanned and ready in the correct format so a session timeout doesn't cost you the whole form.
  • Save a draft frequently and take a printout immediately after final submission.

Exam Day Guidelines

  • The exam is conducted in Delhi-NCR only; there is no centre abroad. A candidate posted abroad must appear in India at their own expense.
  • The Admission Certificate is issued online via sscnr.nic.in (3–4 days before the exam); it is never sent by post.
  • Carry your original Departmental Identity Card along with a hard copy of the Admission Certificate.
  • Candidates not Aadhaar-authenticated during OTR must report early with two passport-size photographs and an original photo ID showing date of birth.
  • No Travelling Allowance is paid by SSC.
  • Mobile phones, Bluetooth/wireless devices, smartwatches, and electronic gadgets are strictly prohibited. SSC conducts post-exam log, biometric, and CCTV analysis, and malpractice attracts debarment of 1 to 7 years depending on the offence.

  • SSC (Northern Region): 011-24363343
  • Official Websites: ssc.gov.in (HQ) · sscnr.nic.in (Northern Region)

The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued Circular DEP-02/2026 inviting applications for 15 Group A and Group C posts — Joint Director, Manager (IT), and Junior Assistant Grade-II — to be filled on deputation (including short-term contract) on Foreign Service terms. Eligible government officers can apply online on www.fssai.gov.in from 06 June 2026 to 26 June 2026.

Quick Summary: FSSAI DEP-02/2026 Notification

Here's a quick overview of the FSSAI deputation notice for candidates who want the essential details before reading the complete breakdown below.

Particulars Details
Organization Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)
Notice No. Circular DEP-02/2026
Mode of Recruitment Deputation (including Short Term Contract) on Foreign Service Terms
Total Vacancies 15 (Joint Director: 3, Manager IT: 2, Junior Assistant Grade-II: 10)
Application Mode Online via "jobs@fssai (careers)" tab on www.fssai.gov.in
Application Start Date 06 June 2026
Application Closing Date 26 June 2026
Hard Copy Last Date 20 July 2026 (tentative)
Maximum Age Limit 56 years (as on closing date of online application)
Place of Posting Anywhere in India

Important Dates for FSSAI Deputation Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply on deputation should note these key dates carefully, as applications submitted outside this window through any mode other than the FSSAI portal will not be considered.

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 06 June 2026
Online Application Closing Date 26 June 2026
Cut-off Date for Eligibility 26 June 2026 (closing date of online application)
Last Date for Receipt of Hard Copy (Tentative) 20 July 2026

FSSAI has clearly specified that the cut-off date for ascertaining eligibility is the closing date of online applications, i.e., 26 June 2026, and only applications submitted online through the FSSAI portal within the due date will be considered.

FSSAI DEP-02/2026 Vacancy Details: Post-wise Breakdown

FSSAI is looking to fill a total of 15 posts across Group A and Group C categories through deputation. The table below shows the post name, pay level, number of vacancies, and tenure for each position.

Post Code Post Name Classification Pay Level (7th CPC) Pay Scale Vacancies Tenure (Years)
DEP-02/2026-01 Joint Director Group A Level-12 ₹78,800–₹2,09,200 3 1
DEP-02/2026-02 Manager (IT) Group A Level-11 ₹67,700–₹2,08,700 2 2
DEP-02/2026-04 Junior Assistant Grade-II Group C Level-02 ₹19,900–₹63,200 10 3

The indicative place of posting for all three posts is "Anywhere in India," and FSSAI has clarified that the vacancies shown are indicative and may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Competent Authority.

Eligibility Criteria for FSSAI Deputation Posts 2026

Applicants wondering whether they qualify for these deputation posts can check the eligibility conditions below, which cover the parent cadre requirements, regular service experience, and educational qualifications for each post.

Joint Director (Pay Level-12) – Eligibility

This Group A post is open to officers from Central/State Government, Union Territories, Government Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, PSUs, or Semi-Government/Statutory/Autonomous Organizations who meet the following criteria:

  • (a) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department, OR with 5 years of regular service in Pay Level-11 or equivalent in the parent cadre/department; AND
  • (b) A Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University (MBA desirable), OR
  • (c) A full-time Degree in Law from a recognized University, OR
  • (d) A Master's Degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Food Technology, Food Science & Technology, Food & Nutrition, Edible Oil Technology, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, Agricultural/Horticultural Sciences, Industrial Microbiology, Toxicology, Public Health, Life Science, Biotechnology, Fruit & Vegetable Technology, Food Safety & Quality Assurance, or any other subject approved by FSSAI, OR a one-year PG Diploma in Food Safety and Quality Assurance, OR a BE/B.Tech in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Food Process Engineering, Food Processing Technology, Fruit & Vegetable Technology, Food Safety & Quality Assurance, or a Bachelor's degree (minimum 4 years) in Medicine, Veterinary Sciences, Fisheries, or Animal Sciences, OR
  • (e) A Doctorate Degree in any of the above subjects along with published research work in the related field.

Manager (IT) (Pay Level-11) – Eligibility

Officers from Central/State Government, Union Territories, Government Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, PSUs, or Semi-Government/Statutory/Autonomous Organizations are eligible if they meet the following:

  • (a) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department, OR with 3 years of regular service in Pay Level-7 or equivalent; AND
  • (b) A B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or any related Engineering discipline, OR an MCA, OR a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field.

Junior Assistant Grade-II (Pay Level-02) – Eligibility

This Group C post requires officers from Central/State Government, Union Territories, Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, PSUs, or Semi-Government/Statutory/Autonomous Organizations to meet:

  • (a) Holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department, OR with 3 years of regular service in Pay Level-1 or equivalent, with experience in handling diary/dispatch and computer typing; AND
  • (b) 12th Standard (or equivalent) from a recognized Board or University.

Age Limit for FSSAI Deputation Recruitment 2026

The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation under this notice is 56 years, calculated as on the last day of receiving online applications, i.e., 26 June 2026. There is no separate relaxed age category mentioned for this deputation cycle.

Tenure and Nature of Deputation

Candidates often ask how long a deputation appointment at FSSAI lasts and whether it can be extended — here's what the circular specifies.

  • Appointments on deputation/Foreign Service Terms (including short-term contract) shall be for a period not exceeding one, two, or three years depending on the post in the first instance.
  • The Joint Director post carries a tenure of 1 year, Manager (IT) carries 2 years, and Junior Assistant Grade-II carries 3 years.
  • The tenure may be extended subject to availability of vacancy, based on Government of India guidelines, performance appraisal of the deputationist, and in consultation with the parent department.
  • Deputation to these posts is exempted from the rule of immediate absorption.
  • Terms of deputation, including pay, will be governed by DoPT Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17th June 2010 and other applicable orders/guidelines.

Pay Scale and IDA-CDA Equivalency for FSSAI Posts

Officials currently working in organizations that follow the IDA (Industrial Dearness Allowance) pay structure instead of CDA (Central Dearness Allowance) can refer to FSSAI's official IDA-CDA equivalency table (Annexure-II) to check their eligibility for these posts.

This equivalency, issued via Office Memorandum dated 9th October 2023, supersedes earlier equivalency norms and is effective immediately for all future FSSAI recruitments on Deputation/DR basis.

How to Apply for FSSAI Deputation Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates need to follow a specific online application process, supported by a hard-copy application countersigned by their employer. Here's the step-by-step procedure:

  1. Visit the official FSSAI website at www.fssai.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "jobs@fssai (careers)" tab and locate the online application link for Circular DEP-02/2026.
  3. Register and fill in the online application form, ensuring all details match your service records.
  4. Confirm that you fulfill the eligibility criteria as on the closing date, 26 June 2026.
  5. Submit the application online between 06 June 2026 and 26 June 2026 — applications not submitted online through FSSAI's portal will not be considered.
  6. Take a printout of the finally submitted online application form.
  7. Get the "Certification by the Employer/Cadre Controlling Authority" section completed and countersigned by your employer, confirming no vigilance/disciplinary case is pending, integrity is certified, and CR Dossier/APARs for the last 5 years are enclosed.
  8. Forward the countersigned hard copy along with NOC, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate, and attested APARs through proper channel, with the tentative last date being 20 July 2026.

Special Note for Candidates Who Applied Under DEP-01/2025

Candidates who had already applied for Joint Director (Post Code: DEP-01/2025-02) or Manager (IT) (Post Code: DEP-01/2025-06) under the earlier deputation notice DEP-01/2025 need not apply again. However, such applicants must ensure that all required documents — countersigned hard copy of the finally submitted online application, certified APARs, NOC, and Integrity/Vigilance clearance certificates — have been submitted through proper channel. If any document is pending, it should be submitted within the current due date for receiving hard copies.

Documents Required for Employer Certification

The hard copy of the application must be accompanied by a certification from the applicant's employer or Cadre Controlling Authority. This certification confirms several important points about the candidate's service record:

  • The information provided in the application is true and correct as per official records.
  • The applicant possesses the educational qualifications and experience mentioned in the vacancy circular.
  • If selected, the applicant will be relieved immediately.
  • No vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the applicant.
  • The applicant's integrity is certified.
  • CR Dossier/APARs for the last 5 years, attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary (Govt. of India) or above, are enclosed.
  • A statement on whether any major/minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years (or a list of such penalties, if any).

Eligibility Restrictions: Who Cannot Apply

Not every government employee is eligible to apply for these FSSAI deputation posts. The circular specifically excludes one category of officers from consideration.

Departmental officers in the feeder cadre category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation to these posts.

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying for FSSAI Deputation Posts

Since this is a deputation-based recruitment requiring employer involvement, applicants should be extra careful to avoid the following common errors:

  • Don't skip the employer certification: Without the countersigned certification from your Cadre Controlling Authority, your hard copy application will be incomplete.
  • Don't apply if you're in the direct line of promotion in the feeder cadre: Such departmental officers are explicitly barred from consideration.
  • Don't miss the online deadline: Applications received via email, post, or any mode other than the FSSAI online portal within 06–26 June 2026 will not be considered.
  • Don't forget APARs and Vigilance Clearance: Ensure attested APARs for the last 5 years and a Vigilance Clearance Certificate are enclosed with the hard copy.
  • Re-applicants from DEP-01/2025: If you already applied for Joint Director or Manager (IT) under DEP-01/2025, don't reapply — instead, verify your earlier documents have reached FSSAI through proper channel.
  • Check IDA-CDA equivalency carefully: If your salary is on IDA basis, cross-check your pay scale against Annexure-II before applying to ensure you meet the eligibility for the post's pay level.

Coal India Limited MT Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

The selection process for CIL MT Recruitment 2026 consists of a Computer Based Online Test (CBT) only. There will be NO interview for final selection. The CBT will be of 3 hours duration (in one sitting) consisting of two papers of 100 marks each. Paper-I covers General Knowledge/Awareness, Reasoning, Numerical Ability and General English. Paper-II covers Professional Knowledge (Discipline related). Each question carries 1 mark and there is NO penalty for wrong answers. No marks will be awarded for un-attempted questions. The question paper will be bilingual (English and Hindi); in case of any error in Hindi version, the English version will be valid and final.

Candidates may opt for three Test Cities in order of preference (cannot be changed after submission). CIL reserves the right to allocate any Test City other than opted and to add/delete cities based on applicant numbers.

NHSRCL will use a multi-stage selection process for all posts under Vacancy Notices 08/2026 to 20/2026. The Computer Based Test (CBT) for all posts from 08/2026 to 20/2026 may be conducted on the same day and at the same time, which is an important reason why candidates can apply for only one post.

  2. Interview
  3. Medical Examination

Management reserves the right to include or dispense with any of these selection stages as deemed fit. Depending on the volume of applications received, NHSRCL may raise or relax eligibility criteria or prescribe additional written tests. The management's decision regarding selection is final. Outstation candidates called for interview will be paid travelling allowance as per company rules.

How to Apply

Applications for NHSRCL Vacancy Notices 08/2026 to 20/2026 must be submitted online as per the "Guidelines to Apply" published on the official NHSRCL website. Incomplete applications or applications without supporting documents will be rejected without any correspondence. The following steps outline the application process.

  1. Visit the official NHSRCL website and refer to the "Guidelines to Apply" document for the complete online application procedure.
  2. Register and fill in the application form in the prescribed format only.
  3. Pay the application fee of Rs. 400/- if you belong to UR, EWS, or OBC category (SC/ST/Women are exempted). Note that transaction processing charges are additional and also non-refundable.
  4. Upload all supporting documents as required by the application portal. Applications without supporting documents will be summarily rejected.
  5. Submit only one application across all vacancy notices 08/2026 to 20/2026. Multiple submissions are not permitted.
  6. Note your registration number and monitor your registered email (including spam folder) and the official NHSRCL website regularly for updates.

NHSRCL will not be responsible for any postal delay, wrong delivery, or non-delivery of communication at any stage. All official communication will be sent to the candidate's registered email address only.

Troubleshooting and Common Mistakes to Avoid

Online application portals for government recruitment can be error-prone, especially as deadlines approach. The following general precautions will help you avoid common technical and procedural mistakes.

  • Apply well before the deadline: Server load increases significantly on the last day. Attempting to pay or submit on the final date risks timeouts, failed transactions, and missed deadlines.
  • Verify payment before closing the window: If a payment gateway transaction fails or remains pending, wait a few minutes and check your bank statement before retrying. Duplicate payments are generally not refunded.
  • Save your registration number immediately: Note down your registration number and application ID as soon as you register. Without it, recovering your application or accessing admit cards later becomes difficult.
  • Check photo and document upload specifications: Government portals typically specify file size limits (e.g., 20100 KB for photos) and accepted formats (JPG/PDF). Uploading files outside these limits causes silent rejection of uploads.
  • Use a compatible browser: If the portal does not load correctly, try a different browser or disable browser extensions. Avoid mobile browsers for the final submission step.
  • Check spam/junk mail: NHSRCL explicitly advises candidates to monitor their spam folders. Shortlisting communications and CBT admit card links are sent to the registered email only.
  • Do not count ineligible experience: Experience from teaching, faculty roles, apprenticeships, internships, proprietorship, partnership, or freelancing will not be counted. Ensure only qualifying service is reflected in your application.
  • One application only: Submitting applications for more than one post under Vacancy Notices 08/2026 to 20/2026 is explicitly not permitted. Ensure you apply for the single most appropriate post before submitting.

Walk-In Time 10:00 hrs to 13:00 hrs
Venue Building No. 30-D, SAC-ISRO, Jodhpur Tekra, Ahmedabad – 380015
Selection Basis First Come, First Serve
Application Mode Offline (in-person only)

Download SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF

What Is the SAC ISRO Apprenticeship Recruitment 2026? 

SAC ISRO's apprenticeship program is a structured, government-regulated training initiative conducted under the Apprentices Act, 1961. The Space Applications Centre at Ahmedabad - responsible for remote sensing, satellite communication, and space-based applications research - offers hands-on training exposure to fresh graduates, diploma holders, and ITI-qualified candidates in technical and non-technical streams.

This is not a permanent job offer. The apprenticeship is a one-year training contract that gives candidates valuable on-the-job experience within ISRO's operational environment - a significant credential for any engineering or science fresher.

SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Post Codes and Disciplines

SAC has notified 16 post codes covering three categories of apprentices. Each category has distinct educational requirements and eligible disciplines.

Graduate Apprentice (Post Codes 01–05)

Graduate Apprentices must hold a B.E. / B.Tech. / B.Arch. / B.Com / B.Lib or an equivalent qualification from a Government-recognized University, Board, or Institute with a minimum aggregate of 60% marks.

Post Code Discipline
01 Electronics & Communication Engineering
02 Mechanical Engineering
03 Architecture
04 Bachelor of Commerce
05 Library Science / Library & Information Science

Technician Apprentice (Post Codes 06–08)

Technician Apprentices must have a Diploma in Engineering or Technology in the relevant field with First Class from a recognized State Board of Technical Education.

Post Code Discipline
06 Electronics & Communication Engineering
07 Mechanical Engineering
08 Civil Engineering

Trade Apprentice (Post Codes 09–16)

Trade Apprentices must have passed SSC / Matriculation / 10th and hold an ITI (NTC/STC) certificate in the relevant trade from a recognized institute.

Post Code Trade
09 COPA
10 Painter (General)
11 Draughtsman Mechanical
12 Machinist
13 Fitter
14 Attendant Operator Chemical Plant
15 Refrigeration and Air-Conditioning
16 Electronics Mechanic

SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Candidates should carefully read all eligibility conditions before appearing for the walk-in. Appearing without meeting these conditions will result in disqualification.

Nationality

Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply for SAC ISRO Apprentice 2026.

State-Wise Eligibility Condition

This is one of the most important eligibility filters and is frequently misunderstood by applicants.

  • Graduate and Technician Apprentices (Post Codes 01–08): Candidates must have obtained their Degree or Diploma from a Government-recognized University/Board/Institute located in any of the following states/UTs:
    • Maharashtra
    • Gujarat
    • Goa
    • Chhattisgarh
    • Madhya Pradesh
    • Rajasthan
    • Dadra Nagar Haveli & Daman & Diu (UT)
  • Trade Apprentices (Post Codes 09–16): Candidates must have completed their ITI (NTC/STC) from a recognized institute in Gujarat State only.

Educational Qualification

  • Graduate Apprentice: Minimum 60% aggregate in B.E./B.Tech./B.Arch./B.Com/B.Lib or equivalent.
  • Technician Apprentice: First Class in Diploma in Engineering/Technology in the relevant discipline.
  • Trade Apprentice: SSC/10th pass + ITI (NTC/STC) in the relevant trade.

Age Limit

Post Codes Minimum Age Maximum Age
01 to 08 (Graduate & Technician) 18 years 28 years
09 to 16 (Trade Apprentices) 18 years 35 years

Age is calculated as on the date of joining.

Age Relaxation:

  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 3 years relaxation in upper age
  • SC / ST candidates: 5 years relaxation in upper age
  • PwBD candidates: As per Government of India rules

Year of Passing Condition

Candidates who passed their Degree/Diploma/ITI in or after July 2023 are eligible. Candidates who have completed three or more years since obtaining their qualifying degree as on the expected date of joining are not eligible, even if they passed after July 2023.

Prior Apprenticeship or Work Experience

Candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing any apprenticeship training, or who have one year or more of job experience as on the date of joining, are not eligible.

SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Stipend

The monthly stipend offered to selected apprentices is fixed by the Government and varies by apprentice category.

Apprentice Type Monthly Stipend
Graduate Apprentice ₹12,300/- per month
Technician Apprentice ₹10,900/- per month
Trade Apprentice (Post Code 09 – COPA) ₹10,560/- per month
Trade Apprentice (Post Codes 10–16) ₹11,040/- per month

The training period is 12 months from the date of execution of the Apprenticeship contract.

SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Walk-In Schedule and Venue

Unlike most central government recruitment processes, this apprenticeship follows a walk-in, first-come-first-serve model. No online application or postal submission is accepted.

  • Walk-In Dates: 20 June 2026 to 03 July 2026
  • Days: All working days (Saturdays, Sundays, and declared holidays excluded)
  • Walk-In Timing: 10:00 hrs to 13:00 hrs
  • Venue: Building No. 30-D (Recruitment Section), Space Applications Centre, ISRO, Jodhpur Tekra, Ahmedabad – 380015

Important: On arrival at SAC, candidates must enter their details in the attendance sheet to confirm their order of appearance. This is mandatory.

SAC ISRO Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Documents Required

Candidates must carry self-attested photocopies of all required documents along with originals at the time of the walk-in. Missing documents may lead to rejection of the application on the spot.

 

  • Mandatory documents for all candidates:
  • Proof of Date of Birth (10th passing certificate / School Leaving Certificate / Birth Certificate)
  • Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
  • SSC (10th) Marksheet and Certificate
  • Qualifying Exam Marksheets & Certificates:
  • Trade Apprentices: ITI (NTC/STC) in the relevant trade
  • Technician Apprentices: Final/Provisional Diploma + all semester marksheets
  • Graduate Apprentices: Final/Provisional Degree + all semester marksheets
  • Latest OBC (NCL – FY 2026-27) Certificate, if applicable
  • Caste/Tribe Certificate (SC/ST), if applicable
  • PwBD Certificate, if applicable
  • EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable
  • Local Police Verification cum Character Certificate (in Original)
  • Blood Group Report
  • SBI Bank Account details

Portal Registration (mandatory before walk-in):

  • Trade Apprentices: Register at https://apprenticeshipindia.org
  • Graduate & Technician Apprentices: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in

 

How to Apply

The application process is entirely offline and in-person. There is no provision for online, email, or postal submission of applications.

  1. Download and fill the official application form attached to the SAC notification (available on the official ISRO/SAC website).
  2. Register on the appropriate apprenticeship portal (NATS or Apprenticeship India) before appearing for the walk-in.
  3. Gather all required documents in self-attested photocopies along with originals.
  4. Visit Building No. 30-D, Space Applications Centre, ISRO, Jodhpur Tekra, Ahmedabad – 380015, on any working day between 20 June and 3 July 2026 during 10:00–13:00 hrs.
  5. Enter your name in the attendance sheet on arrival - this is mandatory to confirm your order in the first-come-first-serve queue.
  6. Submit your application personally at the Recruitment Section.

Applications submitted by post or email will not be considered under any circumstances.

Selection Process

There is no written examination or interview for this apprenticeship. Selection is done purely on a first-come-first-serve basis, subject to verification of documents and eligibility.

  • Candidates appearing earlier in the walk-in period have a higher chance of selection, given limited seats.
  • If any discrepancy is found in name, age, qualification results, year of passing, or caste/tribe details at any stage, the candidature will be immediately disqualified.
  • Candidates who do not meet medical fitness criteria at the time of joining will have their candidature cancelled automatically.

Important Terms and Conditions

Understanding these conditions is critical before appearing for the walk-in, as violations at any stage lead to disqualification.

  • Apprentices will have no claim for regular employment at SAC-ISRO, any other ISRO Centre, or under the Department of Space after completion of training.
  • The apprenticeship contract is registered under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Amendment Act, 1973.
  • Candidates in existing Government service must disclose this in their application.
  • Seats are limited; early walk-in increases your chance of selection.
  • All decisions regarding eligibility, selection, and joining rest with SAC-ISRO administration.

Why Apply for SAC ISRO Apprenticeship 2026?

For engineering and science freshers, an apprenticeship at ISRO's Space Applications Centre is a rare opportunity that carries significant weight in the job market and for higher studies abroad. Here's why candidates across disciplines actively seek this opportunity:

  • Prestigious credential - ISRO is among the world's leading space agencies; SAC-specific experience adds unique value to a resume.
  • Government-regulated stipend - Monthly stipend of up to ₹12,300 during the training year.
  • Hands-on technical exposure - Direct involvement in space-application projects across electronics, mechanical, civil, and IT domains.
  • NATS/Apprenticeship India certification - Completion leads to a nationally recognized apprenticeship certificate useful for both private-sector jobs and government competitive exams.
  • No bond or service obligation - Unlike some training programs, there is no post-training bond.

Source: Official Notice No. SAC: RMT: APP: 2026 dated 08.06.2026, issued by the Administrative Officer, Space Applications Centre (ISRO), Ahmedabad.

No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the Interview or for testimonials checking.

  • Dependents of Ex-Servicemen claiming Ex-Servicemen reservation; the benefit is available only to Ex-Servicemen themselves.
  • Candidates with less than 40% disability, or with disability types other than Low Vision, Deaf & Dumb, and Intellectually Disabled (MILD IQ); they will be treated as General Category without any age or fee relaxation.

  • Married male candidates with more than one living wife, or female candidates married to a man with a living wife; such persons are explicitly not eligible for appointment.
  • Current regular Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Corporation/Board employees who are unable to obtain a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office; NOC is mandatory and failure to produce it at testimonials checking leads to cancellation.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying for Punjab and Haryana High Court Safai Sewak & Mali Recruitment 2026?

  • Selecting the wrong category (General/SC/ST/BC/Ex-Servicemen/PwD); category once filled in the online application cannot be changed at any stage of the recruitment process.
  • BC candidates not carrying the latest BC certificate (issued by competent authority) and not preparing the BC Non-Creamy Layer Declaration (Annexure I) before the testimonials checking stage.
  • Claiming preference benefit (Diploma in Gardening or 3 years' experience) without possessing the required document on or before 30-06-2026; failure to produce proof at testimonials checking leads to rejection for that preference claim.
  • Government employees not obtaining NOC from their Head of Department in the prescribed format (Annexure II) before the testimonials checking/interview stage.
  • Not preparing Affidavit (Annexure III) regarding close relatives working in High Court or District Courts of Punjab, Haryana, U.T. Chandigarh - this is mandatory at testimonials checking.
  • Not preparing Affidavit (Annexure IV) about previous government employment(s) already left before applying; this is mandatory at testimonials checking.
  • Waiting until the last day to apply; the High Court will not be responsible for inability to log in due to heavy internet/website load near the closing date, and no extension will be given under any circumstance.
  • Not retaining 5 copies of the photograph uploaded during online application; the same photograph may be required at multiple stages of the recruitment process.

  • Valid and active mobile number (to be kept unchanged throughout the process)

Documents to be produced at Testimonials Checking (as and when called by the High Court):

  • Caste Certificate (EWS/SC/ST/BC) issued by competent authority of Punjab, Haryana, or U.T. Chandigarh as applicable; BC candidates must also carry latest BC certificate and Annexure I Declaration
  • No Objection Certificate in format (Annexure II) - for Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Corporation/Board employees
  • Affidavit (Annexure III) - regarding close relatives working in High Court/District Courts
  • Affidavit (Annexure IV) - regarding previous government employment(s)
  • Disability Certificate (min. 40% disability) - for PwD candidates
  • Discharge Book (self-attested complete copy) - for Ex-Servicemen
  • Proof of disability/death of parent during active operation - for dependents of Ex-Servicemen claiming fee exemption

  • Regular Government/Semi-Government/PSU employees must obtain NOC from Head of Department; failure to produce NOC at testimonials checking will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable; re-check all details before making payment.
  • In case of any discrepancy between advertisements published in newspapers and the official website, the contents on www.highcourtchd.gov.in will prevail.
  • The High Court shall not be responsible for non-delivery of SMS or email due to network issues, switched-off mobile phones, or emails going to spam; candidates must visit www.highcourtchd.gov.in and check their email accounts regularly.
  • Application found incomplete or with false information can be rejected at any stage, even after completion of selection process.
  • The cut-off date to apply is sacrosanct; no candidate will be allowed to apply after 30-06-2026 under any circumstance.

Who should NOT apply for ECIL Walk-in Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the minimum 60% aggregate marks in B.E./B.Tech. (for PE-C and TO-C) or Diploma (for APE-C); SA-C requires only ITI pass.
  • Candidates who do not have the required post-qualification experience — 3 years for PE-C, 1 year for TO-C and APE-C, 2 years for SA-C — in the relevant field; experience from internships, college projects, or academic institutions is NOT counted.
  • Candidates who have crossed the upper age limit (33 years for PE-C; 30 years for TO-C, APE-C, SA-C as on walk-in date), except those eligible for age relaxation.
  • Candidates seeking permanent government employment; this is strictly a temporary contract engagement for up to 4 years with no guarantee of regularization.
  • Candidates unwilling to work anywhere in India or relocate; ECIL requires readiness to work at any location based on organizational needs.
  • Candidates applying for more than one post category; only one category application is allowed.
  • OBC candidates who belong to the Creamy Layer; only Non-Creamy Layer OBC candidates (with certificate not older than 1 year from date of selection explicitly mentioning NCL) are eligible for OBC reservation.
  • Candidates whose qualification is through Distance/Correspondence mode or from institutions not recognized by appropriate statutory authorities.
  • Current ECIL employees (on rolls) who have not obtained prior written permission letter from their respective Head of Division (HoD) before attending the walk-in.
  • Candidates who cannot produce all original certificates at the time of walk-in; document verification is mandatory for registration and interview.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Attending ECIL Walk-in Recruitment 2026?

  • Arriving late — registration closes sharp at 11:30 hrs and no exceptions are made; candidates must plan to reach the venue before 11:00 hrs to complete formalities comfortably.
  • Not downloading the Application Form from www.ecil.co.in before attending; candidates must bring a duly filled application form and resume to the walk-in venue.
  • Bringing experience certificates that do not mention duration (from and to dates) and post held; work experience without supporting documents will be excluded from experience calculation.
  • Currently employed candidates not carrying their Appointment Order and first/recent pay slips; these are mandatory without fail for currently employed applicants.
  • Not carrying a CGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate from the university/institution if the degree uses a grade/CGPA system; this is mandatory for eligibility determination.
  • Applying for a post where your experience profile does not match the specific domain requirements (e.g., applying for VSAT/SATCOM-specific PE-C posts without any satellite communication experience).
  • OBC candidates bringing an OBC certificate older than 1 year from the date of walk-in, or one that does not explicitly mention the Non-Creamy Layer clause; such certificates will not be accepted.
  • Not carrying all original documents along with self-attested photocopies; document verification happens before the interview and incomplete documentation leads to rejection.
  • Candidates at remote postings (Rawatbhata, Tarapur, Lunglie, Kaaru-Leh) not making prior accommodation/travel arrangements; ECIL advises candidates that document verification and interviews may take considerable time.

How to Apply for ECIL Walk-in Recruitment 2026

This is a Walk-in Selection. There is no online application submission. Candidates must appear in person at the respective zonal venue on the designated walk-in date. The application form must be downloaded from the official ECIL website (www.ecil.co.in) and filled before attending.

Documents to carry (Originals + one set of self-attested photocopies):

  • Duly filled Application Form (downloaded from www.ecil.co.in) and Resume
  • 10th Class Certificate or School Leaving Certificate (as Date of Birth proof)
  • Qualification documents — Certificate and Marks Sheets of B.E./B.Tech./Diploma/ITI as applicable
  • CGPA to percentage conversion certificate from institution/university (mandatory if grade system used)
  • Experience Certificates from previous employers clearly mentioning duration (from & to dates) and post held
  • If currently employed: Appointment Order + first and recent pay slips (mandatory)
  • Category Certificate — EWS/OBC/SC/ST as applicable; OBC certificate must not be older than 1 year from date of selection and must explicitly mention Non-Creamy Layer
  • Government-issued Identity Proof (Aadhaar, Passport etc.)
  • PwBD certificate (if applicable, with minimum 40% disability); Discharge certificate (for Ex-Servicemen); J&K domicile certificate (if claiming age relaxation)
  • ECIL current employees: Permission letter from respective Head of Division (HoD)

For queries: Email [email protected] or call 040-27182222. Any corrigendum will be published only on www.ecil.co.in; do not rely on other websites or social media for updates.

Important Instructions for ECIL Walk-in Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • This engagement is purely on temporary/contract basis for an initial period of 1 year, extendable up to 4 years. It does NOT create any right to regularization or permanent employment in ECIL.
  • Candidates must apply for one category of post only. Applying for multiple posts is not allowed.
  • Registration timing is strictly 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs at the respective venue. Candidates arriving after 11:30 hrs will NOT be allowed under any circumstances.
  • Candidates must be ready to work anywhere in India as per organizational requirements.
  • Experience from Academic Institutions / Colleges / Internship / Project work will NOT be considered for post-qualification experience. Only industry experience from registered organizations will be counted.
  • Apprenticeship in the relevant field (maximum of one year) will be counted as experience.
  • Qualifications through Distance/Correspondence/Off-campus mode are NOT eligible.
  • OBC candidates must ensure their OBC-NCL certificate is not older than 1 year from the date of selection and explicitly mentions the Non-Creamy Layer clause.
  • ECIL employees currently on rolls must obtain and produce a written permission letter from their Head of Division before attending.
  • Canvassing in any form will result in immediate rejection of candidature.
  • ECIL reserves the right to alter the number of posts or cancel the entire recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Applications/candidatures are liable to rejection at any stage if suppression of facts or furnishing of false information is detected.
  • Legal proceedings arising from this advertisement are subject to exclusive jurisdiction of Courts at GHMC (Kapra Circle) only.
  • Beware of fraudulent elements promising contractual appointment through illegal gratification; selection will be done purely on merit in a transparent manner.

What are the Eligibility Criteria?

The recruitment notification includes vacancies for three para-medical posts. Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualifications and age criteria to be eligible. The required qualifications vary according to the post applied for.

Educational Qualification

Candidates applying for ASI (Pharmacist) must have:

  • Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University.
  • Diploma or Degree in Pharmacy granted by an institution recognized by the Central or State Government.
  • Should be registered as a "PHARMACIST" under the Pharmacy Act, 1948.

Candidates applying for ASI (X-Ray Technician) must have:

  • Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University.
  • 02 years Diploma in Radiography from an institution recognized by Central or State Government.

Candidates applying for ASI (Lab Technician) must have:

  • Passed 10+2 from a recognized Board or University with Science.
  • 02 years Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology from an institution recognized by any Central or State Government.

The age limit is the same for all three posts. Age will be calculated as on the closing date of online application i.e. 07 July 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates is applicable as per Government orders.

How To Apply Online For CISF ASI Posts?

Here, we have provided the direct, simple and easy steps to apply online for the CISF ASI Para Medical Staff Recruitment 2026. Every candidate can follow these steps one by one and submit the application form.

  • Visit the official CISF recruitment website at cisfrectt.cisf.gov.in.
  • Click on the "NEW REGISTRATION" button and complete the One-Time Registration process using your Mobile Number and Email ID.
  • Login using your Registration ID and auto-generated password and click on "Recruitment of Paramedical Staff in CISF – 2026" tab.
  • Fill in the essential details such as Registration ID, Password and Captcha and click "SUBMIT".
  • Fill the required personal and educational details in the online application form.
  • Upload your recent passport size photograph (not more than 3 months old), signature, Date of Birth Certificate and educational qualification certificate as per specified format.
  • Pay the application fee through UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit card or SBI Challan (cash at SBI branches).
  • Review all the details carefully, click "Final Submission" and take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.

Selection Process (Written Exam, PST, BVAT & Medical)

The CISF ASI Para Medical Staff Selection Process 2026 consists of multiple stages. Candidates must qualify at each stage to proceed to the next round. The final select list will be drawn based on aggregate marks obtained in the Written Examination (OMR/CBT) equal to the vacancies notified.

  • Written Examination (OMR/CBT Mode – Objective Type)
  • Physical Standard Test (PST) & Documentation

  • Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME)

CISF ASI Para Medical Staff Exam Pattern 2026

The CISF ASI Para Medical Staff Exam 2026 is conducted in multiple stages. The Written Examination is objective in nature and conducted in OMR/CBT mode. Candidates who qualify the written exam are shortlisted for PST, Documentation, BVAT and Medical Examination at a ratio of about 5 (five) times the number of vacancies notified.

  • Objective Multiple Choice type written examination.
  • Total Marks: 100
  • Duration: 2 Hours
  • Questions are asked to test knowledge in the respective trade.
  • Conducted in English and Hindi (bilingual).
  • There is no negative marking.
  • Candidates are shortlisted for PST based on their performance in the Written Examination.

DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Screening of received applications will be carried out at multiple stages. Final selection is purely based on merit of marks scored in the Final Personal Interview.

Stage 1 – Administrative Screening: Verification of identity, age, essential & higher qualifications, length of suitable experience and CCA Declaration (wherever applicable).

Stage 2 – Technical Screening (Level-1): For all Administratively Eligible candidates - Technical Screening by holding a Meeting of Technical Screening Committee (an independent body including Technical Experts from Industry/Academia/DRDO other than RAC) using Bio-data based Technical Screening at Level-1 by: (a) Relevance of suitable experience w.r.t. advertised qualifications; (b) Relevance of Desirable/Higher Qualification; (c) Any other criteria suggested by Technical Screening Committee. Predefined Ratio for Preliminary Online Interview: Up to 24 candidates for 1 post; up to 48 candidates for 2 posts.

Stage 3 – Technical Screening (Level-2 / Preliminary Online Interview, if required): If number shortlisted for Final Personal Interview is large, further shortlisting via Preliminary Online Interview of short duration (10–15 minutes). Predefined Ratio for Final Personal Interview: Up to 12 candidates for 1 post; up to 24 candidates for 2 posts.

Stage 4 – Final Personal Interview (in-person at RAC, Delhi): Final selection is purely on merit of marks scored. Candidates must score a minimum of 75% marks (75 out of 100) in the Final Personal Interview for consideration for selection. The Final Personal Interview will be held in-person only before the Selection Board at RAC, Delhi on the scheduled date - no online/virtual interview will be considered.

Note: If administrative screening does not result in minimum 6 eligible candidates against one vacancy, the subsequent selection process for that vacancy may be cancelled. If technical screening does not result in minimum 6 candidates per vacancy for Final Personal Interview, the number of vacancies will be reduced accordingly.

Competition Level Analysis for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026

The competition level for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very high, particularly for Scientist C posts in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering - disciplines with a large pool of eligible candidates and growing interest in DRDO's prestigious research environment. DRDO provides one of the best career growth structures for scientists under the Flexible Complimenting Scheme (FCS), making it a highly sought-after employer.

The multi-stage shortlisting process (Administrative → Technical Level-1 → Level-2/Preliminary Online Interview → Final Personal Interview in Delhi) is rigorous. Only up to 12 candidates per vacancy reach the Final Personal Interview, and even among those, a minimum of 75% marks in the interview is mandatory for selection. For Scientist D and E posts requiring 7–11 years of experience, the competition narrows to experienced professionals, but the specificity of required experience (e.g., Optics/Photonics, Radiation Physics, Chemical Engineering for underwater applications) naturally limits the eligible pool, making those posts relatively less competitive. Niche posts like Oceanography, Pharmacology, and Remote Sensing will see very limited candidates, improving selection chances for well-qualified applicants.

Who should NOT apply for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not have First Division (60%+) in the essential qualifying degree - this is a hard minimum requirement and no rounding off is permitted.
  • Candidates with experience below Pay Level 10 (7th CPC) or equivalent - such experience will not be counted for computing the required years of experience.
  • Candidates whose period of study (higher qualification like PhD) overlaps with the work experience claimed - overlapping periods will be removed from total experience.
  • Candidates applying for Scientist D or E posts who are currently unemployed for more than one year - under current employment, the period of un-employment shall not exceed one year, else the candidature will be rejected.
  • Candidates serving in Government/PSU who do not upload a signed CCA Declaration - without CCA Declaration their candidature will be rejected, and NOC will be mandatory at Final Personal Interview.
  • Candidates from Private Sector who cannot produce CTC/Pay drawn proof/Form 16A for the claimed experience period - this is the sole criteria for establishing experience suitability from private sector.
  • Candidates exceeding the maximum age of 35 years (Scientist C), 45 years (Scientist D/E), or 56 years inclusive of all relaxations.
  • Candidates who cannot attend the Final Personal Interview in-person at RAC, Delhi - no online/virtual mode is available for Final Personal Interview under any circumstances.
  • Candidates who do not meet the specific work experience fields mentioned in the advertised qualifications - the Technical Screening Committee assesses relevance of experience very strictly.
  • Candidates applying for Scientist C (Encadered) posts from Reserved categories seeking age relaxation - there is no category-based age relaxation for Scientist C Encadered posts.

Common mistakes / What to check before applying for DRDO RAC Scientist Recruitment 2026?

  • Not checking whether your experience is at or above Pay Level 10 (7th CPC) equivalent - experience below this level is invalid and will not be counted.
  • Miscounting experience years by including the period of higher qualification (PhD/M.Tech) that overlaps with work experience - the overlapping period will be deducted.
  • Applying for multiple posts by submitting one application - candidates applying for more than one post must apply separately for each post and mention item numbers of all other posts where they have applied, along with the order of preference.
  • Not highlighting desirable qualifications and experience in the Justification column under 'Other Section' in the online application form - this is crucial for Technical Screening Committee's assessment.
  • Providing incorrect or non-verifiable experience details - the length of experience (date of joining along with Pay Scale/CTC and end date of each employment) should be available in attached experience documents.
  • Not getting experience certificates issued by Admin/HR Head/Director/Principal/Dean/Registrar/Competent Authority - certificates issued by Group Head/Division Head/Project Head/Professor or Head of Department are not acceptable.
  • Not converting CGPA to percentage before applying - CGPA/CPI of 6.75 on a 10-point scale equals 60%; candidates must provide conversion formula certificate from the university.
  • Changing registered mobile number or email after application - vital information will be communicated only to the registered contact; applicants are advised not to change these.
  • Locking/submitting the application without previewing it along with uploaded documents - no correction in data/application will be allowed and no document will be accepted once the application is finally submitted/locked.
  • Uploading documents in language other than English or Hindi without a notarized/certified transcript - all certificates in other languages must be accompanied by notarized transcripts.

SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Final selection is subject to verification of eligibility, qualifying in local language test, and medical fitness. A Wait List (State-category wise) will be maintained for one year from the date of result or next engagement exercise, whichever is earlier. Candidates will be released only once from this waitlist against non-joining subject to availability of qualified candidates.
