SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Weightage in Junior Associate Recruitment

Weightage/Relaxation to apprentices in recruitment of Junior Associates shall be given as per the recruitment policy of the Bank as amended from time to time, to apprentices who successfully complete the apprenticeship training in SBI, subject to candidate's satisfactory conduct and performance during the entire training period. Successful completion refers to passing of the skill evaluation test (Trade test) and obtention of the joint National Apprenticeship Certificate issued by SBI-NSDC / BFSI-SSC.

Competition Level Analysis for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The competition level for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very high due to 7150 seats being offered at the all-India level and the exam being open to any graduate, including those already preparing for bank and SSC exams. While the written test is of easy to moderate difficulty and slightly below SBI Clerk level, the large number of serious aspirants in high-population states like Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh and Telangana will push state-wise and category-wise cut-offs upward.

In practical terms, each seat is likely to attract dozens to over a hundred candidates in major states, making speed, accuracy, and sectional balance crucial to clearing the single-stage written exam followed by the local language test. However, the effective competition reduces at later stages because some candidates will fail to qualify the language test or be filtered out at the document verification, CIBIL, Aadhaar, and medical fitness stages, and SBI will finally select candidates strictly on state-wise and category-wise merit from those who clear all stages.

Who should NOT apply for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates looking for a permanent job in SBI; this is only a 1‑year apprenticeship with no guarantee of absorption or regular employment.
  • Candidates who already completed any Apprenticeship (in SBI or any other organisation) or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act.
  • Candidates outside the age band 20–28 years as on the cut-off date (even 1 day younger/older is not eligible, except notified relaxations for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD).
  • Aspirants who do not have a Graduation degree from a recognised University/Institute by the specified date.
  • Candidates not fluent in the notified local language of the State/UT (reading, writing, speaking, understanding), and who are unlikely to clear the language test or do not have 10th/12th proof.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to register on the NAPS portal before applying, as this is a mandatory prerequisite for SBI Apprentice.
  • Candidates with serious CIBIL/loan/credit‑card defaults who have not regularised or repaid outstanding dues by the time of offer; such profiles are normally rejected in bank recruitments.
  • Ex‑Servicemen / Disabled Ex‑Servicemen, where the notification clearly states no engagement / no reservation for them under Apprentice.
  • PwBD candidates whose disability type falls under “likely to improve” (temporary disability) where reservation benefits may not apply as per notification conditions.
  • Candidates who cannot produce valid Aadhaar (except where exempted, e.g., certain North‑Eastern states with alternate ID allowed).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying in a wrong State or language where you cannot comfortably read, write and speak the specified local language.
  • Entering wrong category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR); category cannot be changed later and mismatch with certificates at DV can lead to cancellation.
  • OBC candidates from creamy layer applying as OBC instead of UR; only non‑creamy OBCs with valid, recent certificate get reservation.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, thumb impression or declaration (wrong size, wrong format, someone else’s handwriting) leading to rejection at scrutiny.
  • Using invalid or inactive mobile number/email ID, causing failure to receive OTPs, registration details, call letters or further communication.
  • Submitting multiple applications for different states or with different details; SBI usually accepts only the last complete application and may forfeit extra fees.
  • Ignoring negative marking and over‑attempting in the exam, which can sharply reduce your score despite high attempts.
  • Not reading the clause that this is not regular employment, and later protesting about absorption or permanent posting after apprenticeship ends.

How to Apply for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Candidates shall apply online; no other mode of application will be accepted. Candidates must first mandatorily register on the NAPS portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) and read the detailed guidelines on https://bfsissc.com before applying online through the SBI website.

Candidates should have a valid email ID and mobile number which should be kept active till declaration of results. Candidates are advised to apply well before the closing date and not wait till the last date.

Documents Required to be Scanned and Uploaded (as per Annexure-I):

  • Recent passport-size colour photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm; 200×230 pixels; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG)
  • Signature with black ink on white paper (140×60 pixels; 10 KB–20 KB; JPEG)
  • Left Thumb Impression on white paper with black or blue ink (240×240 pixels; 20 KB–50 KB; JPEG/JPG)
  • Handwritten Declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels; 50 KB–100 KB; JPEG/JPG) — in candidate's own handwriting
  • Live photograph captured via webcam or mobile phone (to be uploaded at the time of online application)

Documents to be Produced at the time of Examination / Document Verification / Engagement:

  • Call Letter (downloaded from Bank's website) along with photo identity proof (Passport / Aadhaar / PAN Card / Driving License / Voter's Card / Bank Passbook with photograph / Identity Card issued by School or College / Gazetted Officer in official letterhead) in original and self-attested photocopy
  • Caste Certificate in prescribed Government of India format (for SC/ST candidates) — to be submitted at the time of engagement if called for
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Certificate in prescribed Government of India format, issued during the period 01-04-2026 to the date of joining (for OBC candidates)
  • Income and Asset Certificate issued by Competent Authority in the format prescribed by Government of India, valid for the year 2026-27 (for EWS candidates)
  • Disability Certificate in prescribed format issued by a Competent Authority as per Government of India guidelines (for PwBD candidates)
  • Educational qualification certificates and marksheets (Graduation onwards)

Printout of Application Form is NOT to be sent to SBI. No Hard Copy of the Call Letter for Online Written Examination will be sent by post. Candidates must appear for the test at their own cost; SBI will not pay or reimburse any such expenses.

Apply Online at: https://www.sbi.co.in/careers or https://sbi.bank.in/careers

For queries: Call 022-22820427 (11:00 AM to 06:00 PM on working days) or visit https://cgrs.ibps.in — mention "Engagement of Apprentice in SBI" in the subject.

Important Instructions for SBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Candidates

  • THIS IS NOT AN EMPLOYMENT IN THE BANK. NOR IS THE SAME CONTRACT EMPLOYMENT. Candidates engaged as Apprentice will NOT be treated as "employees" of SBI and will not be entitled to receive any benefits available for employees of the Bank.
  • SBI shall have no obligation to offer regular employment to Apprentices during and/or after the completion of the Apprenticeship period. After completion, candidates will be relieved from the respective work area.
  • Candidates can apply for engagement in one State only and can appear for the examination only once under this engagement project.
  • Mandatory registration on NAPS portal (https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in) before applying online on SBI website is required.
  • No Ex-Servicemen / Disabled Ex-Servicemen shall be engaged as an Apprentice and there is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Apprentice Engagement.
  • OBC candidates belonging to the "Creamy Layer" are not entitled to reservation/relaxation; they should apply as General or General (LD/VI/HI/d&e) as applicable.
  • Change of category will not be permitted after registration of online application.
  • Candidates with CIBIL default record (unpaid loans/credit card dues) are not eligible for engagement until dues are regularized/repaid.
  • All candidates (except Northeastern State candidates) must produce Aadhaar Number before engagement/contract signing.
  • Not more than one application should be submitted; in case of multiple applications, only the last valid completed application will be retained and fee paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.
  • PwBD candidates with disability conditions falling under "likely to improve" (temporary disability) category are not eligible for reservation.
  • PwBD candidates eligible for scribe facility: candidates with 40% or more disability having physical limitation to write are eligible. Scribe must be arranged by the candidate at his/her own cost. Compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination is allowed (whether availing scribe or not) for eligible PwBD candidates.
  • Candidates are advised to keep their registered email ID/mobile active for receiving call letters/advices etc.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, pagers, earphones or any other electronic/communication devices are not allowed inside the examination premises.
  • All revisions/corrigendum (if any) will be hosted on the Bank's website only — candidates should visit regularly.
  • No request for change of examination centre shall be entertained. No Travel Expenses will be reimbursed/paid by SBI.
  • Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
  • Legal jurisdiction for any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be Mumbai only.
  • Bank reserves right to cancel the selection process partly/entirely at any stage.

How to Apply for Indian Navy Agniveer (Apprentice) Recruitment 2026

Steps to Apply Online:

  • After successful registration, click on "Login" → AVR (Apprentice) → INET 2/26 → Proceed to apply.
  • Fill in all details carefully. Incorrect declaration of information identified at any stage will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Upload a recent passport-size colour photograph (taken not before May 2026), size 10 KB to 50 KB; front portrait in light background without head gear (except Sikhs). Date of photograph must be clearly written at the bottom.

  • Pay the examination fee of ₹550/- + 18% GST online via net banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI.

  • Original NCC 'C' Certificate / Sponsorship Certificate (if held)
  • Police Verification Form duly verified by the Superintendent of Police of respective jurisdiction (from place of domicile or place of residence)
  • Call-up letter / Admit Card

Apply Online at: https://joinindiannavy.gov.in → Register → AVR (Apprentice) → INET 2/26

Indian Navy Agniveer (Apprentice) Recruitment 2026 - Important Instructions

  • Only unmarried Indian male candidates are eligible. Agniveers cannot marry during their entire 4-year tenure; violation will result in dismissal from service.
  • Agniveers are enrolled under the Navy Act 1957 for a period of 4 years. Indian Navy is not obliged to retain Agniveers beyond the engagement period.
  • Up to 25% of each specific batch of Agniveers may be offered permanent enrolment in the Indian Navy as Sailors (Regular Cadre) / Artificers based on performance and organisational requirements. Selection for further enrolment is entirely at the discretion of the Indian Navy; Agniveers have no right to be selected.
  • Agniveers will not be permitted to seek release at their own request prior to completion of the engagement period.
  • Agniveers are not governed by Naval Pension Regulations/Rules and are not entitled to gratuity for the engagement period.
  • Agniveers will not be eligible for Ex-Servicemen status.
  • Candidates declaring incorrect domicile/gender and other details shall not be permitted to appear in the recruitment and their candidature will be cancelled.
  • Candidates reporting 30 minutes after the reporting time for Stage I - INET shall not be allowed to appear in the examination.
  • A candidate's selection pertaining to a particular batch is valid for that batch only. Qualified candidates whose names do not appear in the merit list cannot claim admission for the next batch.
  • Mobile phones or any other communication devices are not allowed inside the examination premises. Infringement will entail disciplinary action including ban from future examinations.
  • Candidates should not submit multiple applications. If more than one application is received, candidature will be cancelled.
  • Minimum height standard is 157 cms. Permanent body tattoos are only permitted on the inner face of forearms (inside of elbow to wrist) and on the reversed side of palm/back (dorsal) side of hand. Tattoos on any other part of the body are not acceptable.
  • Candidates are advised to get their ears cleaned for wax and tartar removed from teeth prior to medical examination.
  • Visual Standards: Uncorrected Vision 6/12, 6/12 | Corrected Vision 6/6, 6/6 | Colour Perception: CP PASS.
  • No enquiry will be entertained regarding this recruitment/enrolment after a period of six months post completion of the recruitment cycle for the respective batch.
  • The terms and conditions given in the advertisement are guidelines only and are subject to change without notice. Further, orders issued by the Government as amended from time to time will apply for selected candidates.

MSC Bank Vacancy Details – Post-wise Breakdown

MSC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility requirements differ by post for both educational qualifications and age limits. All candidates must have passed the Matriculation Examination with Marathi as one of the subjects and must be domiciled in Maharashtra State (Domicile Certificate is mandatory). Age is calculated as on 01 June 2026.

1. Trainee Junior Officer (49 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with at least 50% marks. Candidates with Bachelors/Masters in Law or JAIIB/CAIIB/MSCIT certifications, or work experience in Treasury/International Banking will be preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience in Banking field, preferably in Urban/DCC Bank as an Officer (Officer Cadre — first level where Clerk level exists, or second level where it does not).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 23 years – Maximum 35 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1991).

2. Trainee Associate (81 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with at least 50% marks. Preference for Government Commercial Certificate in Marathi and English typing; proficiency in Computer Applications required.
  • Experience: Not mandatory; preference for candidates with Co-operative Intern experience in StCB/DCC Banks.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 21 years – Maximum 32 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1994).

3. Trainee Typist – Associate Grade (04 Posts)

  • Education: Graduate in any discipline with Marathi in Matriculation. Must possess Government Commercial Certificate Exam — 30 w.p.m. in Marathi typing and 40 w.p.m. in English typing. Proficiency in Word Processing and Spread Sheet required.
  • Experience: Not mandatory; preference for DTP Operator experience. Preference for Marathi/English stenography course holders.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 21 years – Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1998).

4. Trainee Driver (05 Posts)

  • Education: Matriculation (S.S.C.) Examination with Marathi as one of the subjects and a valid LMV licence.
  • Experience: Not mandatory.
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years – Maximum 30 years (born not earlier than 01 June 1996).
  • Special relaxation: Children of MSC Bank employees get 5 years relaxation on maximum age for Trainee Driver post.

All selected candidates will be engaged as Trainees for 12 months, during which a monthly stipend is paid. After successful training, candidates are placed in the Bank's regular grade with revised emoluments. Post-confirmation, a probation of 6 months follows before permanent absorption.

In case of default, voluntary resignation, or termination before the expiry of 4 years, the candidate is required to pay Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) as liquidated damages and execute a surety bond for Rs. 1,00,000/- from two income tax payees as sureties.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026

The entire application process is online through the MSC Bank career portal. Physical applications will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates should keep their scanned documents ready before beginning registration.

Documents to scan before applying:

  • Photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, passport style, colour, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Signature (black ink on white paper, 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB)
  • Left thumb impression (white paper, black/blue ink, 240×240 pixels, 20–50 KB)
  • Handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 50–100 KB)

Declaration text: "I, _______ (Name), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."

Step-by-step application process:

  1. Visit https://msc.bank.in/career and click "APPLY ONLINE".
  2. Click "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent via SMS and email.
  3. Log in and fill the application form. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress at each step.
  4. Upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per specifications.
  5. Fill remaining application details and click "Validate Your Details" followed by "Save & Next".
  6. Preview the complete application using the "Preview Tab" and verify all entries.
  7. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after final verification.
  8. Proceed to the Payment Tab and pay the application fee online.
  9. Click "Submit" and save/print the e-Receipt and application form for future reference.

Only one application per candidate is allowed. In case of multiple applications, only the latest will be retained and earlier fees will be forfeited.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

Many applicants lose their candidature due to avoidable errors during or after the application process. Review the following checklist before submitting your form.

  • Applying for multiple posts: MSC Bank allows one application per candidate. Submit only one application for the post you are most qualified for.
  • Wrong photograph format: Passport-style colour photo against a light background is required. Selfies, group photos, or blurred images will lead to rejection.
  • Signature in CAPITAL LETTERS: Signatures in block/capital letters are strictly rejected. Sign in your normal cursive style with black ink.
  • Missing Domicile Certificate: Only Maharashtra residents can apply. Ensure your Domicile Certificate is valid and ready for document verification.
  • Not checking Marathi in SSC: All posts require Marathi as a subject in Matriculation. Check your mark sheet before applying.
  • Pressing Back/Refresh during payment: After submitting payment information, do not press Back or Refresh. Wait for the server confirmation to avoid double charges.
  • Incomplete scanning of thumb impression: The left thumb impression must be properly scanned and not smudged. A blurred or partial impression can invalidate your application.
  • Not saving the e-Receipt: If an e-Receipt is not generated, the transaction may have failed. Log in again and repeat the payment process.

What Is CSEB Kerala? - Understanding the Recruitment Process

The Cooperative Service Examination Board (CSEB), Kerala, is the state body that conducts recruitment examinations for vacancies in Kerala's cooperative banks and societies. Unlike PSC (Public Service Commission) which recruits for government departments, CSEB specifically handles the cooperative sector.

The recruitment process works in two layers:

  1. CSEB conducts the written examination and prepares a ranked list of qualified candidates for each advertisement
  2. The individual cooperative bank/society conducts the interview from the shortlisted candidates and makes the final appointment

This means that after you clear the written exam, the specific bank where the vacancy exists will call you for an interview. Final appointment is made by that bank - you are an employee of the cooperative bank, not a Kerala Government employee. However, the salary scales, service conditions, and regulations are governed by the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act and rules.

Why Apply for a Kerala Cooperative Bank Job?

Many candidates overlook cooperative bank jobs while focusing only on PSC or central government posts. Here is why CSEB recruitment deserves serious consideration:

  • Stable, permanent employment governed by the Kerala Co-operative Societies Act
  • Pay scales competitive with state government Level equivalents for the same qualifications
  • Local posting - most cooperative banks post staff within the district or region, unlike state government transfers
  • Less competition than PSC exams - the candidate pool for CSEB exams is significantly smaller than for state-level PSC recruitments
  • Multiple banks in one advertisement - you can apply to multiple institutions in the same advt by paying an additional ₹50 per bank, increasing your selection chances significantly
  • Fresher-friendly - the Junior Clerk posts especially have no experience requirement

Tips for CSEB Written Exam Preparation

  • The 100-question, 100-mark written exam typically covers: General Knowledge, Current Affairs, Kerala-specific awareness, Cooperative law and principles, Mathematics/Reasoning, and English/Malayalam language
  • For Secretary and Assistant Secretary posts, expect questions on cooperative management, accounting principles, banking regulations, and the Kerala Cooperative Societies Act in depth
  • For Junior Clerk posts, the pattern is closer to a standard clerical aptitude test - reasoning, basic arithmetic, language comprehension
  • For System Administrator, expect technical questions on networking, OS administration, database management, and IT security alongside cooperative awareness
  • For DEO, expect typing/computer knowledge components alongside the written test
  • The minimum qualifying score is low (4/20 for interview eligibility) but the real competition is in clearing the cutoff that gets you called for an interview - typically much higher in popular banks. Focus on scoring in the top tier rather than just qualifying.

Can You Apply for Multiple Banks in the Same Advertisement?

Yes - and this is a significant strategic advantage. Unlike most government recruitment processes where you apply to one organization, the CSEB system allows a single candidate to apply to multiple cooperative banks under the same advertisement number. Each additional bank beyond the first requires an extra ₹50 exam fee.

For example, under Advt. 17/2026 (Junior Clerk – Super Grade), if you want to be considered for 3 banks, you pay: ₹150 (first bank) + ₹50 + ₹50 = ₹250 (+ 18% GST).

This is particularly useful for candidates who are flexible about work location within Kerala, as it dramatically increases the number of vacancies you are effectively competing for.

Sourced from official CSEB Kerala notifications Advt. No. 15/2026 to 21/2026, issued by the Cooperative Service Examination Board, Thiruvananthapuram, dated May 30, 2026.

Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for a series of interviews (Specialized Branch Manager) or Interview/Discussion process (Manager – Contract). Candidature will be cancelled if any information furnished in the application is found false, incorrect, or incomplete. Final offer letter will be issued after successful completion of Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Document Validation.

Post-Selection Steps (Specialized Branch Manager – Regular):

  • Preliminary Offer Letter issued to qualified candidates.
  • Background Verification, Police Verification, Medical Examination, and Documentation.
  • Final Offer Letter issued after successful completion of all mandatory procedures.
  • Probation Period: 6 months; confirmed in the respective post after successful completion.
  • Selected candidates must execute an undertaking on Rs. 500/- stamp paper committing to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining. In case of default/voluntary resignation before completion of 5 years, liquidated damages of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) are payable to the Bank. Surety bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- each from two income tax payees is also required.

Post-Selection Steps (Manager – Contract):

  • First appointment on contract for 1 year; extendable up to a maximum of 5 years based on performance assessment.
  • Either party must give one month's notice or pay one month's fixed component of compensation to terminate the contract before expiry.
  • Appointment subject to being declared medically fit as per Bank's requirements.

MSC Bank Specialized Branch Manager & Manager (Contract) Recruitment 2026-27 – Contract Terms (Manager)

Parameter Details
Duration of Contract 1 year initially; extendable up to maximum 5 years based on performance appraisal
Leaves 12 days Casual Leave per year (1 CL per month of service); 15 days Privilege Leave per calendar year with prior approval from Competent Authority
Outstation Official Duties Travelling expenses / Halting allowance / hotel stay eligibility as per Bank's T.A.D.A. Rules & Regulations
Working Hours As applicable to serving employees of the Bank

Place of Posting Regional Offices and Head Office, Mumbai; Bank reserves right to transfer as per business requirement
PF / Gratuity / Pension Not applicable for contract engagement
Regular Absorption No legal claim to regular absorption during or after contract period

Who should NOT apply for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Candidates who have not passed the JAIIB examination (for Specialized Branch Manager) or the CAIIB examination (for Manager – Contract) — these are hard mandatory requirements.
  • Candidates without at least 5 years of experience as a Branch Manager at Officer level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Specialized Branch Manager).
  • Candidates without at least 10–12 years of experience at Senior/Middle Management level in a commercial/co-op bank (for Manager – Contract).
  • Candidates who are not domiciled in Maharashtra State — Maharashtra domicile certificate is compulsory for both posts; non-Maharashtra residents cannot apply.
  • Candidates who are below 45 years of age as on 01-05-2026 — both posts have a minimum age of 45 years.
  • Candidates for Manager (Contract) who are above 62 years of age as on 01-05-2026.
  • Candidates unwilling to be posted/transferred anywhere in Maharashtra — all services are liable to be transferred.
  • Candidates for Specialized Branch Manager who are unwilling to execute the 5-year service bond and pay Rs. 10 Lakh as liquidated damages in case of early exit.
  • Government/PSU/Bank employees who have not informed their employer in writing about applying for this recruitment — submission of employer information copy is a mandatory requirement.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying for MSC Bank Recruitment 2026-27?

  • Not downloading both Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form) from https://msc.bank.in/career — both must be filled and submitted together.
  • Not enclosing the Maharashtra Domicile Certificate with the application — applications without it will be treated as ineligible.
  • Not enclosing self-attested photocopies of all supporting documents (educational certificates, JAIIB/CAIIB certificate, experience certificates, date of birth proof) — applications without mandatory enclosures will not be considered.
  • Candidates currently in Government/PSU/Bank service not enclosing a copy of their employer intimation letter (informing their Head of Office/Department about the application) — this is a mandatory requirement.
  • Super-scribing the envelope incorrectly — the envelope must be clearly super-scribed as "Application for the post of Specialized Branch Managers" (Advt. 01) or "Application for the post of Managers (Contract)" (Advt. 02) respectively.
  • Applying for both posts in a single envelope or under a single application — each post requires a separate application as per respective advertisement instructions.
  • Not providing a definite timeline/proof for relieving from the current employer if selected — this must be mentioned with documentary proof in the application.
  • Not providing references of two important professionals/Government officials as required in the application form.

How to Apply for MSC Bank Specialized Branch Manager & Manager (Contract) Recruitment 2026-27

Applications must be submitted offline only. No other mode of application shall be accepted. Candidates must visit the Bank's website https://msc.bank.in/career, download Annexure-1 (Application Form) and Annexure-2 (Declaration Form), fill them in all respects, and send by Post / Speed Post / Courier along with all mandatory self-attested documents.

  • Experience Certificates (containing area, organization, and period of service) for all relevant work experience
  • Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate (compulsory)
  • Copies of relevant published work / research papers (if any, for Manager – Contract)
  • Copy of letter informing employer about this application (mandatory for candidates in Government/PSU/Bank service)
  • Proof of definite timeline for relieving from current employer (if selected)
  • Passport-size photograph affixed on the application form (sign across; do not pin/staple)

  • Applications must reach the Bank on or before 22-06-2026 by 05:15 PM. Incomplete applications and those received after this deadline will not be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Submission of Maharashtra State Domicile Certificate is compulsory. Applications without it will not be considered.
  • Candidates in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Financial Institutions/Banks service must inform their employer (Head of Office/Department) in writing about their application and attach a photocopy of the intimation letter with the application, prior to submission.
  • At the time of joining, recommended candidates must produce a proper discharge certificate from their employer.
  • Any external influence/canvassing regarding appointment or transfer shall be treated as a violation of Bank rules and the Bank reserves the right to cancel such candidature.
  • For Specialized Branch Manager: Selected candidates must execute an undertaking to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years. Liquidated damages of Rs. 10,00,000/- (Ten Lakh) are payable on voluntary resignation/termination before 5 years. Surety bond of Rs. 1,00,000/- each from two income tax payees is also mandatory.
  • For Manager (Contract): The engagement shall not be construed as employment in the Bank. No PF/Gratuity/Pension provisions are applicable. There is no legal claim to regular absorption during or after the contract period.
  • Officers who are confirmed in the services of MSC Bank and fulfill the eligibility criteria are also eligible to apply for both posts.
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirements.
  • Candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage if any information provided is found to be false/incorrect/incomplete.
  • No TA will be paid to candidates called for interview.

Bellary DCC Bank Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

(A) Manager / First Division Assistant

Step 1 - Written Examination + Interview: Vacancy filling is done through written examination and personal interview.

Step 2 - Shortlisting for Written Exam: Online applications are screened based on prescribed educational qualifications and required documents. Eligible candidates are called for written examination conducted by an external government-authorized body. Based on marks scored in the prescribed written examination, an eligibility list is prepared and candidates are called for interview in a 1:5 ratio (15 marks minimum to qualify for interview).

Step 3 - Merit List: Written exam marks (minimum 85 out of 100 to qualify) combined with interview marks are totaled to prepare a final merit list (Merit List), following reservation norms for final appointment.

Competition Level Analysis for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026

The competition level for Exim Bank MT Recruitment 2026 is expected to be very intense given that only 05 vacancies are on offer across two disciplines from a large pool of MBA/PGDBM graduates across India. The Bank being a premier financial institution under the Government of India makes this an exceptionally sought-after position among finance, HR, and administration postgraduates. The subjective Written Test format — unlike the MCQ-based bank exams — demands strong subject knowledge, analytical writing ability, and command over HR / Administration concepts rather than just speed and aptitude.

The low vacancy count means even marginal differences in written test scores will determine shortlisting for the interview round. Candidates with domain depth in HRM/Personnel Management (for MT-HRM) or Hotel/Facilities/Civil background with MBA (for MT-Administration) are better positioned. The Personal Interview carrying 30% of the final weightage means soft skills, subject clarity, and awareness of Exim Bank's functions and India's international trade ecosystem will be critical differentiators at the final stage.

Who should NOT apply for Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who have completed their graduation or postgraduation through correspondence / part-time / open university / open learning / external / distance learning; they are categorically not eligible.
  • Candidates who do not hold a Post Graduation (MBA / PGDBA / PGDBM / MMS) in the relevant specialization with minimum 60% marks in both graduation and post graduation.
  • Candidates outside the age band of 21-28 years as on 30-04-2026 (except as per OBC/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen relaxation).
  • OBC candidates belonging to the Creamy Layer; they must apply as General candidates. OBC certificate must be valid as on the last date of applying (issued within one year prior to the last date).
  • Candidates who have defaulted in any loan repayment and/or whose name appears in CIBIL database as a defaulter.
  • Candidates unwilling to serve anywhere in India or unwilling to be transferred to offices outside India (with consent).
  • Candidates unwilling to execute a personal bond of Rs. 3 lakh to serve the Bank for 1 year as MT and minimum 5 years as employee after absorption.
  • Currently serving employees of Government / PSU who cannot produce a proper Relieving Letter/Discharge Certificate from their present employer at the time of joining.
  • Candidates whose CGPA-based qualification does not include an equivalent percentage conversion letter from the Head of Institute/Controller of Examination (if percentage is not mentioned in marksheet).

Common mistakes / What to check before applying Exim Bank Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  • Applying for MT-HRM without specialization in Human Resource Management / Personnel Management, or applying for MT-Administration without the prescribed qualification combinations.
  • Not checking whether your graduation and postgraduation are from a full-time regular programme; part-time/distance mode graduates are not eligible even if the university is recognized.
  • Entering less than 60% marks in either graduation or postgraduation; both must independently meet the 60% threshold.
  • OBC candidates applying with an expired caste certificate; OBC NCL certificate must be issued within one year prior to the last date of applying and must contain the non-creamy layer clause.
  • Uploading blurred/incorrect photo, signature, left thumb impression, or handwritten declaration; any mismatch or unclear document can lead to rejection.

  • Using an inactive or incorrect mobile number/email ID, causing missed notifications for call letters, exam updates, or interview communication.
  • Pressing the BACK or REFRESH button during the online payment process, which may result in double charge or payment failure.
  • Not noting down the Provisional Registration Number and Password generated at the time of registration; required for re-login if application is saved midway.
  • Submitting application without verifying that the name as filled in the form exactly matches the name on photo identity proof; any mismatch will lead to disqualification at the exam/interview stage.

Pune People's Co-Op Bank Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be based on the candidate's qualifications and experience. The Board of Directors reserves the right to relax the conditions in respect of candidates. The general selection flow is:

  • Step 1 – Application Screening: Applications are screened based on post-wise eligibility criteria (qualification, experience, age).
  • Step 2 – Shortlisting: Candidates with higher qualifications than stipulated will be given preference. Computer literacy is mandatory for all posts.
  • Step 3 – Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview at the Head Office or a designated location. Date and venue will be communicated by the bank.
  • Step 4 – Document Verification: Original documents will be verified at the time of interview or joining.

Who Should NOT Apply for Pune People's Co-Op Bank Recruitment 2026?

  • Candidates who do not meet the minimum experience requirements for the post applied for - the bank explicitly requires verified years of relevant banking experience for all posts.
  • Fresh graduates with no work experience - all posts require a minimum of 1 year (Graphic Designer) to 15 years (Chief Law Officer) of relevant experience.
  • Candidates above the age limit specified for their post, unless the Board decides to grant relaxation.
  • Candidates applying for legal posts (DGM Chief Law Officer / Branch Manager Legal Officer) who do not hold LLB/LLM qualifications - other qualifications are not acceptable for these posts.
  • Candidates who are not computer literate - computer literacy is a mandatory requirement for all posts without exception.
  • Candidates unwilling or unable to be posted at any of the bank's locations across Pune, Belgaum, Thane, or Chh. Sambhaji Nagar.
  • Candidates who cannot submit a physical application by post to the Head Office within 10 days of the advertisement date - no online application mode is available.
  • Candidates applying for Branch Manager (Board Secretary) who are not proficient in both English and Marathi correspondence.
  • Candidates for Steno/Typist post who cannot type at 40 w.p.m. in English - this is a minimum threshold, not a preferred standard.

Common Mistakes / What to Check Before Applying

  • Not mentioning the post applied for clearly on the application envelope - the notification explicitly states the post must be written on the envelope; unlabelled envelopes may be misdirected or rejected.
  • Downloading and using an incorrect or outdated application form - the form must be obtained from the bank's official website www.punepeoples.bank.in only.
  • Missing the 10-day deadline - with such a short window, candidates must act immediately after seeing the advertisement. Postal delays must be accounted for.
  • Not attaching all necessary supporting documents (qualification certificates, experience certificates, age proof) with the application - incomplete applications may be rejected outright.
  • Applying for a post with experience from a private sector company that is not a Co-operative or Nationalized Bank for senior posts - most senior roles specifically require banking experience in Co-operative or Nationalized Banks.
  • Claiming CAIIB qualification without valid certification - CAIIB is a key differentiator for senior posts and will be verified.
  • Applying for multiple posts in the same envelope - each post application should be treated separately with a clearly labelled envelope.
  • Not verifying the communication address before sending - the application must be sent to: 477/478, 1st Floor, Market Yard, Gultekadi, Pune – 411037.
  • Candidates for Branch Manager (Legal Officer) applying based only on academic law qualifications without actual practicing/banking experience - 10 years of practical legal experience is mandatory.

What is Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026?

The Railway Recruitment Board City Intimation Slip 2026 is an advance notification document released before the admit card. It provides candidates with essential preliminary information about their examination to help them make necessary travel and accommodation arrangements. The city slip is NOT your admit card but serves as an important reference document.

Key Information Available in City Slip:

  • Allotted exam city and state
  • Scheduled exam date
  • Shift timing (Morning/Afternoon/Evening)
  • Reporting time at exam center
  • Gate closing time
  • Candidate's name and registration number
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC/General/EWS)
  • PwBD status (if applicable)

Important Notice: The city intimation slip is NOT your admit card and does not permit you to appear in the exam. It is only for informational purposes. You must download the admit card separately (available 4 days before exam) to enter the examination hall.

Common Issues & Solutions While Downloading City Slip

Issue 1: Unable to Login / Invalid Credentials Error

Solutions:

  • Verify your registration number carefully (no spaces before/after)
  • Check date of birth format: DD/MM/YYYY (e.g., 15/08/1998)
  • Ensure CAPS LOCK is off while entering details
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies (Ctrl+Shift+Del)
  • Try using a different web browser (Chrome, Firefox, or Edge)
  • Use "Forgot Registration Number" link if you don't remember it
  • Check your registered email for registration confirmation

Issue 2: City Slip Not Showing / Page Not Loading

Solutions:

  • Verify if city slip is released for your specific exam date
  • Try downloading during non-peak hours (early morning 6-8 AM or late night 11 PM onwards)
  • Disable VPN, proxy, or ad-blocker extensions
  • Check your internet connection stability
  • Try using mobile data instead of WiFi (or vice versa)
  • Use incognito/private browsing mode
  • Update your web browser to the latest version
  • Try accessing from mobile app if available

Issue 3: Error in Details Displayed on City Slip

Solutions:

  • Contact Railway Recruitment Board helpdesk immediately
  • Email to: [email protected] with screenshot
  • Call helpline: 080-4719-2000 (working hours: 10 AM - 5 PM)
  • Keep your registration number and application details ready
  • Explain the exact discrepancy in detail
  • Request for correction before exam date

Issue 4: PDF Download Not Working

Solutions:

  • Take a screenshot of the city slip as backup
  • Try "Print to PDF" option (Ctrl+P then save as PDF)
  • Use a different PDF reader (Adobe Acrobat Reader)
  • Check if pop-ups are blocked in browser settings
  • Ensure sufficient storage space on device
  • Try downloading from different device

Issue 5: Captcha Not Visible or Loading

Solutions:

  • Refresh the page (F5 key)
  • Enable JavaScript in browser settings
  • Disable browser extensions temporarily
  • Use a different browser
  • Clear browser cache completely

City Intimation Slip vs Admit Card - Key Differences

Many candidates confuse city intimation slip with admit card. Here's a clear comparison to understand the differences:

Aspect City Intimation Slip Admit Card / Hall Ticket
Purpose Advance information only for travel planning Mandatory entry document for examination
Release Time 7-10 days before exam date 4 days before exam date
Information Provided Exam city, date, shift timing only Complete center address, roll number, photo, signature
Can you enter exam hall? NO - Not permitted YES - Mandatory requirement
Contains Photo No Yes
Contains Roll Number No  Yes
Exam Center Address Only city name Complete address with venue details
Use for Travel Booking Yes - Use for advance planning Can use after release
Barcode/QR Code Usually not present Present for verification
Exam Instructions General instructions Detailed exam day instructions

Critical Warning: You CANNOT enter the examination hall with only the city intimation slip. You MUST download and carry the admit card (available 4 days before exam) along with a valid photo ID proof to appear for the exam.

UP Board Class 10th/12th Compartment Online Form 2026

  • Students of Class 10 (High School) and Class 12 (Intermediate) under the Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UPMSP), Prayagraj, who are dissatisfied with their marks in any subject or with their overall result for the 2026 exams, can apply for Compartment and Improvement. UPSSSC Junior Assistant (Kanistha Sahayak) Mains Revised Answer Key 2026 - Official Master Set Released

The UPSSSC Junior Assistant Revised Answer Key 2026 is officially out. The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC), headquartered at Pickup Bhawan, Third Floor, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow – 226010, released the revised answer key on 13 June 2026 vide Notice No. 100/08/Computer Section (12)/2025-26/12-Exam/2024.

The written examination for the post of Kanistha Sahayak (Junior Assistant) Main Exam (PRA-AP-2023)/12 was conducted on 01 February 2026 under Advertisement No. 12-Exam/2024. After publishing the provisional answer key on 02 February 2026 and inviting objections (link made available on 03 February 2026), UPSSSC has now finalized and uploaded the revised / descriptive Master Set answer key on its official website upsssc.gov.in after reviewing all valid objections received.

Candidates who appeared in this exam can now download the revised Master Set answer key (Set Code: ZO3) directly from the official UPSSSC portal.

Overview - UPSSSC Junior Assistant Mains Exam 2026

This section gives a quick reference snapshot of all essential details related to the UPSSSC Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam and the revised answer key release.

Detail Information
Conducting Body UPSSSC (Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission)
Advertisement No. 12-Exam/2024
Post Name Kanistha Sahayak (Junior Assistant)
Exam Name Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam (PRA-AP-2023)/12
Exam Date 01 February 2026
Provisional Answer Key Released 02 February 2026
Objection Window Opened 03 February 2026
Revised Answer Key Released 13 June 2026
Set Code (Master Set) ZO3
Official Website upsssc.gov.in
Notice Number 100/08/Computer Section (12)/2025-26/12-Exam/2024

Important Dates - UPSSSC Kanistha Sahayak Answer Key 2026

Tracking the complete timeline helps candidates understand where they stand in the recruitment process. Here are all the key dates confirmed in the official UPSSSC notice dated 13 June 2026.

Event Date
Written Exam Conducted 01 February 2026
Provisional Answer Key Published 02 February 2026
Objection Submission Link Activated 03 February 2026
Revised (Master Set) Answer Key Released 13 June 2026

What Is the UPSSSC Revised Answer Key 2026?

The revised answer key is the final, corrected version of the answer key released after UPSSSC reviews all objections submitted by candidates. This section explains what the Master Set revised answer key means and why it matters.

After the provisional answer key was published on 02 February 2026, candidates were given the opportunity to raise objections against any answer they found incorrect. UPSSSC reviewed all valid objections received against the provisional key. Following this review process, the commission has now published the Master Set Revised (Descriptive) Answer Key for Set Code ZO3 on its official website. This revised key supersedes the provisional answer key and will be used as the final reference for result preparation.

The answer key covers all 100 questions from the Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam and spans the following subject areas:

  • Hindi Language (Grammar, vocabulary, idioms, proverbs)
  • General Mental Ability and Reasoning
  • General Knowledge and Current Affairs
  • Computer Knowledge and Digital Literacy
  • Uttar Pradesh Special GK (Geography, History, Economy, Polity)

How to Download UPSSSC Junior Assistant Revised Answer Key 2026

Candidates can access the Master Set revised answer key directly from the UPSSSC official website in a few simple steps. No login credentials are required for downloading the answer key.

Step-by-step process:

  1. Visit the official website: upsssc.gov.in
  2. Look for the "Answer Key" or "Important Notice" section on the homepage.
  3. Find the link titled "Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam (PRA-AP-2023)/12 - Revised Answer Key (Master Set)"
  4. Click on the link - the PDF will open in your browser.
  5. Download and save the answer key PDF for reference.
  6. Match your responses with the Master Set (ZO3) answer key to estimate your score.

Direct Link: UPSSSC Junior Assistant Revised Answer Key 2026

Subject-Wise Highlights from the Revised Answer Key (Set ZO3)

The UPSSSC Kanistha Sahayak Mains Exam covered five broad subject areas across 100 questions. Below is a subject-wise summary of the types of questions asked, directly sourced from the Master Set revised answer key (ZO3).

Hindi Language (Questions 1–30)

The Hindi section tested candidates on core grammar and vocabulary concepts. Topics covered in the exam included the number of vowels (Swarvarna) in Hindi, Sandhi-Viched (word splitting), types of Sandhi (such as Guna Sandhi), correct and incorrect word forms, synonyms and antonyms, idioms (Muhavare), proverbs (Lokoktiyan), Samas (compound words including Tatpurush Samas), Karak (grammatical cases including Apadan Karak), types of pronouns (Prashnvachak Sarvanam), types of sentences, and one-word substitutions.

General Mental Ability and Reasoning (Questions 31–45)

The reasoning section included analogy-based questions, odd one out from letter series, number-based coding problems, seating arrangement-based ranking questions, figure counting (number of squares in a given figure), sequence completion, coding-decoding (such as CALL = BZKK, find PEON), syllogism-based logical conclusions, and series completion (e.g., 3, 15, 35, 63, 99, ?).

General Knowledge and Current Affairs (Questions 46–60)

The GK section covered static and current affairs topics including the origin of the Ganga river (Gangotri Glacier), common domestic fuel (LPG), organ that pumps blood (Heart), Pokhran's historical significance (successful Atomic Bomb testing), the pandemic that spread in 2020 (Covid-19), the organization running India's space programmes (ISRO), the leader who launched the Quit India Movement (Mahatma Gandhi), the sector employing most Indians (Agriculture), currency note issuing authority in India (Reserve Bank of India), the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre location (Amritsar, Punjab), the Salt Satyagraha movement (Civil Disobedience Movement), the song popular during the Swadeshi Movement (Vande Mataram), the state with rich coal deposits (Chhattisgarh), India's Chief Election Commissioner in 2025 (Gyanesh Kumar), and the country from which India purchased Rafale-M jets in 2025 (None of the above).

Computer Knowledge and Digital Literacy (Questions 61–80)

The computer section tested candidates on the first version of the Internet (ARPANET, 1969), matching software to categories (Microsoft Word = Word Processor, Linux = Operating System, Google Chrome = Web Browser, Photoshop = Image Editing Software), arranging computers by processing power (Micro, Mini, Mainframe, Super), the primary purpose of USB (connecting external devices and transferring data), the father of computers (Charles Babbage), e-Governance (using the Internet to provide government services), the hardware used to print large maps and posters (Plotter), a digital wallet (Paytm), FASTag (automatic toll payment without stopping), the Internet as a network of globally connected computers, examples of structured data (Excel), AI examples (ChatGPT), popular AI voice assistants (Siri), and IoT/Big Data/Deep Learning/AI matching.

Uttar Pradesh Special GK (Questions 81–100)

The UP-specific section included questions on the Lower Ganga Canal (built in 1878, originates at Narora in Bulandshahr district), the Mahajanapad-Capital pair not correctly matched (Asmak – Virat), the dynasty that replaced the Shunga dynasty in Magadh (Kanva dynasty), districts in Azamgarh Division (Mau, Ballia), Babur's victory at the Battle of Khanwa 1527 (Rana Sanga of Mewar), the Battle of Ghaghara (1529), the date of approval of UP Tourism Policy 2022 (16 November 2022), location of Chota Imambara and Roomi Darwaza (Lucknow), Kaimur Wildlife Sanctuary location (Sonbhadra), plateaus forming UP's southern frontier (Bundelkhand and Baghelkhand), Archaean rocks found in (Sonbhadra and Lalitpur), IST facts (82.5° east longitude, passes through Mirzapur), the "Sorrow of Gorakhpur" river (Rapti), incorrectly matched airport (Kalyanpur International Airport – Aligarh), GNIDA full form (Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority), Operation Dronagiri 2024 states (UP, Haryana, Assam, Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra), Kashi Tamil Sangamam (KTS) 3.0 location (Varanasi, Feb 2025), UP Budget 2025-26 (Rs. 8,08,736.06 crore), veteran hockey player from Varanasi (Lalit Upadhyay), and Tiger Claw 2025 exercise (concluded at Garud Regimental Training Center, UP).

  1. Download your OMR response sheet / note down your marked answers from memory.

  3. Note the marking scheme mentioned in the official UPSSSC notification for this exam.
  4. Add up correct answers and apply any applicable negative marking as per the official scheme.
  5. This estimated score will give you a rough indication of your performance ahead of the official result declaration.

What Happens After the Revised Answer Key?

Now that the UPSSSC Junior Assistant Revised Answer Key 2026 has been released, the next step in the recruitment process is the declaration of the Final Result / Merit List. The result will be prepared based on candidate performance in the Mains Written Exam using the revised Master Set answer key as the final reference. How to Calculate Your Score Using OPSC OCS Answer Key 2026

Once the answer key is downloaded, candidates can estimate their probable prelims score using the formula below. This helps assess chances of qualifying for the Mains examination before the official result is declared.

Score Calculation Formula:

Score = (Total Correct Answers × 1) - (Total Incorrect Answers × 0.33)

Steps to calculate:

  1. Count all your correct answers from the answer key.
  2. Multiply that count by 1 to get your positive marks.
  3. Count all your incorrect answers.
  4. Multiply that count by 0.33 and subtract from your positive marks.
  5. Do not add or deduct anything for unattempted questions.
  6. Separately verify you have scored at least 33% in CSAT Paper 2.

Why Is the RSSB Lab Assistant Answer Key Important?

The answer key plays a crucial role in the post-exam phase of any government recruitment process. Here is why every candidate should carefully review it:

  • Transparency in Recruitment: Publishing the answer key ensures fairness and openness in the evaluation process.
  • Objection Mechanism: If a candidate believes any answer is incorrect, they have the right to formally challenge it within the objection window.
  • Reduces Post-Exam Anxiety: Knowing your approximate score helps candidates plan their next steps — whether to prepare for document verification or for future exams.

  • After reviewing all valid objections, RSSB will release the Final Answer Key.
  • No further challenges are accepted once the final answer key is published.

He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store. Generate weekly or bi-weekly client reports covering outreach sent, opens, replies, interviews scheduled, and pipeline status. 9. Track each client’s application pipeline from saved to applied to interviewing and keep records updated. 10. Communicate proactively with clients when attention or input is required. 11. Flag patterns, blockers, or client issues to internal leads before they become problems. Strong understanding of the job search process and practical hiring workflows. 3. Strong written English skills for writing client-facing emails and reports. 4. Comfortable working with LinkedIn, spreadsheets, email clients, and new SaaS tools. 5. High ownership mindset with the ability to manage deliverables independently. 6. Ability to handle multiple clients and priorities simultaneously without missing deadlines. 7. Good understanding of corporate hierarchy and stakeholder targeting. 8. Previous startup experience is a strong plus. 9. Familiarity with ATS systems, cold email tools, or LinkedIn outreach is a strong plus. What good looks like at 90 days: 1. Managing a full client portfolio independently with minimal escalations. 2. Ensuring client reports and outreach activities are delivered consistently on time. 3. Proactively flagging edge cases and judgment calls instead of making assumptions or remaining silent. 4. Helping clients receive replies and schedule interviews successfully.

Role Snapshot
At peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Partnerships Director to lead and strengthen key partner relationships, drive operational excellence, and support the successful delivery of strategic education-focused initiatives. This role is ideal for a commercially minded relationship leader who combines strong account management capabilities with project coordination expertise and a passion for delivering exceptional stakeholder outcomes.

Role Overview

The Strategic Partnerships Director is responsible for managing and developing strategic partner relationships while ensuring the successful coordination and delivery of activities across multiple stakeholders. The role focuses on governance, reporting, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and identifying opportunities to strengthen long-term partnerships and support sustainable growth.

Working closely with internal teams and senior external stakeholders, you will act as a trusted advisor, ensuring commitments are delivered, issues are resolved efficiently, and partnership objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage strategic partner relationships and act as a trusted point of contact for senior stakeholders
  • Support the overall success of partnership engagements through proactive account management and stakeholder collaboration
  • Oversee operational planning, risk management, and delivery activities across key phases of partner engagements
  • Identify, manage, and resolve escalated issues while ensuring timely communication and effective outcomes
  • Coordinate cross functional teams to ensure commitments are delivered and activities remain aligned with partnership objectives
  • Prepare and present governance reports, business reviews, and performance updates for internal and external stakeholders
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to improve partnership performance and long-term value creation
  • Coach and guide internal teams on effective partner engagement practices and account management approaches
  • Develop a deep understanding of partner objectives and identify opportunities to expand support and strengthen relationships
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of partnership management processes, systems, and operational frameworks

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience in senior account management, partnership management, or client relationship leadership roles
  • Minimum two years of experience managing key accounts, strategic partnerships, or complex stakeholder relationships
  • Experience coordinating projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Strong client service orientation with a proven ability to build productive and trusted relationships
  • Knowledge of digital education, online learning, higher education, or related sectors would be advantageous
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare reports, presentations, and proposals
  • Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Experience working independently while effectively collaborating with geographically distributed teams
  • Demonstrated problem solving, decision making, and risk management capabilities
  • Commitment to continuous learning, improvement, and professional development

Benefits

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

Exposure to strategic stakeholder engagement and partnership leadership opportunities.

Opportunity to work with diverse teams across multiple regions and time zones.

Our Recruitment Process

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  • Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
  • Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
  • Video Interview Stage: You'll be invited to record short responses to 3-4 role-specific questions.
  • Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
  • Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
  • Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
  • Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you'll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

Role Snapshot
Brahma AI is the end-to-end content system for content creation. We build photorealistic digital humans with our proprietary models, ATMAN (visual identity) and VAANI (voice), which power an enterprise platform that lets these humans speak across languages. We are now building a dedicated in-house linguistics function so that our output is not just accurately translated, but linguistically and vocally excellent in every language we ship.

About The Role

This is not a traditional translation seat. You will be one of our first linguists in, owning language quality across both text and voice, and helping shape the tools that produce it and how other linguists interact with these tools. You will sit close to the VAANI (voice) team. Your job is twofold:

  • Make our output linguistically excellent.
  • Make the systems that generate and support that output better, across both text and voice.

You will be the first internal user of our localisation tooling and voice interfaces. Your feedback will directly define how they work.

Today we rely on external vendors and internal native speakers. That does not scale, and it does not give us ownership. We need dedicated linguists who hold the quality bar and drive the tooling forward. You will, however, be involved in supervising external linguists as volume demands.

What You Will Do

  • Own linguistic quality (review, QC, correction) for translated text in your language(s).
  • Review and evaluate synthesised voice from VAANI in your language, starting with linguistic correctness, then naturalness, prosody, pronunciation, emotion, and timing.
  • Work directly with the VAANI team to define and improve how voice is generated and evaluated in your language.
  • Help design the linguist-facing platform experience: the workflows, review screens, and tooling linguists use to translate and validate output. You are the first user, so you tell us what good looks like.
  • Build and maintain the linguistic assets for your language: style guides, glossaries, evaluation criteria, pronunciation guidance, and a pronunciation dictionary you contribute to and continually refine.
  • Set the quality standards and turnaround expectations for external vendors and internal speakers, rather than absorbing all the volume yourself.
  • Turn linguistic problems into structured, actionable input for engineering and product.

Who You Are

  • An excellent linguist first. Native or near-native command of your language, with strong English.
  • Formal training or equivalent professional experience in linguistics, translation, or localisation.
  • Fluent with AI. You already use AI tools in your work and you trust them where they earn it. You want to help shape the models and platform tools that produce the highest quality translation and voice output, in the most efficient way.
  • Adaptable and hands-on. Comfortable in a fast-moving, undefined environment. You like building process where none exists.
  • A clear communicator. You can explain linguistic nuance to engineers and turn vague product goals into concrete language requirements.
  • Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You hold a high bar and you ship.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with voice, TTS, or speech evaluation.
  • Experience with localisation tooling, CAT tools, or QA platforms.
  • Enough technical literacy to understand, at a high level, how these models behave and fail.
  • Additional languages.

Languages We Are Hiring For

We are hiring linguists across the following languages:

  • English
  • Mandarin Chinese (Simplified)
  • Spanish (Latin American and Castilian)
  • Hindi
  • Arabic (MSA)
  • Portuguese (Brazilian)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • French
  • German
  • Italian
  • Turkish

Why Join?

You will help define how digital humans speak across the worldâs languages, with direct ownership of both the quality and the tools that produce it. This is a build role, not a maintenance role.

At our organisation, we redefine executive and business support through exceptional problem-solving, proactive execution, and advanced integration of technology and AI. You are highly tech-savvy and naturally leverage tools, including AI, to design, deliver, and scale impactful programs. Whether your background is in program management, operations, product, or enablement, you excel at driving clarity, alignment, and measurable outcomes across complex initiatives.

Join a culture that prioritises clarity, practical innovation, and the seamless integration of human intuition with technology and AI-driven efficiency.

Our client is a specialist UK-based delivery partner supporting pharmaceutical and medical device organisations across marketing, communications, education, and events. Working across print, digital, and live engagement channels, they deliver high-quality, compliant project execution within highly regulated environments.

Their work is built around strong operational delivery, deep understanding of pharmaceutical compliance processes, and a modern approach to project execution supported by technology and AI-enabled workflows.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, agile delivery team supporting global healthcare brands on complex and fast-moving projects.

Location: Remote / Flexible
Commitment: Approx. 1 day per month

Our client is a modern philanthropic organisation and donor-advised fund (DAF) focused on building sustainable, long-term impact through innovative and disciplined approaches to charitable giving and capital stewardship.

Operating at the intersection of philanthropy, governance, innovation and long-term sustainability, the organisation is developing a model designed to create enduring impact over generations. Through its donor-advised fund structure, it provides a flexible, forward-thinking platform for strategic philanthropy, long-term giving and responsible stewardship of charitable capital.

The organisation operates within a lean and agile environment and is seeking individuals who are comfortable navigating complexity, supporting innovation responsibly and helping shape scalable structures for long-term success.

The Opportunity

Our client is seeking to appoint two Trustees to join its Board and contribute to the strategic oversight, governance and long-term sustainability of the organisation.

This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven organisation operating within a dynamic and evolving environment. Trustees will help ensure the organisation maintains strong governance while supporting innovation, responsible growth and long-term impact.

The organisation is particularly interested in individuals who see governance as an enabler of progress rather than a barrier to innovation.

  • Support the long-term sustainability and institutional development of the organisation
  • Contribute expertise, insight and professional experience to Board discussions
  • Act as an ambassador for the organisation where appropriate

  • Solutions-oriented and commercially minded
  • Entrepreneurial in thinking and adaptable in approach
  • Strong communicators with integrity and sound judgement
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving and evolving environments
  • Collaborative, thoughtful and strategically minded
  • Motivated by long-term impact and sustainable philanthropy
Essential Experience
  • Previous Trustee, Board, governance or senior leadership experience preferred
  • Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capability
  • Ability to operate effectively within complex stakeholder environments
  • Understanding of governance, accountability and organisational oversight
Desirable Experience

For one Trustee appointment, a background in legal, regulatory or governance matters would be highly desirable.

For another Trustee appointment, a background in finance, accounting, investment oversight or financial governance would be highly desirable.

Additional experience that may be valuable includes:

  • Charities, foundations or philanthropic organisations
  • International operations or governance

  • Commercial, technology or investment-related sectors

  • Remote

Role Snapshot

STARS + HONEY: Head of Consumer Experience

ROLE OVERVIEW

Stars + Honey is a fast-growing functional nutrition brand on a mission to eliminate compromise in health and indulgence. Our products deliver joyful flavor and clean functionality, making everyday wellness feel like a treat rather than a trade-off.

As we enter our next phase of growth â scaling from a strong DTC foundation into national retail â we are seeking a Head of Consumer Experience to build and lead a best-in-class consumer experience function.


This role is critical to:

  • Delivering an exceptional consumer experience across every touchpoint
  • Increasing consumer loyalty, repeat purchase, and advocacy
  • Protecting and strengthening the Stars + Honey brand reputation
  • Turning consumer feedback into actionable business insights
  • Building scalable systems and processes that support rapid growth


This leader will own the end-to-end consumer experience strategy and operations across DTC, Amazon, and retail support channels, ensuring every interaction reflects the premium, joyful, and consumer-first experience that defines Stars + Honey.

This role reports to the Chief Brand & Commercial Officer.


IMPACT OF THIS ROLE

As Director of Consumer Experience, you will play a critical role in shaping how consumers experience Stars + Honey across every stage of their journey.

  • You will build the systems, processes, and standards that ensure consumers receive thoughtful, timely, and effective support while helping the organization learn from every interaction.
  • You will own the consumer experience from first purchase through repeat purchase, ensuring that every question, concern, product issue, and moment of delight strengthens trust in the brand.
  • You will serve as the voice of the consumer internally, partnering closely with Brand, Growth, Sales, Operations, and Product Development to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve the overall consumer experience.

This is a unique opportunity to build a consumer experience function that not only supports consumers, but strengthens loyalty, drives advocacy, and contributes meaningfully to long-term brand growth.


WHAT YOUâLL OWN

1. Consumer Care Operations

Own and elevate the day-to-day consumer experience across all channels:

  • Manage consumer support across email, website, social media, Amazon, and retail-related inquiries
  • Establish service standards, response time expectations, and escalation protocols
  • Develop and maintain SOPs, workflows, and response playbooks
  • Ensure all consumer interactions reflect the Stars + Honey brand voice and values
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve the consumer experience while increasing operational efficiency

Success = fast response times, exceptional service, and consistently positive consumer experiences.

2. Consumer Satisfaction & Service Excellence

Build a consumer experience function that consumers genuinely love interacting with:

  • Establish and monitor key consumer experience KPIs
  • Track and improve response times, resolution rates, satisfaction scores, and recurring issues
  • Conduct regular quality assurance reviews and coaching
  • Identify friction points and implement improvements
  • Create systems that make it easy for consumers to get the help they need

Success = stronger consumer satisfaction, fewer service issues, and increased consumer loyalty.

3. Reviews, Reputation & Brand Advocacy

Protect and strengthen the Stars + Honey brand across every consumer touchpoint:

  • Monitor consumer sentiment across reviews, social channels, and support interactions
  • Own review management across Amazon, DTC, and key retail partners
  • Identify recurring themes and partner cross-functionally to address root causes
  • Build systems that encourage ratings, reviews, referrals, and advocacy
  • Help turn satisfied consumers into passionate brand ambassadors

Success = stronger brand sentiment, increased positive reviews, and growing consumer advocacy.

4. Voice of Consumer & Insights

Serve as the voice of the consumer throughout the organization:

  • Collect and analyze feedback from support channels, reviews, surveys, and social conversations
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and recurring pain points
  • Develop recurring Voice of Consumer reporting for leadership
  • Translate consumer feedback into actionable recommendations
  • Partner with Brand, Product Development, Sales, and Operations to improve products, experiences, and communications

Success = consumer insights directly influence business decisions and help drive continuous improvement.

5. Consumer Recovery & Escalation Management

Own resolution of complex consumer issues and ensure challenging situations become opportunities to build trust:

  • Manage escalated service issues and product-related concerns
  • Partner with Operations and Quality teams to investigate product feedback and complaints
  • Develop consumer recovery programs and service recovery best practices
  • Create clear communication frameworks for handling sensitive situations
  • Success = consumers leave even difficult interactions feeling heard, valued, and confident in the brand.

6. Systems, Technology & Scalability

Build the infrastructure needed to support rapid growth:

  • Own consumer experience platforms and tools
  • Improve workflows, automation, and reporting capabilities
  • Develop dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into performance and consumer trends
  • Manage external consumer care agencies and partners
  • Build systems that scale as the business continues to grow

Success = scalable infrastructure that supports exceptional service without sacrificing quality.

7. Team & Partner Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing consumer experience team
  • Manage external partners and agencies
  • Establish clear goals, accountability, and performance expectations
  • Foster a consumer-first mindset across the organization


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (First 6â12 Months)

  • Consumer response times improve significantly
  • Consumer satisfaction scores exceed established benchmarks
  • Ratings and reviews improve across key channels
  • Recurring service issues and escalations decline
  • A structured Voice of Consumer program is established
  • Consumer feedback is regularly shared and acted upon across the organization
  • Scalable systems and processes are implemented to support future growth
  • Consumer experience becomes a meaningful driver of loyalty, advocacy, and repeat purchase


WHO YOU ARE

Experience

  • 5â10+ years of experience in Consumer Experience, Customer Service, Consumer Care, Customer Success, or related functions
  • Experience scaling support operations within high-growth consumer brands
  • Background in DTC, eCommerce, CPG, or omnichannel consumer businesses
  • Experience building processes, systems, and teams in fast-paced environments

Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of consumer experience and customer service best practices
  • Strong operator who enjoys building systems and solving problems
  • Highly consumer-centric with exceptional empathy and judgment
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data and feedback into action
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator

Leadership Traits

  • High ownership mindset
  • Strong communication skills
  • Detail-oriented and operationally rigorous
  • Bias toward action and continuous improvement
  • Passion for building brands consumers genuinely love

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

This role is central to Stars + Honey's ambition to become a leading omnichannel nutrition brand by:

  • Delivering exceptional consumer experiences at scale
  • Building deeper relationships with consumers
  • Strengthening trust, loyalty, and advocacy
  • Protecting and enhancing brand reputation
  • Turning consumer feedback into meaningful business improvements
  • At Stars + Honey, we believe consumers should never have to compromise between health and indulgence. This role ensures they never have to compromise on their experience with our brand, either.
